description:
It has all household machines such as refrigerator, oven, hair dryer. Provides 24-hour unlimited internet access, hot water heating system. In addition, your towels and Istanbul maps will be ready when you check in and my check-in time is flexible. The whole apartment has new furniture and is completely modernly decorated. There are wardrobes, cool rugs, bedside tables and comfortable chairs. It is just 100 meters away from Taksim.
Flat is 2. floor
You will absolutely enjoy the city,and my home!

reviews.text:
The host is extremely responsive and ready to take any necessary action to improve your stay quality. For example, when I complained about the TV not being smart, they added a Xiaomi TV box the next day. The place can host up to 5 people and is spacious enough. Depending on what you plan to do, this unit is perfectly located in an accessible area close to public transport or the famous Istighlal street.
There are a few problems, however. The windows/walls are not so good for sound isolation. In the mid-night when the drunk people go around the streets, their noises can be heard in two of the bedrooms loud and clear. The noises were waking me up in the middle of the night. Other than that, noises of the cars, music, people talking could be heard in the unit. Also, we found the bed frames and mattresses of low quality which can be improved. Also the shower was problematic. I find the place not as fancy as it looks in the pictures, after all, the devil is in details.

We had a wonderful stay! Our host was extremely kind, helpful, and very responsive throughout our stay. The apartment is super cute, cozy, and in a great location, making it easy to explore the area. Everything was clean and comfortable, and we really enjoyed our time here.
Just a couple of things to keep in mind: the apartment is on the second floor with no elevator, and there is one bathroom shared between the three bedrooms. Other than that, everything was great! We would definitely stay again and highly recommend this place. Thank you so much for having us! ✨

The apartment was very clean and well maintained although it was old. Mira was very responsive and helpful, and she quickly provided anything we needed during our stay. Everything was exactly as described in the listing.
The location was excellent—very close to Taksim Square and just a one-minute walk from Istiklal Street. Even though the apartment is right in the city center, it was surprisingly quiet with very little noise.
The apartment is located in the second floor which is written in the description and I didn’t pay attention but they helped us with our luggages.
My family and I really enjoyed our stay and had a wonderful time.

Moray was very active in her comms with us and how to get to the property. The photos were true to the property, however when my curtain fell down when I went to draw them at night there was so much Reno junk under the bed that should have been removed from the property. Old curtains, sheets, shelving etc. Advantages of place are close to Iskital st and Metro system. But so does the nightclubbing noise, parking agreements and people working all hours of the night. For is Westerners (im Australian) and Kiwis staying with me… a Toaster for the kitchen, and tea towels would be great. For the lounge - a Smart TV, so we can use our Media to chill out in our spare time with English speaking entertainment or Netflix etc. Happy with the big fridge and washing machine. A real treat when travelling in a group. Be aware there are 2 flights of stairs to climb with no lift (40 steps total). Overall, a great stay, minor hiccups but nothing to take away from the stay. Would I stay again…absolutely.

I had a great stay at Miray Ada’s apartment. Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Miray is very responsive, kind, and always ready to help, which made the stay even better. The only thing to keep in mind is that it can get a bit noisy due to the nearby road, but it wasn’t a big issue for me. Overall, highly recommended!

description: Our place, which is close to Taksim Square, will provide a suitable and comfortable accommodation for our guests. This apartment is located on the 2nd floor and access to the apartment can be made by stairs. The apartment has a portable kitchen where you can cook simple meals. You can also spend time in our backyard as a common area and create a working environment for yourself while drinking your hot drinks.

reviews.text:
Great place for any couple looking for a simple base for their Istanbul adventures. Well worth the price.
Pluses:
- the locality is great, you can get anywhere fast from Taksim. Turan street has a great vibes and food.
- big and comfortable bed
- Mr. Serhat is a very nice host, always responsive, always nearby, communication was great
Small minuses:
- the shower could be cleaner
- stains on the wall spoil the impression of the room a little bit
- sometimes animals on the rooftop woke us up
I recommend it to anyone searching for a budget friendly spot in a great district

Good value for money, convenient location 10m walk from Taxim square with lots of good restaurants nearby.
Room is large and comfortable for 1 person with air conditioning with very basic facilities. Nowhere to cook so you will need to find a restaurant for hot food.
Serhat is helpful and always available for questions.
Neighbourhood is a bit chaotic with narrow streets and steep hills. But the room is quiet and peaceful except the 5x a day call to prayer from the Taksim mosque.
Overall good value for a private room in the heart of Istanbul. Recommend for solo travellers and couples 👍

The room was very clean and organized. it's a nice small place just like in the photos. You're going to get some very cute guests that you're going to see from the window (piegons). I loved our small room. it was perfect for us with a very suitable price.
Serhat is an amazing guy. He's so polite and generous. He offered to buy us bread from the bakery because he heard our "Mmm that looks delicious". He bought us ice cream when we encountered him with his small cute child (I assume). A very generous act that I will always remember. His wife (again, I'm assuming) is also a nice classy lady.
The place is very near to Taksim Square which makes it incredibly strategic. If you want to shop, enjoy the monuments and the streets, or take the train, everything will be near. Privacy is also guaranteed. That was a very crucial benefit for us.
I'd highly recommend this room. We booked 12 days so we can live like locals and it was a very nice experience.

I highly recommend Mr. Serhat's room!
It's the ideal place to discover Istanbul. The apartment is located just a few minutes' walk from the Taksim metro station, which makes it very easy to access all the tourist sites.
The room was impeccable, very clean, and everything needed was provided: clean towels, cleaning products, and quality bedding.
Mr. Serhat is an exceptional host, very welcoming, kind, and always available. Communication was perfect and very responsive from start to finish.
An excellent address, I will come back without hesitation!

Serhat’s airbnb was very comfortable and convenient. Serhat was very accommodating as we arrived very late to our place, and helped us carry our luggage’s up. The airbnb is closely located to Taksim square and bus stations which was very helpful. He also recommended us to places to eat and visit! The airbnb was very clean, and had everything we needed! Only inconvenience was the airbnb being located on an uphill, as it was a workout every time we came and left. Otherwise, we loved our stay at Serhat’s place!

description: This charming, characteristic Istanbul house is located in the midpoint between Galata Tower and Istiklal Avenue. It is 3 mins to these both major sights of Istanbul. The apartment is fully renovated. It is furnished with brand new items. Galata is best possible location to access all tourist attractions of Istanbul by walk. Sishane metro, Karakoy tram and ferry stations are 5 mins from the apartment by walk. The apartment is in a historical building that offers an exceptional experience.

reviews.text: Guess it is as good as it gets in Istanbul. Place is clean, 100% as described. Host always answered all my questions within 15-20 minutes. Good for 2-3 people. I didn’t like electric stove and if you are traveling with lots of luggage or have problems to negotiate high narrow stairs and steep climbs toward building location then choose another place. Lots of tourists till late in the night but apartment is quiet tho it is next at one of those screaming towers and first night i had a nice surprise at 6 am. I would rent this place again without thinking twice. Well worth the price and thanks to Ahmet for a good time I had at his place

I had a great stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was responsive and helpful, making check-in and the whole experience seamless. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Istanbul!

Lovely apartment. Owners are very nice and very helpful. The location is the best, 2 min walk to the Galata Tower and restaurants. The place was very clean and comfortable. I choose the penthouse (4 levels of stairs) great exercise for sure, but the owner has other apartments in the same building. They also own a cafe/restaurant downstairs: you can get pizza, pasta and much more.The owner also helped me with a ride back to the airport. I have plans to come back to Istanbul in the next few months and I will definitely rent one of the apartments from Mr Ahmet portfolio again. Thanks for having me.

We stayed here for over a week and really enjoyed the location and comforts of home. Ahmet the host is friendly, knowledgeable of the history of Turkey and easy to talk to. We enjoyed the home as it was clean, spacious for us and quiet at night. There is a cafe at the bottom of the building with really good breakfast, if you go downstairs and order the food they will bring it up to your room. My husband and I also had the hookah downstairs which was cool. I recommend this home!

Fernando and his team were absolutely amazing to work with. The booking and check in was easy apartment looks just like the photos but feel bigger. Ceilings low but the space is designed well and with the architecture. Often felt like sleeping in a museum. The stairs are not that bad and given the location and treat of a view at the top this was a perfect place to spend and wake up!!! Looking forward to booking again.

description: Our newly built place in the center of Kadıköy offers a modern and comfortable life. The bedroom and bathroom are together. The whole place is all yours. There are no common areas. All items are new. We offer a safer accommodation service because it has a steel door. The room has a large double bed, television, air conditioning, refrigerator, table, armchair, wardrobe, bedside table, kettle and welcome tray.

reviews.text:
moda area is quite noisy in general, 10-15 minutes to the metro, lots of local food around, ferry and bus stop nearby.
convenient check-in at any time and the host always answered.
the room is already quite old or much used repairs, there was a feeling that it is not clean, although maybe it is just over time so everything is used (especially towels and bed linen).
on the last day there was some kind of accident and all the water was turned off for several hours, which was of course very uncomfortable.
overall the experience is ok.

Konum gayet iyiydi, girişte herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Ancak temizlik konusunda oldukça sorunlu bir odaydı. Yatak temiz değildi ve duşakabin camları kirliydi. Sanki bir acele odadaki havlu vb. değiştirilmiş ama diğer her şey olduğu gibi kalmış görüntüsü vardı. Yastık yüzleri kirli görünüyordu ve yorgan yüzünde yıkama sonrası kalmış gibi görünen değil de daha yeni olduğu anlaşılan, canlı lekeler vardı. Yedeklerini istediğimizde hemen temin ettiler, yardımseverlerdi ama yine de konaklama deneyimini kötü etkiledi. Ayrıca duşta saçlar vardı. Bunun dışında oda genel olarak gösterildiği gibiydi. Yanlış tarif edilen bir şey yoktu.

The unit was as described and Fatih was very responsive during my stay. I liked the location it’s closed to a lot of things. There are different metro systems near especially if you want to explore the Asian side of Istanbul. I would recommend and definitely stay again.
We were pretty satisfied with Fatih's place. The location was great, easy check-in, and true the pictures. However, it was not cleaned thoroughly and there was no toilet paper provided.
Fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi temiz ve konum olarak oldukça merkeziydi. Konaklama süresince herhangi bir sorun yaşamadım. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

description:
Located in Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls and cinemas, this residence is waiting to welcome its new guests. It is within walking distance to places such as Taksim, Şişli and Nişantaşı.

High speed Wi-Fi available.
Elevator, parking, 24/7 security, reception.
New & High quality furniture.
It has front facade and city view from your own balcony.
Please kindly check all the photos for details.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE.

reviews.text: Great place. Smooth check in. Very clean and new. Central location, parking, pool, sauna. Recommended!

This was our second stay here, and just like the first, it was perfect. The location is very central and made it easy to get everywhere we needed. The apartment was very clean and well maintained throughout our stay. Nihan was extremely responsive and helpful whenever we needed anything, and all of the staff were also very kind and welcoming. We had a great experience again and would definitely stay here another time.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the apartment. It was an amazing and cozy place to stay. The location was perfect, right near everything and with plenty of activities to keep you entertained. The apartment was well-equipped and had everything you needed. It was the best experience I’ve ever had, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay.
See you next time!

Our stay at Guest Teori was exceptional. The location is very central, with most major tourist attractions and excellent restaurants around Istanbul reachable within a 10-minute drive. The apartment was well equipped with all the necessary amenities, including an iron and ironing board, as well as full cooking utensils with pots and pans. The staff were extremely welcoming, warm, and responsive, making all our requests easy to accommodate. We would definitely stay here again.
The location is great - a short walk (13 minutes) to taksim/istiklal and lots of restaurants and fun bars. The play is also very nice and clean. Would definitely recommend.

description: Our chic garden flat is located in Taksim and only 600 Meters away from fabulous İstiklal Street and 900 Meters away from Sishane Metro Station...It is at the garden level with full sunshine all day. It has a private garden of 20 Sqm with seating facility...You can sleep up to 3 Adults with a double bed and a sofa bed...Enjoy Your Stay and İstanbul Experience...

reviews.text: My husband and i had a great stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was perfect, close to everything we needed but not too close to all the noise. Communication with the host was smooth and super fast, which made everything even easier. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Wonderful apartment in a very central location: this is actually my second stay in this building but first in this apartment and I loved it! The private patio is really nice, too bad it was too cold to enjoy it thoroughly but then again, I came in winter:) The access to the rooftop with a stunning view was absolutely magical!
The apartment itself is actually very spacious, bigger than I expected, same goes for the bathroom and shower. It was very clean. The host was very responsive and helpful. Definitely recommend!

My stay was a great experience, recep was an amazing host n always reachable, super fluent in english, really friendly and professional manners 💯
The place was very clean and just like the photos and the neighborhood was great too, super close to istiqlal street, bus stations and other popular places in downtown.
100% recommended.
Great stay at Recep’s place! Clean, just like the photos, and in a perfect location near Taksim with easy access to buses and metro. The garden is a lovely bonus. Highly recommend!

Konaklamam harikaydı, kendimi evimde gibi hissettim! İstiklal Caddesi'ne çok yakın olmasına rağmen çok sakin ve rahat uyudum. 12 günlük kalışım boyunca haftada 2 kez yapılan temizlikten de çok memnun kaldım. Ulaşım çok kolaydı ve çevrede yemek için her şey elinizin altındaydı. Ev sahibi Ümit Bey çok ilgiliydi ve bizi harika ağırladı; çamaşır deterjanından tuza kadar tüm temel malzemeler mevcuttu. Türkiye'ye her gelişimde kesinlikle bu yeri tercih edeceğim.

description: You can have a nice time in our apartment, which is suitable for families and is centrally located. We are only 10 minutes walking distance from historical places

reviews.text: Great location, easy access, and well-equipped for the price! The stay was comfortable, though the cleanliness could be improved (dust under the beds and stained kitchen cabinets). Also, note that the smaller bedroom lacks AC and gets very hot. Still, highly recommended for larger groups looking for a great value stay.

Imre and his brothers were very helpful and responsive. Just the right amount of care. The apartment itself was as described and matched the pictures. The only thing I would prefer was a bit better kitchen (the stove was not so easy to control), and the shower jumped from hot water to cold and back like every 10 seconds. The rest was amazing, cozy, and comfortable. It is a decently quiet place within walking distance of many useful locations: POIs, tram and metro stations, restaurants, shops, and groceries. I would recommend both the place and its hosts.

Spacious and light apartment, good location for visiting all the sights.
Entrance to the apartment was up 2 flights of stairs, which are steep with no handrail, there was a lift but was out of service during our stay.
Could do with a little TLC, paint peeling, rust on some appliances, shower mount broken and some sockets not in wall properly.
Beds were comfy but location was noisy, cars and people till early hours and restarted very early in the morning.
Washing machine door stuck and clothes stuck in but host was very responsive and resolved quickly.
Would be helpful to have an information pack on arrival for appliances/tv etc as well as local information. Some information was given at check in but a reference guide would have been useful particularly as we arrive late at night.

The apartment was nice, comfortable, spacious and the location is great, safe and secure. Many shops and restaurants nearby and very close to some of the main attractions in Istanbul. The host was responsive at all times. The cleanliness was on satisfactory level. Wifi was not working properly in some of the rooms. There was a bit of a musty smell. Overall a great stay if you are on a budget.

Nice apartment, convenient location nearby Blue Mosque and other hot spots
there’s a lift to take you upstairs which is really essential when you have many heavy luggages
A little bummer that water pressure of the heater goes down to 0 every 2 days but the host can send someone to fix it very quick

description: Our centrally located flat in Kadikoy offers an incredible opportunity with its prime location near all public transport. You'll enjoy comfort in this stylishly decorated home, equipped with fiber internet, air conditioning, and essential household goods. Just steps away from the vibrant Kadikoy life, the quiet, street-facing apartment is designed for your convenience. Unlike many old buildings you'll stay in a new building with an elevator, ensuring modern comfort and convenience for your stay.

reviews.text:
In the middle of Kadikoy, which we regarded as the best area in Istanbul, this Airbnb served as a good base to explore what Istanbul offered. It perfectly combined with a Kadikoy food tour experience that allowed us to enjoy delicious Turkish food that mostly locals go to, all within walking distance from the Airbnb.
Host Bahat was very friendly and responsive. The room was very thoughtful furnished with everything we would need. Bahat also prepared local recommendations around here!
Some downsides: Some noise from the street below, fluctuating shower water temperature. Soft mattress and low pillow. Sewage smell emitting from toilet sink (everywhere in Turkiye not just here)
Public transportation: 15min walk from metro station/ferry terminal or 7min walk from busstop.
Overall was good value and strategic location.

Ev kadıköy boğa heykeline çok yakın yürüme mesafesinde her yere gidilebiliyor. Ev sahibin attığı konum ve verdiği bilgilerle hızlı şekilde eve ulaştık. Mutfak, yatak, tv, internet yeterliydi bağlantıda sorun yaşamadık. Tek sıkıntı diyebileceğim banyoda kullanılan paspaslar. Bana çok temiz gelmedi beyaz olduğu için çabuk kirlenmesi muhtemel. Evde de ekstra tek kullanımlık terlik bulunmuyor bu sebeple biraz içim sinmeyerek duştan çıkarken çorabımı giyip öyle bastım. Salondaki halının da vaziyeti çok iç açıcı gelmedi bana ama onun haricinde iyi bir evdi. Kadıköy olmasına rağmen gürültü yok denecek kadar azdı. Rahat bir uyku çekip aynı zamanda yürüme mesafesinde merkezde de vakit geçirebildik.

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was also very convenient and made it easy to get around.
Bahat was an excellent host. Always quick to respond, kind, and incredibly helpful throughout my stay. Communication was smooth from check-in to check-out, which made everything stress-free.
I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you for your hospitality!

Merhaba, konaklama genel olarak iyiydi sadece yeni rezervasyon yapacak olan arkadaşlara birkaç fikir vermek isterim, genel anlamda ev tertipli düzenliydi, Baht bey tüm sorularımıza gayet ilgili ve yardımcı yaklaştı.
Çok donanımlı olarak değil ama kalan kişilerin ihtiyacını yeterli karşılayacak kadar mutfak eşyaları vardı, Kadıköy’de olmasına rağmen diğer daire seçeneklerinin konumuna kıyasla tahminimden daha az gürültü vardı, en başta odayı ısıtmak için kaloriferleri açmıştım ama odanın içerisi ısıtma açık olmasa bile gayet sıcaktı, öyle ki bazı geceler direkt ısıtmayı kapatma gereksinimi duyduk, kış günü hiçbir derdimiz olmadı.
Yeni bir bina ve asansörü bulunuyor, eğer sizin için önemli ise büyük bir artı. Temizlik açısından yaşanmayacak bir durum yoktu elbette ama biz içimiz rahat etsin diye nevresim takımı getirdik, aynı zamanda bir tavsiye olarak eğer bizim gibi temizlik detayına fazla önem veriyorsanız yanınızda deterjan bazlı temizlik mendilleri de getirebilirsiniz.

I loved staying at this accomodation, located on a very nice street in an exciting part of Istanbul. Close to everything, very good AC keeping the apartment cool on hot days, clean and caring hosts who were very helpful. Nice colorful walls. Highly recommended!

description: We are Mayer Property Mngmt company with over 100 apts in our portfolio. Our Studio apt is located in Galata. On entrance floor, 200 meters away from Galata Tower w/ easy access to all attractions and hip restaurants & cafes in its neighbourhood. The apt is 30 sqm and tastefully designed for our guests needs : nesspresso & filter coffee machine ), Ultra Fast WiFi, Our Concierge is available at the entrance to assist you w/ your needs. Book now and experience this unique space.

reviews.text: This airbnb was in a great location in the heart of Istanbul - we kept discovering more and more great things to do each day, within walkable distance. Everything you needed within 100 m distance - fantastic! The room was clean and organized as reflected by the photos - all plugins worked as well. The only problem was the high pitched noise that was ongoing mostly in the evenings/during the night, which we suspected was from one of the neighbors air conditioning units. When we would open up the window during the night, it was so loud it disrupted our sleep. But, the host was adamant to get this issue resolved and acknowledged the problem to get it resolved. Beside that nuisance, everything was great! We would return again. Thank you Mayer & team!

I stayed in this one-bedroom apartment and had a great experience. The place is clean, cozy, and exactly as described. It has fast internet and a Smart TV, which made my stay very comfortable. I was traveling alone and checked in late, but the self check-in with code locks worked perfectly and was super convenient. Overall, a very comfortable stay — I’d definitely recommend it.

This place is definitely worth the money! The room is clean and comfortable, bathroom has everything you need. The location is the best side of it. It’s quiet, but still 1 minute walk from Galata Saray. Everything was perfectly arranged, host was very responsive and approachable. They were very helpful, arranging the transportation for us. Definitely would recommend!

it was a clean small hotel room. i think it's overpriced for what it was, but it's clean, quiet and in a great location, and helpful staff. there is no view, you look out on another building 1 meter away from you, so its a dark little hole, only good for sleeping really. because its ground floor, you hear everyone else coming and going, but it's ok, still quiet enough. I think this should cost max 35 dollars not more.

Rezervasyon yaparken hiç yorum olmadığı için tereddüt ettik ancak ev sahibinin bir çok evi olduğunu ve güzel yorumları olduğunu görünce bu endişemiz kalmadı. Konum anlatıldığı gibi ve harika, hotel dizaynı var, giriş çok emniyetli, sorularımıza hızlı cevaplar aldık ve temiz bir oda. Tavsiye ediyoruz :)

description: We offer a unique accommodation with comfortable and cozy rooms. Without breakfast. MARRIAGE IS A REQUIREMENT FOR DOUBLE ACCOMMODATIONS.

reviews.text: Firstly ever since my check in day, I’ve been getting random calls from Turkey numbers. I’m back in Australia and still getting calls. Clearly the system has been hacked and client numbers have been leaked. The second day the electricity was out almost the whole day which didn’t allow me to use the hairdryer before leaving the hotel for the day. I found the walls too thin and could hear the room next door. I had to air out the cigarette smell daily. Doors could have better lock system especially as a female solo traveller. Location was good with walking distance to supermarket, restaurants etc. The bed frames could have been cleaner from dust.

it was nice overall. I noticed some trash on the floor and hair on the towels ( they were clean though 😅), but I stayed for only one night, so all good. the Ac works, hot water available, nearby there's a bus stop, H6 goes to the airport, you can pay by any visa card
Thank you for accommodation, all was clean and cozy, near from airport..
Host helped us to find hotel and answer very fast

İlgi güzeldi. Otel odası temizdi. Tadilat vardı otel tam bitmemişti. Fotoğraflardaki odayı ayırmalarını söylememe rağmen başka bir oda verildi çok küçüktü valiz açılacak yer yoktu. Çıkmamıza 1-2 saat kala elektrikler gitti. Genel olarak bakıldığında kötü bir deneyimdi.

description:
Our flat is pretty quiet and peaceful, although it is in the heart of Galata. The flat is just a few steps away from Galata Tower and Karaköy.

The flat designed to provide all your needs. If you want, you can work from home with high-speed internet or cook for dinner or read a book peacefully in silence with high consantration.

Out of the building, there are a lot of boutique cafes to eat something and a lot of local market for shooping

reviews.text:
The apartment was clean, with a great terrace where you can have coffee in nice weather. Good location: 5 minutes on foot to the Galata Tower, with restaurants and shops nearby. It was warm because the heated floors were working. Fast Wi-Fi.
On the downside, the apartment is much smaller than it appears in the photos, especially the bathroom. Like many buildings in central Istanbul, there is no elevator, so it was difficult for us to carry two large suitcases. Just keep this in mind if you’re traveling with luggage.
Great location. Easy communication. Clean apartment

Konum olarak çok merkezi ama içeride kaldığı için kargaşadan da izole olması güzeldi. Check-in ve check-out işlemlerinde ev sahipleri çok yardımcı oldu. Yönelttiğimiz sorularda tavsiyeler verdiler. Rahat ve keyifli vakit geçirdik, teşekkürler.

Absolutely loved this little nest tucked away in a peaceful corner amongst the bustling karakoy neighborhood. Our host was pleasant, courteous, and proactive. We spent 6 nights in the area and loved it. Bonus, there was a mother with a litter of 3 kittens on our street, and we got to see them playing every day!

The most beautiful wonderful and tastefully apartment i have seen in turkey
Very centrally located. Wohld absolutely book it again. Hosts are extremely kind and helpful. Hughly recommended place in istanbul and wonderful hosts

description: Fully furnished apartment located in the heart of the old city near the Blue mosque, Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar. Walking distance to main attractions & public transportation.

reviews.text: Guven was extremely cooperative during our stay, wether it was 'keeping our bags safe after the checkout' or 'giving hand with luggage'. Accommodation location is in beautiful street and I was pleasantly surprised by its quietness despite the fact there were busy areas just a street away. Location was fantastic, I timed my walk to Sultan Mehmet Mosque which was 10 mins, Grand bazar was 15 mins, Sea was 15 mins. very good location if you want to avoid taxies and see everything by walking. Just a warning that this side of Istanbul is hilly so come prepared with a good pair of shoes. Property has 3 flats so if you are unable to climb stairs, then talk to Guven ahead of time to book ground floor apartment. If two different families are staying then beds in living room/kitchen don't give privacy. But in this price bracket you cant expect any more. Overall, I would stay again. Have your expectations set based on what you are paying then you will appreciate it more

Terrible experience in general. This is not an apartment, it’s a hotel so there’s other rooms in the property so you’re not on your own (not a private place). There was a lick in the sink that made all the kitchen and entrance floor wet and dirty, without mentioning there was a terrible smell coming from the lick. There were 2 AC’s, but one of them never worked. We weren’t able to close the bedroom’s door because of that and we specifically choose this property because of the separate bedrooms. Host was never there, although he said he would be. The only thing good was the location. Not recommended.

It's a A good family own Apartments Hotel. The apartment I booked was good for a family or a group of 4, and very comfortable and we enjoyed our stay. For me it is a geat location to visit Blue Mosque, Hagia Sofia, Topkapi Palace, and many other attractions and the old town of SultanAhmet and Fatih area. If you book any other guided tour like Bosphorus Cruise Tours, you can be picked up from this place with a return transfer.
Guven was a great and helpful, and very accommodating host. Helped us with booking tours, and car parking.

We received and extremely warm welcome from Guven and his staff at the apartment. They were very helpful in many aspects and accommodating towards our needs.
The apartment was smaller than we thought based on the photos however it was comfortable and clean.
very good location, bed is very clean and comfortable! the Staff is very helpful and polite!

description: Have a pleasant time with your whole family in this stylish place. Our apartments are clean and well-maintained. We have an office on the same floor between 9 am and 5 pm on weekdays.

reviews.text:
We had a nice stay at Sinpaş managed by Bondy . The Pros: 1. Secure building with 24 hour security and access card to enter. Beautiful view of Istanbul , gym and indoor & outdoor pool .
Balcony , AC in living room and bedroom .
Ekin the property manager was friendly and responsive .
The Cons:
The area around the building is little run down and you had to walk or take taxi to Bomonti or Nishantasi about 7- 20 min walk .
Unfortunately they allow smoking in all the condos they manage , so we had to change 3 condos till we found one less smelly .
The Mattress was uncomfortable , no amenities like shampoo , dish soap , hand soap , laundry detergent, paper towel , hangers & limited kitchenware.
Luckily they have store in lobby that offers all the supplies you need as well as coffee shop and pharmacy , etc

This was my first AirBnb in Turkey, and it was absolutely amazing. The apartment was just as nice, if not nicer than the pictures shown. The host (Ekin) was so generous and supportive when it came to anything we needed. The building is located in the heart of Istanbul, with a decked out gym, indoor and outdoor pool, a sauna, basketball court, tennis court, grocery store, cafe, the list goes on and on. 10/10, I plan on staying here again next time I visit.

It has been an amazing stay at this unit , the location is perfect for tourists or even half, long term stays, close to shopping mall and amazing view. The services makes everything easy for you and thank you for everything
Nice place, had a good time!
Thanks! Very nice place. Very nice service and view from the balcony.

description: We have prepared this newly restored room with large windows and a breathtaking view, located in a central location, for you to have a wonderful experience. Get ready to explore old Istanbul while staying safely in this room close to historical destinations.

reviews.text: Overall, we had a great stay and the place actually exceeded our expectations compared to the photos. The view was phenomenal, the location was perfect, and having a restaurant directly downstairs was very convenient. However, the biggest downside was the experience with some of the staff at the restaurant. While a couple of them were very kind, others were quite rude and unhelpful, especially towards foreigners. The WiFi in the room was extremely poor, so we had to work from the restaurant, but despite there being plenty of space, we were told there was no availability the next day, which was frustrating given the situation. There were also small moments, like being refused water despite it clearly being available, that added to the inconsistency in service. Overall, the stay itself was great, but the staff experience made it feel a bit mixed.

❌ Schlimmste Airbnb-Erfahrung – Finger weg!
Ich reise viel und habe schon in zahlreichen Airbnbs auf der ganzen Welt übernachtet – aber das hier war mit Abstand das Schlechteste. Die Unterkunft war extrem schmutzig, die Möbel alt und abgenutzt, und das Bett war eine Zumutung: Insekten haben mich nachts gebissen, was absolut ekelhaft war.
⸻
❌ Terrible stay – do not book!
The place was dirty, full of old furniture, and there were insects in the bed that bit me at night. My companion felt unsafe, and the location was hard to reach. I left on the first day and booked a hotel. The host ignored my messages, offered no help, and I still had to pay the full price. Worst Airbnb I’ve ever experienced. Avoid!
——
❌ Korkunç bir deneyim – uzak durun!
Ev kirliydi, mobilyalar eskiydi ve yatakta gece beni ısıran böcekler vardı. Konum ulaşması zordu, arkadaşım kendini güvensiz hissetti. İlk gün ayrılıp otele geçtim, ev sahibinden hiçbir yanıt alamadım. Tüm ücreti ödemek zorunda kaldım.

This was the best place we have stayed in Istanbul out of all our visits to the city. The panoramic view from the cafe and room and the central location is amazing, and the hospitality and care of the host Ahmet was great too 😊. Our room was clean and as described. Something to bear in mind is that this boutique hotel is on a steep hill which may be harder to reach on foot for people with young children or elderly visitors. Overall a great experience and will highly recommend ⭐️

We absolutely loved our stay here. The hospitality was so warm and lovely and the view is just incredible. Based on other reviews I was a little bit worried about the hill and the walk to the hotel but it was actually really manageable and a small trade off for the most incredible view of Istanbul. The hotel itself is in a less well-off area but we never felt unsafe and we did come back late on a few occasions. The restaurant downstairs is just gorgeous and we had two spectacular Turkish breakfasts there across our 5 night stay. I would 100% stay here again next time I visit - it was clean, comfortable, and well located amongst several transport options (bus, ferry, and train). Çok teşekkür ederiz ❤️

We had the pleasure of staying at the Calligrapher Room – 2A, and we have to say, Ahmed and the team offered exceptional hospitality from start to finish. He was incredibly responsive, thoughtful, and went out of his way to make us feel welcomed and supported throughout our stay.
The location is outstanding — right in the heart of Fatih with some of the best views in the area. We were just a short walk from the Grand Bazaar, historic mosques, ferry terminals, and a wide variety of restaurants and shops. It’s the perfect spot for anyone looking to fully experience the charm and energy of Old Istanbul.
The room was very clean, the shower was excellent, and we had everything we needed — fresh towels, toiletries, and friendly staff who made us feel right at home. We also enjoyed a beautiful, traditional Turkish breakfast during our first morning, which was served promptly with all the little local touches that made it feel special. Thank you very much Ahmet!

description: Stay in a separate room close to the most interesting attractions. The hotel is located in the very center, a 3-minute walk from Osmanbey metro station. reviews.text: Water doesn't work half the time. Reception's not responsive even after calling 10+ times. Gayet çözüm odaklı ve kibarlardı. Bir daha kalınabilir. Sadece telefon kullanmayı seven veya yatakta vakit geçirmeyi sevenler için yatak kenarlarında priz yoktu. Tek sorun bu olabilir. Yoksa kesinlikle fiyat ve kalite orantılıydı. Konumu da gayet iyiydi.

It was a very comfortable stay at the hotel because the staff were very friendly and helpful. I’ll be back to visit the city in a few months time and l’m going to stay there again.
Thank you.

description: The whole group will be comfortable in this spacious and unique space.

reviews.text:
Strategic location, comfortable unit with everything you need, very nice bathroom and shower, good mattress, nice AC, little fridge and induction stove, black thick curtains, big tv screen, lovely terrace, tea and coffee always available, great desk service, proactive staff and accomodating owner. Only downside was a problematic neighbourhood pretty noisy during nighttime so if you are in need of good night sleep might be helpful to book the rooms in the back that are super quiet. Miller was very accommodating and moved us in the back as soon as was possible. He moved all of our belongings under my request since we were out on a daily trip on an island. When back we found everything in place exactly where we left it just in a different room. Thanks for helping us with check in , since we were lost without data and geolocation he waited for us on the street and thank you with the moving.
Mostly appreciate. We definitely recommend the place!

It is located in very old and smelly point at the historic area of city, spiecialy there is some men that make noise during nights.

Great stay overall! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Communication with the host was smooth and check-in was easy. Would definitely recommend and hope to stay again in the future.

The room was spacious for 2 people. Everything was clean on arrival and in working condition. Everything looked as it did on the pictures, even better in person. Host was very responsive and friendly. The location was at 5-7 minutes walking distance from the nearest tram stop and had lot of facilities near by. Overall, we had a good experience staying here.

description: luxury apartment on the main street 100 meters from the metro Nişantaşı taksim shopping mall walking distance

reviews.text: I had an amazing 6-night stay at Murad’s place in Istanbul! The apartment was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. Murad was an outstanding host—super responsive, helpful, and gave us great local tips to make our stay even better. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Istanbul. Thanks, Murad!

The host is very friendly and always there to help.
I will consider it my fault to have read about the noise in the night from the night club and still having the expectations of sound sleep in the master bedroom. I didnt paid fortune for this booking so I am happy.
location is great and close to Taksim square or easy commute to anywhere in the city.
Had a little trouble with water heater but host took care of it quickly.
Good Value for money.

description: As the Semt İstanbul family, we welcome you, our valued guests, to our comfortable apartment on Karaköy Boğazkesen Caddesi, 150 meters from Galataport and 50 meters from the Tophane Tram. The apartment features 1 bedroom, a spacious living room, an open kitchen, and a bathroom. We offer a pleasant stay in a newly renovated building with an elevator, just a few steps from cafes and restaurants, in the heart of the city, and adjacent to historic areas. We would be happy to host you as the Neighborhood Istanbul family.

reviews.text:
This is a good choice of place since it was located close to Tophane tramvay station, grocery shop, restaurant & coffeehouse. Even taxi was easy to reach to the point.
However, somethings that host need to improve is conditions of iron board, vacuum (for long stay), rust on pipe of sink & proper bedsheet cover (we noticed poor condition cover provided).
It would be good if got air conditioning on bedroom since summer weather is quite warm.
Overall, this choice of stay is worth your penny 👍🏻.

Excellent location, the apartment is exactly like in the pictures, with the caveat that it is still a rental property. Access to the apartment was super fast and easy. Everything was good; the hot water is not from a boiler, which is great. It was a bit cold, but that’s to be expected in Istanbul in winter. Comfortable mattress; perhaps I would add some additional low-level lighting in the living room to create a nicer evening atmosphere.

Thank you Fatih for you for the warm welcome. Great apartment, big, clean. The building has an elevator, very convenient. The apartment itself is located in a great area, very beautiful, near the Galaport

Fatih was an amazing host! Was very helpful and communicative and provided us with whatever we needed! The location is amazing and the flat is just as described! Only thing I would mention is that there are no essentials (which he does mention in the listing) but if we needed anything extra (like blankets etc) we just asked and he was able to provide them! So overall a seamless and a wonderful stay!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely Perfect Stay!
From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded expectations! The apartment was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had every amenity we could possibly need. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the location was ideal — close to everything yet quiet and peaceful. Our host was incredibly kind, responsive, and made sure we felt right at home.
It honestly felt more like a luxury boutique hotel than a BnB. We didn’t want to leave! Highly, highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a flawless stay. 🌟💫
Can’t wait to come back again!

description: My apartment is located at the neighboring street with Istiklal Avenue. It is also at the same street with famous Galatasaray hammam. Our neighborhood (Galatasaray) is a treny place with many nice cafes and restaurants. All the major tourist attractions are accessible within minutes from the apartment. This big place has 4 Bedrooms and 2 Shower and 1 wc which makes it a rare-find amoung Istanbul apartments. Our building is a protected historical monument which has characteristic high ceilings!

reviews.text:
Very responsive host.
One toilet for 4 bedrooms - potentially 8 people and it being in the main bathroom could be tricky for some. We were only 6 people.
It is up 4 flights of stairs but it keeps you fit!
It would be good to have black out blinds - view from the balcony is amazing but those yellow curtains are particularly bright on a sunny morning. I bought an eye shade with me but my husband and kids struggled with the light. Pack an eyeshade.
No hot water on the last morning but the host was very responsive but unfortunately we didn’t manage to reset the boiler.
The apartment was very clean and tidy with magnificent high ceilings and eclectic decor.
The location is fantastic. Host is very quick at responding to any queries / recommendations.

We were a family of 8. Gulsen was super responsive and helpful, from the booking time all the way to the checkout. Her place feels very homie and has a nice living room. It has good beds and the kitchen does the job too. The location is also very close to a lot of famous places. There are only 2 downsides about the place:
1) It has only 1 bathroom (but 2 showers)
2) It is on the 4th floor with no elevator. Overall, her services and communications made it worth the price!

I wanna live here permanently ❤️ Better than a hotel, you can't beat the location. Worth the steps—four floors, no elevator, so it's a workout, but seriously, you'll get used to it. There's plenty to do nearby, and it feels homely. The beds could have been more comfortable, but the host was proactive, telling me about extra cushions I added, which helped a lot. Having a washing machine was also very useful, although there is no dryer; however, the balcony and rack make it manageable. The dishwasher works great. The house is supplied with tea, oil, salt, and sugar, which I loved because it helped too. The view from the balcony is lovely—the sun comes inside and bathes the space. I loved the mixture of old and new in the apartment; it gave it more of a house vibe than an ordinary apartment. I can’t wait to come back again, seriously. The block is perfect—you have so many walkable spots, cool places to visit, but it’s not noisy, so you can sleep peacefully and privately.

Very nice cozy place overall. The biggest problem is climbing 4 floors of steps and it’s very tiring. The apartment has a lot of tripping hazards so when you walk around watch your steps going to the bathroom or kitchen. View is nice from the balcony but balcony needs some cleaning. Water pressure keeps going down so don’t get startled when there is no hot water. Just have to put the pressure up again. Very nice restaurant across the building which is a very nice thing. I love Istanbul and a lot of people are very nice but some are extremely rude and very terrible behaviour. Especially at the Otoparks, watch out, people are very rude.

The apartment was wonderful and was just the place for all 8 of us. The neighborhood was excellent and we walked around every single day. The location is amazing, the living room was just what we needed, all the beds and bedding were excellent, and Gulshen was so responsive with any issues.
As a few other people have mentioned, there is only one toilet (description says "1 WC") which for 8 people could get a little tough, but we made it work. Also, it is a 4th floor walk up with no elevator - be prepared to get your exercise.
Would highly recommend this apartment to any group.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was very friendly and helpful. The location is excellent—very close to Taksim Square and within walking distance to the airport shuttle service, which made getting around super easy. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Ev sahibi kibar ve iletişimde nazikti. Ancak evin temizlik durumu maalesef beklentimizin çok altındaydı. Tuvalet ve duşta kir, kıl ve lekeler vardı; yüzeyler silinmemişti. Mutfak ve banyo dolapları da temiz değildi.
Yatakta kıl vardı ve çarşaflar lekeli görünüyordu, değiştirilmemiş izlenimi veriyordu. Değişim talep ettiğimizde çarşaf verildi ancak eksikti.
Genel olarak hijyen konusunda ciddi eksiklikler vardı. Konum iyi olsa da, yalnız seyahat edenler için çevre biraz tenha olabilir.
The apartment was very unhygienic and clearly not properly cleaned. The area may feel uncomfortable at night, especially for solo travelers and women.

A place completely different from the pictures. There was a bad smell in the room from the toilets and it was unsanitary. The garbage was placed inside the kitchen and smelled strongly. There was no hot water. There was no remote control to operate the air conditioner. I do not recommend this place at all. There are problems with the sewage system and this causes unbearable smells.
He is very helpful and polite and assists me in any possible way. The place was also clean and comfortable.

Bir kaç gün konaklama için Taksim’e bu kadar yakın bir konuma göre fiyatı gerçekten iyi. Fakat odanın temizliği beklediğimiz gibi değildi. Otelin bulunduğu muhit güvenli hissettirdi bize fakat üst katımızda kalan kişiler odaya malum kadınları aldıkları için sabaha kadar bir takım seslerden dolayı uyuyamadık. Ayrıca check-out saatimizden daha geç bir saatte çıkabilmemiz için bize fırsat sağladı.

description:
Stay in the heart of Istanbul: Sultanahmet Guesthouse

Located in the historic Fatih district of Istanbul, our guesthouse in Cankurtaran offers an memorable stay. Within walking distance of landmarks like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern and Topkapi Palace, our guesthouse has 2 bedrooms, a bathroom,that can accommodate up to 4 guests. Enjoy free Wi-Fi,TV,air conditioning and street parking. Experience the rich history and vibrant life of Istanbul with us; your home in Sultanahmet!

reviews.text: Amazing stay in the heart of Istanbul! The location was perfect—within walking distance of major attractions, restaurants, cafes, and public transportation. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in very easy. We felt safe and at home throughout our stay. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would gladly stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul! The location is absolute perfection and just a few minutes on foot to the Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace. It made exploring the historic heart of the city so easy.
Because the apartment is on the ground floor, it is easily accessible and perfect for elderly guests or anyone who has difficulty climbing stairs.
There are also endless amazing restaurants, traditional cafes, and shops right outside your door. The host was wonderful, and the space was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul.

We hada great time in Istanbul. Beker’s apartment was super clean and well located. It made it easy to get to all of the most important landmarks on foot. Communication was good and we were comfortable enough. A thing to keep in mind, though, is that the airbnb itself and the building it is in are older and a bit more humble than the pictures make it look (though the airbnb seems recently renovated). There are also a few quirks in the airbnb that require some attention from the host, but nothing serious. It can be a good option if you are traveling on a tight budget!

Us 3 people stayed in this hotel for 2 days, the apartment is located in the basement which made it very soggy. It was a bit cold and uncomfortable, although air conditioners work in both rooms. There is no vent in the bathroom. In some corners of the room mold is visible. The rooms are small The beds are comfortable and the cloths are clean, the location of the apartment is very convenient, having easy access to restaurants, shops and city center. Berker was very friendly, we had no problem checking in and out. The apartment is in need for renewal. In my opinion, the price is a bit higher than it should be.

The location is great. We can walk to almost all attractions by foot. There are also two restaurants down the street offer great and affordable food as compared to most of the nearby restaurants that are expensive. The place is a little cramped for 4 pax. It will be very comfortable for 3 pax. Berker is a great and responsive host.

description:
The flat is newly renovated completely in January 2025

250 meters ( 5 minute walking ) to Palace of the Porphyrogenitus,
400 meters ( 7 minute walking ) to the seaside.
550 meters to Balat bazaar district ( where iconic tavern of "Agora Meyhanesi 1890" is )

reviews.text: If you need to stay for just few nights it is okay. If you want to stay for a longer period of time this might not be a good fit - filthy couch (Many random stains and hair that we were told are “fine” and no one cleaned them), cracked window (I guess this will get fixed soon after the maintenance staff took measurements), the kitchen equipment is not in a good condition (we had missing kettle, basic things like salt/pepper etc that are mentioned in the listing) and unfortunately the host doesn’t respond to messages fast or very politely and resolution to problems takes several days. No one really speaks other language than Turkish so take that also into consideration. But for this price I think the bathroom and bedroom were really nice. For shorter stays this place can be nice.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment with our family. The host was very kind, friendly, and always quick to respond whenever we needed help. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and located in a great area with easy access to public transport, shops, and restaurants. We really felt at home during our stay.
The only small suggestion would be to add a microwave, as it would make it even more convenient for families with children.
Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you for your warm hospitality!

Excellent location and an amazing host. The apartment was cozy, comfortable, and perfect for our stay. It’s very close to Sultanahmet and all major areas. It is adjacent to Balat, which is such a lovely neighbourhood to explore with great cafes and beautiful streets for walks and lots of restaurants. Public transport was easy to access, making it convenient to get around Istanbul.
The host was extremely responsive and accommodating throughout our stay. One thing we really appreciated was how well-equipped the apartment was — it had all the necessary amenities already provided, which was a very thoughtful touch and honestly more than we expected.
Overall, a 10/10 experience. Would definitely recommend staying here and would happily return again.
Please note that there are a lot of steps and a steep climb when trying to reach the apartment. You can take a taxi to get there but google maps doesn't work reliably. Lots of small shops for grocery nearby.
the host was great and very helpful . the apartment was very clean and new , the location was in historic area. it was peaceful and quite area.

Ev mükemmel kesinlikle ev konusunda asla sıkıntı çekmiceksiniz ev sahibi de gayet duyarlı herhangi bi sorun olduğunda direkt yardımcı oluyor evin temizliği olsun eşyalar olsun 10/10 gayet geçerli tamamen kendi evinizdeymişsiniz gibi bir hissiyat veriyor tek sıkıntısı evin konumu eğer bu evi tercih edicekseniz yokuşlara hazırlıklı olmalısınız

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 52 m2 apartment, all-equipped, inside a secured residence. High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

reviews.text:
«آپارتمان بسیار عالی و دلنشینی بود و ما واقعاً از اقامت خود لذت بردیم. آن‌قدر راضی بودیم که ۵ روز دیگر هم مجدداً رزرو کردیم. همچنین پارک بسیار زیبا و خوبی در نزدیکی آپارتمان قرار دارد که اقامت را لذت‌بخش‌تر می‌کند.
“The apartment was wonderful and very comfortable. We truly enjoyed our stay and even extended our booking for another 5 days. There is also a beautiful park nearby, which makes the experience even more enjoyable.”

Easy access with 24hr security at front gate. It has a lot of shops, restaurants, bus stop, mosque all in walking distance.
If you’re someone who likes quiet then the only downside for you is the school near the building except for that. It’s a really good place worth the money.
Easy communication with a host, its worth the price . In the backyard there is lots of kittens and 🐈 cats😍 we definitely would stay here again.
Good host, will stay again.
Location is further away from Istanbul

description: Welcome to the City Center, a 2-min walk to Osmanbey Metro (1 stop to Taksim). Enjoy 24/7 camera security and elevator access. Your bedroom features a Double-size sofa bed and a Double-size bed, both with AC. A dining table with 4 chairs complements your private kitchen, equipped with all essentials. The bathroom includes a washing machine. Indulge in entertainment with Netflix and Youtube on the TV, connected via the Mi TV stick. Experience comfort and convenience in this centrally located flat

reviews.text: Daire gerçekten harikaydı! Temiz, ferah ve fotoğraflardakinden bile daha güzeldi. Konumu çok uygundu, her yere kolayca ulaşabildim. Evde ihtiyacım olabilecek her şey düşünülmüştü. Ev sahibi de son derece ilgili ve misafirperverdi. Kesinlikle tekrar konaklamak isterim, herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ediyorum! 🌿✨

Artılar ve öneriler olarak iki başlıkla yazmak faydalı olabilir.
Artılar:
Giriş çıkış çok kolay.
Konum arabasız metro ve otobüslere 1-2 dakika arabalı olanlar icinde etrafta otopark fazlasıyla var ama merkezi bir konumda olması trafikte olmasına sebep ama çok değil.
İşletme sahibi çok hızlı cevaplıyor.
Tarih değişikliği yaptım ve çok kısa sürede çözüm sağladı.
İnternet sorunsuz çalışıyor hızı gayet iyi. Temiz havlular ve banyodaki suyun sıcaklığı gayet iyi.

Binanın girişinde güzel bir hamburgerci var. Binaya girince kokusundan karnınız acıkıyor ama koku tabii ki fazla. :)
Eşyalar belki yavaş yavaş yenilenirse iyi olabilir. Zamaı gelmeye başlamış gibi ama fiyat performans durumunu etkileyebiliyor.
Bir de insanlar yoldan gelince belki su almayı unutabilir bir iki küçük su bırakabilinir.
Kısa süre ve konu için bölge olarak iyi tercihlerden birisi.

Harika bir konumda, metroya yakın olması büyük avantaj. Daire fotoğraflardaki gibi temiz, rahat ve şık dekore edilmiş. İletişim de çok kolaydı, her şey sorunsuz geçti. Kesinlikle tekrar tercih ederim 🙏🏻

Great location right next to the Metro line which could get you anywhere. Plenty of food and drink options around the neighborhood. The internet was quite strong.
We would only recommend to change pillows or add extra ones. Also, the AC filters are quite stuffed and need cleaning. After a few minutes the entire room smells of cigarettes.

close to Osmanbey Metro. road is a bit steep and uphill.. a bit difficult with heavy luggage. had shops nearby. Helpful host - we did not know how to convert the sofa into a bed and host came to help make it. TQ

description:
Fully renovated private studio in hotel area of Taksim square. Taksim is one of the two centres of Istanbul.
Apartment is on the second floor without elevator.
This studio is in a relatively quite area next to Taksim square and walking distance to Istiklal street.
- Metro and airport shuttle stations are within 5-min distance.
- Unlimited stably working Wifi enables homeworking
- Washing machine and dryer are to share with other studios on the same floor.

reviews.text:
Great location with easy access to transit and walkable to a lot of lively areas. The amount of space was great for the price and very clean, and communication with Özgür was very smooth. I also appreciated the consistent hot water and small kitchen amenities.
A few small things that didn't bother me but might be more important to others: the windows directly face another building so natural light is limited, and smoking seems to be allowed in the studios on the floor so you may smell smoke from the other rooms (though smoking is very common throughout Istanbul so perhaps this is to be expected).
Overall would definitely recommend this place as an affordable option for solo travelers!

The studio itself ( more like a big room ) was cosy and nicely designed. Very clean and practical with a small kitchen and ensuite bathroom.
The only drawback is the fact that the studio is located inside what used to be 1 bigger apartment which was divided into smaller studios. As a result on can hear lots of noises from the neighbours who share the same corridor. Otherwise the host was helpful and provided all the clear instructions for an easy check-in/out process.
A fantastic place to stay in Taksim, easy walk to the metro and all the restaurants. The studio is beautiful, just like the photos. Very clean and everything you need. I loved the little kitchen.

I really enjoyed staying at this accommodation. Process was easy and smooth. Özgür was very friendly and welcoming. The place was very nice, clean, and cozy, and I had everything I needed during my stay. I also really appreciated how clean the bathroom was. Another big plus is the location, as it’s very close to Taksim Square, which was very convenient. I had a great experience staying here and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and pleasant stay at a good price.😊

An excellent value. The accommodation is rather small--which shouldn't be a surprise, given the very reasonable price--but it is very intelligently put together. The windows are all double-glass, which helps keep street noise to a minimum. The apartment is a five-minute walk from Taksim Square, which was very convenient for me. Ozgur is an excellent host, who responded quickly to any questions I had. I stayed for a month, and would do so again.

description: Our facility is a 4-minute walk from Galata Tower, with a small kitchen in each room and a terrace where you can spend your free time with your guests, and a reception that is always open even during curfews. We have a transfer service (VIP vehicle to/from the airport to the facility. A small kitchen, minibar and sitting or working area, TV, air conditioning in each room. Turkish Bath and Parking area.

reviews.text: Muhammed was a truly amazing host. He was friendly, professional, and welcoming! The property is in a great location, only a few minutes walk from Galata Tower. The Airbnb is exactly as described. It was cosy, and we felt right at home. On top of that, there is a café right below the Airbnb with great drinks and food, which made breakfast very easy. The building itself is safe and secure. And the neighborhood was nice too. Furthermore, Muhammed was flexible and easy going with both check-in and check-out. We had a fantastic experience with Muhammed as our host, and his property as our Airbnb. I highly reccomend choosing this Airbnb to anyone visiting Istanbul, you will be happy with your selection. We couldn't have asked for a better first experience in Istanbul. Thank you again Muhammed!
fiyatına göre gayet güzeldi o da temizdi konum olarak güzel yerde muhammed beyde gayet ilgiliydi bu fiyata kalabilceğiniz en iyi yer.
Location is so great. You can walk to everything. The kebab place called Hazerfen is downstairs is very good! We had a really good time there. The host is very nice as well!

ilandaki resimler teras kata ait verdiği oda 3.
