description: Robert Han, built in Galata, the commercial and financial center of the 19th century, is one of the finest examples of Ottoman architecture influenced by Neoclassical and Art Nouveau styles. Reflecting the Ottoman Empire's engagement with Western architectural movements, the building embodies the era’s transition towards European-inspired designs while maintaining its unique local identity.

reviews.text: We had a truly lovely 6 days in Taygun's appt. It is a real gem - lovely old Ottoman tiles, brickwork and wooden floors compliment a very clean, comfortable and airy living space that is ideal for 4 people. It is unusually light for Istanbul appts, with the 3-sided windows in the living room giving it a very open, warm, cityscape feel. Good aircon, very comfortable beds and a great shower finish it off - and being near Galata Tower means its super accessible for ferries to the Asian side, to the old town and Taksim etc; it's easy to avoid the very touristy feel nearby, just don't walk down the main street from Taksim to Galata which gets very crowded. Overall, very highly recommended in every way

Taygun & Tolgay were fantastic hosts! All queries were answered immediately.
The apt was in a great location..Walking to all amenities. It was accurate to it's photos. Clean, roomy & comfortable.
I highly recommend this booking and will definitely revisit when next in Istanbul!

Best place to stay in Istanbul. So close to everything you want to see. Really cool apartment, clean just like the photos.
Easy check in details… very responsive owners and helpful. Excellent value for money… book it now!

The apartment is beautiful, spacious, well equipped and enjoys a great location. Communications between us and the hosts were excellent. However unfortunately we did encounter a few problems.
The main issue being the shower which really was not to the quality and standard expected of this type of fairly expensive accommodation . It also flooded at one point due to a blocked drain although this was dealt with by the host quickly.
In addition maintenance work and repainting of the hallway and staircase was ongoing during our stay and we were not advised or made aware of this. Unfortunately my son put his hand on the stair handrail which was still wet with oil based black paint which was difficult to remove. There wasn’t anyone painting at the time and no sign was put in place warning of the wet surface.

My friends and I had a lovely stay at Taygun and Tolgay brother's apartment. It was just as in the photos and they made the check in very easy, with clear instructions etc. The place was super clean and the apartment is in a great location. I would stay here again for sure!

description:
This elegant apartment is located in a flat and easily accessible area, just a 5-minute walk from Taksim Metro Station. Located in the heart of Cihangir, the house is just a few steps away from popular cafes, restaurants and supermarkets.
🔸 Kitchenette and basic cooking utensils.
🔸 Wi-Fi, TV, Netflix
🔸 Air conditioning and heating system
🔸 A quiet and peaceful environment offers a relaxing atmosphere despite being in the city center.
🔸Clean towels

reviews.text: The apartment is just like in the pictures – small but compact and exactly as described. The neighborhood is great, with plenty of nice cafés and restaurants nearby. Be prepared for quite a few stairs and level changes to get there, but it’s worth it for the lovely area.

First of all, I was very well received by Ali. He was friendly and helpful, and he also allowed me to check out late on the last day of my booking, which I really appreciated.
Unfortunately, the house was not what I expected. It needs some serious maintenance, the Wi-Fi is not strong enough, and overall it does not offer the level of comfort I would expect for the price, especially compared to other properties I have stayed in in the area in the past.
On the positive side, the location is great, and the bedroom is quiet and away from noise, which made it good for sleeping.

Konum harikaydı ve ulaşım çok kolaydı, adresi rahatlıkla bulduk, erken check in konusunda sorun yaşamadık ve eve çok kolaylıkla giriş yapabildik. Ev temiz ve düzenliydi, ilanda anlatılan herşey mevcuttu, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi Gizem hanım ve Ali bey her konuda çok yardımcı oldular, iletişim konusunda hiç sorun yaşamadık. Çok kibar ve samimi insanlardı. Kendilerine çok teşekkür ederiz. Bir sonraki seyahatimizde yine tercih edebileceğimiz bir mekan.

Had a great stay in Cihangir. The apartment was very central in the area. For the most part we were able to access everything we wanted to by foot or transit. Would stay here again just for the location!
During our stay, the AC broke and spewed out a bunch of ice onto the bed. It wasn’t a huge deal but did cause the bedroom to be quite hot for the second half of our stay. Luckily there’s another AC unit in the living area so we were able to cool down in there before going to sleep. In addition to the AC, there’s an interesting hole in the bathroom wall but we were able to look past that.
The unit is definitely quaint but we were out and about for majority of the time anyway. The bedroom is away from the busy streets so we got a good night’s rest.
There was a very friendly kitty that would come to our window each morning! Gizem and Ali were friendly and responsive hosts. I’m only docking a star for the AC situation as it was pretty hot during our trip.

The location of this Airbnb is wonderful as it is close to many cafes and restaurants. It is very easy to walk to different areas of Istanbul as the location is very central. A few things to keep in mind: there is no elevator in the building, there is no fridge in the apartment, and the AC did not work. Other than these issues, we had a lovely stay and the hosts were very responsive and nice!

description: Our deluxe apartment is located near Taksim Square. It is close to almost every place you need to visit, such as the historical Galata Tower, Istiklal Avenue and the famous Taksim Square. The region is one of the most popular places in Istanbul. The apartment is very luxurious and decorated for all your needs. The apartment has a bedroom, a living room and a balcony. It is only a few steps away from Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Square and the metro station. Also, it is one minute away from all public transportation.

reviews.text: A tiny studio with a fairly large balcony right in the center, just a 5-minute walk to Taksim Square, the metro, and the bus stop. There are plenty of shops and cafes nearby. The host is always in touch. Cons: the bathroom mirror is hung in a really awkward spot (it would be difficult for a woman to style her hair or put on makeup, and there are no other mirrors in the apartment), there's no shelf in the shower, no lid for the frying pan, no shelves in the fridge, and a huge block of ice in the freezer. Also, there is no dish soap, no paper towels, no cooking oil, no laundry detergent, and only 1 roll of toilet paper. For stays longer than a week, these items should be provided to make the stay more comfortable. It would also be a good idea to leave a broom, a mop, and a cleaning cloth in the apartment so the guest can keep the place tidy themselves. Pros: there is a hairdryer, an iron, as well as dishes (although the dishware really needs to be updated). Overal it was fine! Thank you

The place is on a good location, close to Taksim square, and surrounded by local cafes, restaurants and lot of chonky cats on the streets.
If you are by walk and have suitcases, prepare yourself for walking on a stiff and on the narrow stairs to the 3rd (4th for Asian) floor.
Big soft bed, washing machine is working properly (but all the displayed program text is in Turkish), small fridge, AC and heating are available for your comfort.
Free WiFi is there, TV you can watch Netflix.
For this price it is a good deal.

Ev fotoğraflarla uyumluydu ve genel olarak iyi donanımlıydı bir iki kişiydik ve iki haftalığına kaldık, ancak bazı önemli eksikler vardı. Temizlik yeterli değildi (yastıklar sararmıştı, yatak tam temiz değildi, çekmecelerde toz kıl vardı) ve bazı parçalar sabit değildi veya arızalıydı (rezervuar, tuvalet aksesuarları).
Ayrıca giriş ve çıkış çok zordu. Daire üçüncü katta ve merdivenler çok dar. İki kişi olmamıza rağmen tek bir valizi indirip çıkarmakta bile çok zorlandık. Yaşlılar veya valizlerini tek başına taşıyamayan kişiler için uygun değil. Ev sahibinin söz verdiği yardım da gelmedi.

To be fair, Simar was friendly and responsive. But the Airbnb was very dirty… stains, bugs everywhere, the shower was rusted, parts of the Airbnb were unfinished or needed maintenance. The smell (likely from the area) and surrounding area (I suppose not the actual Airbnb) was pretty bad. Once again, not criticizing the host he was nice, but the actual Airbnb was very unclean and just not a comfortable space as a result. I would be careful, as I checked out early. Thankfully Airbnb took care of me because he refused to refund.

The stay was amazing regardless of my bad luck as hundreds of people too had the same luck. The host knows lol. Over all the apartment is clean and near buses and metro station. Convenient to go around Istanbul. Samir was always around when needed. He is helpful host and great guy.

description: Welcome to our spacious 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of Şişli! With 3 bathrooms, a large living room, 3 air conditioners, and 2 TVs, it offers comfort and convenience. Located just a 5-minute walk from Cevahir Mall, metro, and bus stations, and within walking distance to Nişantaşı, you’ll be in the center of everything. Perfect for families and groups looking for a modern, well-equipped stay in Istanbul!

reviews.text:
We had a really nice stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was amazing, close to so many places, with shops, food, and attractions nearby, which made everything really convenient.
I also want to give a special mention to Hani, who is part of the program. He helped us a lot during our stay and was very humble, kind, and down to earth. His support really made a difference and made us feel welcome. Overall, it was a great experience, and we would definitely recommend staying here.
It was really clean and the location is convenient as there are many restaurants and stores nearby . The host communicates very well
Ev temiz, yataklar rahat herşey çok güzeldi
Fatih took a lot of effort to send me measurements in advance in order to make sure my wheelchair would fit. He was very helpful from the get go and also during the stay. Super experience!!

Unser Aufenthalt war insgesamt gut. Die Umgebung hat uns sehr gefallen und auch das Personal war freundlich und hilfsbereit. Leider haben ein paar Kleinigkeiten gefehlt, wie zum Beispiel Toilettenpapier, ein Besen und eine Waschmaschine. Abgesehen davon war aber alles in Ordnung und wir waren im Großen und Ganzen zufrieden.

description:
When you make a reservation, the entire
building will be exclusively yours. There will be no other guests staying in the building!

This historic building is located just 1-minute walk from Galata Tower, on the safest street and also within walking distance to Galataport, Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Square Golden Horn and Cihangir.

Recently restored by a renowned architect, our building features 4 sepetate private rooms, allowing you to stay alltogether while enjoying your own personal space.

reviews.text: Burks was a very responsive host, making sure I had everything I needed prior to me even arriving to the Airbnb. He also had complimentary drinks, tea, soap, towels and wash cloths. The Airbnb was even better than described being about 6 floors from the basement kitchen to the master bedroom with its own balcony on the top floor. There were 4 bedrooms total and each room had a fridge, stove top and bathroom/ shower. Only thing is the top floor room did not have a stove top but the balcony made it worth it plus who cooks on vacation anyway lol. The Airbnb was walking distance from several bars, clubs, restaurants and Galata tower. There is a parking garage a five minute walk from the Airbnb as well. Definitely would stay here again the next time I’m in İstanbul

we had the pleasure of booking the entire 4 floors. Burak had already advised us that there is no elevator in the house, however this turned out to be beneficial in helping us meet our daily targets for the steps😊. the house is amazing. all amenities as described in the advert. neat and tidy. ensuites on every level which is very handy for large families. close to everything, restaurants shops, istiklal street,metro station, tram station.
the hosts are very responsive and made us feel at home. The basement kitchen is a great cosy place to enjoy a cuppa after walking and exploring the streets of Istanbul.
will definitely stay here again.
Thank you Burak and Asli.

I’m truly happy that coincidence led me to this wonderful place. The location is perfect, very close to Galata Tower and the end of Istiklal Street, only about a 3minute walk.
Although the house is in a small alley, taxis and drivers can easily reach the door when the correct location is shared 👍
The house itself is beautiful and unique. The layout is very well designed: a living area and kitchen on the ground floor, and rooms on the upper floors. Each floor has a studio-style bedroom with a small kitchen (microwave, oven, and fridge) and a private bathroom. All rooms have windows, and the top-floor room has an amazing balcony 🤩
Everything is clean, well-organized, and tastefully decorated. The furniture is new, and all essentials are provided.
I highly recommend this place. Burak & Asli are wonderful hosts — very kind, responsive, and helpful.
My family and I truly enjoyed our stay, and we will definitely choose this place again on our next visit to Istanbul.
Thank you so much

We had a wonderful stay at this centrally located home in the heart of Istanbul’s historic district ❤️
We rented the entire house, which consists of four self-contained rooms in addition to a basement with full kitchen
The place is perfect for a group or family traveling together.
Each space was very clean, modern, and well-equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The location made it easy to explore the city’s main attractions on foot, and the host was extremely responsive and helpful throughout our visit.
Highly recommend

Great place in a great location - fun walkable neighborhood with restaurants and sights, and easy to get to other neighborhoods too. Vertical setup with one bedroom / bathroom / kitchen on each floor. Everything was spotless and as described. Host was exceptional - proactively offered to arrange our airport transfer for a large family at 4:30am, and very quick to respond. Also generously let us in a bit early and let us leave bags after check out. Would definitely recommend and stay here again. Thank you Burak!

description: Prime Istanbul location! Stunning Bosphorus Bridge & Maiden's Tower views from this cozy flat. Just steps to Galata Tower & Dolmabahçe Palace. Enjoy sunrise coffees on your balcony, easy access to top sights. Fully equipped, stylish & central - your perfect Istanbul base!

reviews.text: Kısa ve orta dönem konaklamalar için ideal bir yer, fiyatın karşılığını veriyor. Temizlik ideal, konum harika, manzara için söylenebilecek tek şey mükemmel. Ev sahibinin iletişimi olağanüstü.

Yüksel bey e herhangi bir sorum olduğunda çok kolay ulaştım hemen dönüş yaptı ev fotoğraflardaki gibiydi ve temizdi manzarası çok hoştu çıkışta valimizi bir iki saatliğine güvenle emanet bırakabildim merdivenleri çıkmak biraz zor ama o manzara için merdivenler değer. Gün doğumu gün batımı izlemesi aşırı keyifliydi

Ev sahibi gerçekten çok ilgili ve yardımseverdi. Akşam saatlerinde son dakika rezervasyon yapmama rağmen hiçbir sorun yaşamadan, hızlı ve ilgili bir şekilde yardımcı oldu. Ev temiz, konforlu ve ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her şey düşünülmüştü İletişim konusunda da oldukça memnun kaldım Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim tekrar konaklamak isterim. 🙏

One the best views of the Bosphorus , you won’t find a better view from any airbnb, only issue is it’s accessible by some stairs , if you could manage it, then it’s probably one of the best airbnb in Istanbul , all amenities inside this studio , bed is also very comfortable , maybe if they add blackout curtains world be nice for good sleep in early morning

We had a wonderful stay! The owners were incredibly accommodating and responsive, making everything easy from check-in to check-out. The place was spotless, modern, and very well maintained, with a beautiful view that really made the stay special. We felt comfortable the entire time and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!

description:
Located on Pavlonya Street, one of Kadikoy’s most vibrant and central areas, this spacious and stylish 3BR apartment welcomes up to 6 guests.

**IMPORTANT: The apartment is on the 4th floor, accessible by stairs. Our staff will carry your luggage.**

Featuring warm lighting, exposed brick walls, and a cozy living space, it's ideal for families or groups. Just steps from local cafes, boutiques, bars, and transit, it offers the perfect blend of comfort, design, and unbeatable location on Kadikoy

reviews.text: Cute and clean place right in the heart of Kadikoy. Everything is right out the front door. Comfortable beds and well stocked kitchen. If you’re looking for a fun location for nightlife, restaurants and bars right out the door, this is your place. If you’re looking to go to sleep before 1am, you will need ear plugs in the back bedroom as there is a bar right below the window. If you have a lot of luggage keep in mind there is no elevator and it’s 4 floors up. Awesome communication from the hosts!!

Konum olarak gerçekten çok avantajlı bir yerde konakladım. İstanbul’da ulaşım her zaman önemli olduğu için bu evin merkezi konumu benim için büyük rahatlık sağladı. Ev hem temizdi hem de fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha genişti. Ferah bir ortamda kalmak, özellikle uzun günlerin ardından dinlenmek için gerçekten çok iyi geldi.
Ayrıca evin büyüklüğüne ve sağladığı konfora göre fiyatı oldukça makul. Bu nedenle bütçe–konfor dengesi açısından beklentilerimin üstüne çıktı. İstanbul’a sık sık geliyorum ve gönül rahatlığıyla söyleyebilirim ki bundan sonra ilk tercihlerim arasında olacak. Ev sahibi de iletişim konusunda çok yardımcıydı. Her şey için teşekkür ederim, tekrar konaklamayı sabırsızlıkla bekliyorum.

We had a wonderful stay here with my family. The apartment was very nice, clean, and comfortable. The location is excellent—everything you need is just a short walk away. There are plenty of restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, and shops nearby, and the ferry terminal is only about a 7–10 minute walk, making it very convenient to get around. The area is lively and has a great atmosphere.
The host was very helpful throughout our stay. Even though I didn’t meet the host in person, they kept checking in with us through messages and were always ready to help with any questions. We were welcomed by the co-host, who met us on arrival and handed over the keys.
The only thing to note is that there are pubs directly below the apartment, so you can hear some noise late into the night, especially on weekends when it stays busy a little longer. It wasn’t a major issue for us, but it’s something future guests should know.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend this place

My family (5 pp) stayed a week at Miran’s and had a wonderful time. I’ve stayed in 4 Airbnbs in Istanbul—this was the best. If you want downtown Kadikoy, this is your top choice. It truly feels like home.
Hosts: Miran and his wife Irem were excellent—responsive, welcoming, and proactive. Their staff helped us carry our suitcases to our 3rd floor flat on checkin day.
Location: Excellent, 5 min walk to the ferry, 2 blocks to the market/supermarket, and a pleasant stroll to Moda beach.
Apartment: Newly remodeled with quality furniture/appliances; pride of ownership shows in every detail. Comfortable beds, spacious living area, open kitchen/dining, great for family time. AC worked well. Super well-equipped and perfect for long stays.
Internet: fast and stable perfect for remote work.
Only minor downside: Some weekend bar noise, but that is common anywhere central Kadikoy. Overall, my favorite place in my month in Istanbul. I would recommend it to anyone!

This was our first stay in Kadıköy, and it was a wonderful experience.
Our host was incredibly responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout our stay. We arrived late and chose the self check-in option, and the instructions were clear, accurate, and made the process very straightforward. The flat was also easy to find.
The flat truly felt like a home away from home, with everything we could possibly need. Our family felt comfortable, relaxed, and settled from the moment we arrived.
I noticed that some previous guests had mentioned noise from the surrounding area, but this didn’t affect our stay at all. Coming from England, we actually enjoyed the lively social atmosphere—it created a vibrant yet relaxed vibe that really added to the experience.
The location is excellent, just a short walk from the ferry ports and right in the heart of the local markets, making it easy to explore the area.
Overall, we were extremely pleased with our stay and would happily book here again in the futu

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: Very easy communication and flexible Check-in. Great area and super clean very cozy room. Would stay without hesitation again.

Kübranur hanım son derece ilgili biri, odadan çok memnun kaldık. Çok kullanışlı ve mutfakta bulaşık makinesi, ocak ve mikrodalganın olması büyük avantajdı. Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi ve konum harika çok teşekkür ederiz.
Konumu, temizliği, konforu ile kusursuz bir konaklama geçirdik. Tekrar kalmak isterim ve herkese şiddetle tavsiye ederim .

Konaklamamız çok güzeldi. Evin yeri, konumu ve boğaz manzarası inanılmazdı. Ayrıca çok temizdi. 3 kişi konaklayacağımız için onu da düşünerek hazırlanmıştı. Kübranur hanım her konuda yardımcı oldu. İletişim konusunda hiç sorun yaşamadık çok sıcakkanlı yaklaştı. İstanbul’a her gidişimde tereddüt etmeden konaklayacağım bir yer buldum. Her şey için teşekkürler.
We had a very nice stay at the appartment. Everything looked just like in the pictures. Very nice and friendly stuff plus are where is located couldn’t be better for our stay:)

description:
Prime location: Just 100 meters from Ortaköy seaside, with cafes, restaurants
• Your private space: Enjoy the privacy of your own room with a personal key, just like a boutique hotel experience.
• Modern amenities: Air conditioning, smart TV, mini fridge, fresh towels, and shampoo – everything comfortable stay.
• Easy access: Perfect spot to explore Istanbul with public transportation, taxis, and Bosphorus tours nearby.

It’s the ideal place to experience Istanbul while feeling right at home.

reviews.text: Ev oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi. Konumu güzel, ulaşım kolaydı. Ev sahibi çok misafirperverdi, her sorumuza hızlıca yanıt verdi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz

I had such a lovely stay at İbrahim’s place 🏡✨
He was super helpful and kind throughout my visit 🙌😊
The apartment is cozy, clean, and really feels like home ❤️
The location is great too; just a nice 20–25 min walk from Beşiktaş pier 🚶‍♀️🌆
It’s a beautiful walk with lots to see along the way! The neighborhood is full of local food spots 🍽️, markets 🛒, and everything you might need nearby.
So convenient and fun to explore! 🗺️💫
Highly recommend staying here if you want a homely vibe in a cool part of Istanbul!
Görüşürüz🇹🇷

Having visited Istanbul many times and stayed in different places, I really enjoyed the location of the place. Central location, bit noisy sometimes(but did not cause any problem to me) and safe neighborhood. Check-in was very easy and Ibrahim was always responsive. Apartment was very clean and cozy.

İlk dakikadan itibaren samimi bir iletişimle ve hızlı dönüşle çok güzel bir hizmet aldık, konumu çok iyi ve oda görselde gördüğünüz gibi, geniş, ferah , temiz ve huzurlu bir yer. İlgilenenlerin bilgisine sunarım.
Temiz ve uygun fiyatlı. Kısa konaklamalar için ideal.

description:
Your perfect base for your stay in Istanbul - Bright, clean, modern, comfortable and stylish fully furnished studio apartment with AC.

Perfectly located just a few seconds walk from the famous Istiklal Street. Only a few minutes to Taksim Square, and other famous tourist attractions.

The apartment has a kitchen and washing facilities, as well as a work desk and lounge area. Smart TV with Netflix, Youtube, etc.

reviews.text:
Ali was a fantastic host, always responsive, friendly, and it was lovely meeting him at check-in.
The place itself is right at the heart of the vibe near Taksim and Galata Tower, so if you want something quiet, it’s not for you. If you want to live in the midst of the bustle and energy, it’s an exceptional spot. It’s also off the main Istiklal road so you have a bit more of a local vibe, with a great cafe right around the corner, lots of great eating and drinking spots within a couple of mins of walk, and plenty to shop right on the high street. There’s also a little supermarket right next door.
The apartment itself is perfect – it feels larger than you’d first think. The shower and bed are fabulous. And all the amenities it has work great and are a wonderful facet, especially for the price.
The Internet runs smoothly and quickly, which makes it a great spot for a solo digital nomad / digital nomad couple to spend a week or two.
Thank you, Ali, for this perfect place!

Ali was an incredible host throughout my stay. He was friendly, responsive, and always willing to help, making everything smooth and comfortable from check-in to check-out. I really enjoyed my stay in Istanbul—the accommodation was clean, well-located, and exactly as described. I would definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to come back on my next visit!

Ali's place was true to the pictures, the studio is in the heart of Istiklal area, the space felt cozy and everything was good. Ali was very helpful with the check-in. There is everything one needs in the neighborhood and the apartment.
Amazing place, neat and clean, accessible to all the know places. Restaurants bars are nearby.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. Walking distance to historical areas

reviews.text: The host was super communicative and responded quickly! The location was perfect, very easy walk to the sights in old town. Lots of restaurants and shopping nearby, and a market across the street! Apartment had ac and was exactly as pictured.

Excellent cozy place at the heart of Istanbul. Less than 10 min walk to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia and close to transit line. The other beautiful part is the closeness to shore where you can enjoy morning and evening walks. The place was great for our group of 4. The kitchen is well equipped. The place was very clean. I would highly recommend it.
Good value for money. Location is perfect close to the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Place was clean and spacious.
Everything was amazing as described and host fulfilled all our requests. Thanks for the great stay.

Yunus sangat responsif berkomunikasi via online. Ia menawarkan untuk atur antar jemput bandara untuk menghindari penipuan, dengan biaya yg umum dan rasional. Perlu sabar menunggu penjemputan di bandara, karena kendaraan tidak langsung siap.
Lokasi apartment berada di jalan yang ramai dengan restaurant dan toko, agak sempit untuk dilalui 2 kendaraan, sehingga agak tersendat menuju lokasi. Dapat berjalan kaki 5 menit ke Hagia Sophia, mesjid biru, istana Topkapi, dan dermaga.
Arahan untuk check in sangat mudah. perlu mengantisipasi tangga yg agak sempit, tanpa lift untuk ke unit di lantai 2. Unit sangat bersih dan lengkap, wifi juga cepat.
Kami menginap 3 hari 2 malam dengan nyaman. Pada hari terakhir, tidak ada air sama sekali karena ada gangguan suplai dari perusahaan air, padahal kami perlu bersiap ke bandara, sehingga harus membeli air botolan untuk mandi. Perlu antisipasi kendaraan jemputan terlambat 45 menit dari waktu yang diharapkan, sehingga sangat sempit waktu ke bandara.

description:
Experience authentic Istanbul life in this spacious 3-level home, just minutes from the Bosphorus and Galataport.

Enjoy a private terrace, balcony, in-house bar, and a relaxing sauna. With 3 bathrooms and a dedicated play area for kids, the space is ideal for both families and groups. Stay right in the heart of the city, close to historic landmarks, lively streets, and local culture.

If you’d like a private airport transfer, feel free to reach out.

reviews.text: Our host was very helpful. The place was huge, but is really three separate apartments. Very clean, but not decorated like in the photos.

Great location, yet very private and quiet street. Plenty of space and it has a beautiful rooftop terrace. It was a great choice for us. Be mindful of the spiral staircase, as for older people it could be a challenge. The host and his team very responsive and friendly.

Kenan's Airbnb location is unbeatable. While most main attractions are across the Galata Bridge, the Beyoglu neighborhood is full of shops, restaurants, bars, and is extremely walkable. The rooftop terrace offers great views and we enjoyed using it when the weather was nice. Hosts are extremely communicative and helpful. I'd happily stay my next time in Istanbul and would recommend this Airbnb to others.
Very comfortable place the host helpfully
This place perfect for multiple people and very spacious. Great location and also very clean. I highly recommend!

description:
Listing is 2 separate apartments on the same building same floor.
One apartment has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
Second apartment has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom.
Located next to the Tram station Aksaray.
Building has an elevator

reviews.text:
İstanbul never sleeps, but we did! This is in a great area for transport lines to get around the city. The traffic (honking) can be noisy at night, so pack earplugs if you're a light sleeper.
Beds were comfortable with nice linens, plenty of space for luggage, everything was clean. A/C worked in ever room.
Small kitchen, as shown in photos, with very basic needs.
Highly recommended for larger groups, as we had plenty of private bedrooms along with the living rooms.
Finding the entrance the first time through a shop was the only concern, even with the provided instructions.

The host is highly responsive, and the apartment itself is a really nice place to live in, though there are a few issues to note. The AC units need maintenance as they are quite noisy, leak water, and the remote controls make it very hard to actually control the temperature. Additionally, the bathroom quality isn't up to the high standard of the rest of the apartment. When arriving, be aware that the building's main entrance is almost entirely blocked by clothes stands, so you have to be careful when walking in, and the elevator is extremely small, fitting a maximum of two people at a time. Overall, it is a pleasant space, but a few updates and repairs would make it much better.

We enjoyed our stay at Home in Fatih. The property is perfect for small groups looking to spend quality time together. The venue is beautiful, well-furnished, and equipped with many amenities that made our stay comfortable and enjoyable.
The location is excellent and very central, with easy access to the metro and other forms of public transportation. We also loved experiencing the local nightlife and the vibrant atmosphere of the neighborhood.
We recommend this host. He was respectful, responsive, and always willing to help with anything we needed throughout our stay. Overall, it was a great experience, and we would gladly stay here again.

Grup konaklamaları için gayet uygun bir ev, ev fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi, temizdi, evde normal bir evdeki gibi her imkan var, konum olarak toplu ulaşıma çok yakın, oda sayısının ve banyo-tuvalet sayısının çokluğu da grubumuz açısından önemli hususlardı.
Bina eski ama konumu ve dairenin içi gayet güzel fiyat performans açısından tercih edilesi bir daire ayrıca temizlik gayet yeterli

description: Discover convenience in this modern, centrally-located studio apartment. Perfect for two guests, this bright space features two twin beds, a well-equipped kitchenette, and an in-unit washing machine. Its prime location makes it an ideal base for exploring the city. Enjoy a stylish and efficient stay with everything you need at your fingertips.

reviews.text: Konum doğru ve banliyö trenine çok yakındı. Bir meyhane veya restoranın üst katı olmadığı icin gece sessiz ve rahattı. Ancak yerler, masada bulunan bardaklar kirlere sahipti. Ayrıca fotoğraflarda çift yatağı olduğu halde odanın kendisinde ayri yataklar bulunuyordu, bence biraz yanilticiydi o acidan. Onun dışında bir problem çekmedik, fiyatına göre guzel deneyim geçirdik:)
Nice apartment, worth the money. It was clean and supplied with everything needed. The host was always responding very fast and was very helpful. Thank you again for a pleasant stay.

its located at a great location. book this place if you only have limited time to explore istanbul. a little too small as we have two luggages but we managed. no space for prayer if any of the luggage is open. cleanliness can be improved

The place was really nice overall, especially the location was great. However, if one advertises their place with a washing machine it is expected to also have a drying rack or something similar available. This was not the case and we had to carry our wet clothes to the (expensive) local laundry store. Also, as only one of two headlights in the bathroom was working, the room felt a bit dark and dystopian.
The apartment is lovely and is close by to train station and many restaurants. Celal is very responsive and proactive. Check in and checkout instructions were very clear. Would highly recommend.

description:
Welcome to this Luxury 2-bedroom apartment located in Atakent area, near Tema World Shopping Mall.

🌿 This stylish apartment offers spacious living with a fully equipped kitchen, free access to indoor pool, spa, sauna, hamam and gym, and also includes daily free housekeeping service.

📍 The apartment is conveniently located close to Tema World Mall, restaurants, cafés, and shopping options, making it a perfect choice for both leisure and business stays.

We wish you a pleasant stay! ✨

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was beautiful, clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and helpful throughout my stay. Everything was well organized, and I truly appreciated how easy and smooth everything was from check-in to check-out. The location was also very convenient. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you for making my stay so enjoyable!

The rooms were clean and comfortable. The gym and spa amenities were amazing. The breakfast was expensive but it stood out and the waiting staff were always kind and attentive. The Marriott Executive Suites’ proximity to Tema World made an open walkable mall with restaurants, a grocery store, cafes, stores, and taxis easily accessible. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would come again.

Our stay at the Marriott Executive Apartments was spectacular.!!
Finding a space for a family of five (kids aged 12 and 10, plus a 1.5-year-old) is usually tough, but this was perfect.
The Best of Both Worlds!
It offers a premium, exclusive hotel experience with the soul of a home. The apartments are spotlessly clean and modern. With a 24-hour reception, you get 5-star service with the privacy and layout of a luxury residence.
Unbeatable Convenience!
Right in front of the complex is a fantastic mall that made our trip stress-free:
• Play: Both indoor and outdoor playgrounds kept the baby and the older kids thrilled.
• Dining/Shopping: Dozens of restaurants and shops just steps away.
The staff were incredibly helpful with our needs. If you want a high-end, functional, and "homey" stay in Istanbul, this is it. We felt like VIPs every day hitting the gym, relaxing in the sauna, steam bad, turkish bad and indoor pool!
The absolute highest recommendation for families! Thank you!

From the beautiful space and surrounding area to the wonderful communication the host provided, the entire experience was truly amazing. I couldn’t recommend this place enough! There’s plenty to do nearby while still being incredibly peaceful and relaxing. The room was wonderful, comfortable, and had all of the amenities listed. We had such a great time and would absolutely recommend staying here!
Konaklama genel olarak keyifliydi. Ev temiz ve düzenliydi, konumu da oldukça iyiydi. İletişim konusunda herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Rahat ve huzurlu bir konaklama geçirdik. Teşekkür ederiz.

description:
The space
Safe flat for tourists at historical area Beyoglu very close to Taksim. Unlke many of the areas in Beyoglu the street of the flat is one of the most quiet and secure street of the area and surrounded by security cams.

It is only 40 seconds far from Istiklal street & 5 min far from Galata Tower, Contemporary Art Museum, Pera museum, Galata Mevlevihanesi...

1 min to metro station (Sishane) to Taksim & Levent.
3 min to tram station (Tophane) to Sultanahmet (old town).

Easy access to/from almost every point of the city.

The flat is fully equipped. 1 LCD tv, 1 microwave owen, 1 washing machine,1 dishwasher,1 refrigerator, wireless internet connection, bed linens, towels, all kitchen equipments, soaps, shower gels, travel books, brochures, dictionaries, variety of Turkish / Ottoman music collections, documentary movies about Turkey are in your use.

Plus; "Istanbul Card" for transportations through Istanb

reviews.text: The apartment locates at perfect location. It looks exactly like the photos, clean, bright and charming. Shin is a very professional and great host, every questions were answered so quickly. I missed my flight to Istanbul because of weather so that my arrival was delayed one day. Shin kindly refunded me the first night rent. After I told him the hot water problem in the apartment, he fixed it within two hours. I had very pleasant staying in the apartment. Thanks Shin. I strongly recommend the apartment.

I stayed in Shin’s flat from mid-Jan to mid-Feb and much enjoyed its proximity to thriving Istiklal St. for restaurants, pubs, shopping, and public transport. It’s on the Bosphorus side of Istiklal, about 100 meters down fairly steep Kumbaraci St., on the corner of Tercuman. The living space and bedroom (comfortable mattress) are spacious, with adequate storage. The kitchen and bathroom are small but serviceable. The heating system kept the flat comfortably warm during my winter visit.

WiFi is reliable and reasonably fast, and the flat-screen TV carries several English-language channels (news/finance & movies). The surrounding area is quiet, making for restful sleep. The price was most reasonable considering the central location and amenities. Shin and Arda are responsive hosts who are keen to make visitors feel at home.

Transport hint: The Istanbulkart provided by Shin is real plus and essential to getting around. If you’re heading to Old Town and the many attractions there, rather than walk up Kumbaraci to the Tunel Metro, head downhill instead. A 5-minute walk will connect you to the Tophane T1 tram stop for the short trip across the Golden Horn. Taking the T1 in the opposite direction to the Kabatas stop drops you right at the ferry terminal for Princes’ Islands. Dolmabahce Palace is just a short walk north up the Bosphorous from the tram stop.

The apartment is perfectly located. It is spacious, interestingly planned and has a character, though nothing there - apart from tourist information and photos - gives you an idea that you are in Turkey. It is comfortable, with everything you need to enjoy your vacations or to work if on a business trip, including 100% reliable Internet connection. Unfortunately, because of a sudden illness (has nothing to do with the apartment!), I couldn't properly enjoy my stay in Istanbul. However, not a single moment I felt myself alone. Shinnosuke and his friend Arda took care of me as if I were their beloved aunt. They visited me every day, brought everything I asked for and even things that I did not ask for but that were helpful. As soon as I could go out Arda took me several times for a stroll, so that I could see at least some beautiful places of this marvellous city and try some of its famous gastronomic delicacies. He made me acquainted with the city as a professional guide, invited me for tea and baklava, for a short Bosphorus trip and what not. I feel as if now I have two nephews in Istanbul. When I next time go to Istanbul I hope to stay in the same apartment, in which you not only get a comfortable accommodation but also the human warmth. No words can express my profound gratitude to Arda and Shinnosuke.

Shinnosuke was an exceptional host.
My friend missed her flight and had to travel the next morning, meaning I had to check in to the apartment by myself really late in the evening. I'd never checked in to an Air Bnb rental by myself and was slightly nervous. Shin was friendly and reassuring.
The apartment itself has all the essentials, is centrally located and close to transport links. It was clean and comfortable and the local area felt safe.
There are many guide books, a phrasebook and maps at the apartment in case you did not get one. Some of the guides are a few years old but still useful for all the main tourist attractions. There is Wifi at the apartment so you can always check online for the latest bar and restaurant reviews. There is also a good welcome pack at the apartment with a great deal of information on local culture/ food / shop opening times etc.
Shin went above and beyond, providing us with an online map with all the local amenities marked, a travelcard for getting around, he arranged private car hire for us and was always contactable throughout our stay.
Our departure day coincided with the May Day demonstrations and many roads and bridges were closed in Istanbul. Shin took time out of his day to come to the apartment and help us to find a way out of the city.
Highly recommended!

Shin's flat was a wonderful place to be based in Istanbul. It was very comfortable, centrally located and clean. There were a lot of materials in the flat useful to the tourist. The kitchen was in good order, enabling us to make breakfast. Shin was a great host, arranging transport to and from the airport, meeting us at the flat, helping us gain our initial bearings and giving us a travel card that we used throughout the time we were there.

description:
Due to a new regulation in Istanbul, short-term stays require special permission.
If you’re interested in specific dates or durations, please feel free to contact us before booking.
We will be able to offer flexible options.

ADVANTAGES:

Pick up from airport,
