Towels, shampoo

reviews.text:
On the whole, the stay was ok. Mr. Kubilay was very nice and kind and tried to help whenever he could. The communication was excellent, he usually replied within a very short period of time and tried to make the stay as comfortable as possible.
Pros:
- Very cheap, esp. taking into consideration that the whole apartment is yours
- Big flat with enough rooms
- Fully equipped apartment
- Communication with Mr. Kubilay, quick response and always eager to help
- Cleaning of the apartment when wanted
- Bus stops nearby
- All necessary shops and stores are within a 5-7 min. walk
- Flat is on ground floor
- Balcony
- SIM card for free use
Cons:
- Fridge was full of old, partially moldy food; some food was expired 2 years ago
- Smell within the fridge
- Don´t know when the kitchen cabinets where cleaned last, very disgusting
- Overall cleanliness, esp. if you had a closer look at certain furniture and behind it
- Antisocial neighbourhood, esp. the neighbours below; might not be safe to go out at night-time
- Very misbehaved cat; jumps onto all surfaces, including those in the kitchen and while having dinner; poops next to the litter box sometimes although it is clean
- When cleaning lady isn´t there, her daughter takes on the task -> doesn´t clean properly
All in all, the apartment is a good catch for a short-term stay, but I wouldn´t recommend it for a long-term stay as in my case (1 month)

Hospitality at its best. Kubilay is very helpful and honest. A clean and safe environment. The kitchen is always stocked up and one can help oneself to whatever one wants. There are also jam and dried apricots from his mother who lives in a distant village. One can use the washing machine and iron. The bathroom has shampoo, soap, toothpaste, and shaving cream. One can sit and chat with him in the evening in the living room. From the beginning I felt as though I was visiting a close friend even though I’d never met him before. It was just like staying over at a friend except that he was more hospitable than many of my friends. He is very helpful with information regarding getting around Istanbul and Turkey especially if one is looking for inexpensive options. The neighbourhood has many shops. He really is a superhost and likes taking care of his guests. The WiFi and all the amenities were more than adequate for my needs. The location was convenient for me. He will be my first choice when visiting Istanbul again. Nic.

Kubilay's place is very well looked after, the surroundings are safe, you can see a lot of families walking around at any time, also, you can find convenient stores and bakeries nearby. The apartment is well equipped and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Kubi was always responsive and helpful with all my doubts and with recommendations, you also get a sim card(this is very expensive as a tourist if you want to get one on your own in Istanbul, so this is a huge plus from the apartment) and a Istanbul card (public transport)

Kubilay is an absolutely excellent host. He really goes out of the way to make our stay here so much more convenient and enjoyable. He replied to our numerous information request spontaneously. He even get up at 5 am in the morning to ensure the taxi we booked arrive on time. Thank you very much Kubilay. Really appreciate all your help. We enjoyed our stay at your place very much.
Kubilay's place is very big with lots of space. They are many many shops, restaurants and virtually all the things you need to live here comfortably, just a few minutes walk away. Cost of food stuff, dining out, etc is much cheaper here than for example in Istiklal street, Taksim square. Bus stops and tram station is only a few minutes walk away. I would highly recommend anyone to stay in Kubilay's place.

A clean and lovely apartment equipped with everything you need. A good bed and nice bathroom. The location is good too. It is close to public transportation, banks, shops and supermarkets. Kubilay is a great host. Even though I didn't meet him in person because he was out of town, he was available whenever i had any questions. I had a great stay! Would absolutely recommend you to stay there!

description: 400 meters to Galata Tower,3 minutes T1 Tophane tram station.5 minutes to Karaköy.New building.

reviews.text:
We (three friends) had a lovely and comfortable stay at Kemals property.
The location was very convenient to exploring Istanbul and the staff that we met were most kind and courteous.
There was this issue of the aircon not cooling the first night but one request to Kemal and he told us it was switched to heater mode and got it switched back and we slept very well afterwards.
Room size is big and the bed and sofa couch were comfortable.
WiFi was 5-10 Mbit down and 0.5 Mbit up. I was able to conduct MSTeams video calls for work pretty OK.
All in all, good value for money and would recommend at the price we paid.
Area around has quite a lot of small quaint cafes and little shops and Taksim Is not far. (Uphill Walk)
Note: Apparently Turkey requires a copy of your passport on check-in. The staff took a photo of mine from their phone which later I got paranoid with. Kemal assured me these photos are deleted.
I'd advise to cover your social security number if such a photo is taken if like me you are paranoid regarding identity documents.
Thank you Kemal and hope to come visit again soon :)

We arrived very late at night, yet checkin was smooth. The first room seemed to have AC trouble and we were immediately moved into another room (turns out the AC was fine though, was on us).
Room was clean, extremely spacious for the cost. Great deal for 2 people, quite comfortable for 3. Area is super nice, walking distance to a ton of super cute bars and cafes.
The best part was they gave us a ridiculously late check out because we had a late flight. This was such a seemingly small gesture but completely changed out experience.
Host was constantly and quickly responsive.

Our stay at Kemal’s place was amazing! The location is very central—just a 5–7 minute walk to Galata Tower and Galata Bridge, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and things to do nearby.
We originally planned to stay for only 2 nights but ended up extending our stay to 5 because of how convenient the location was. The room was beautiful, spacious, and clean, with fresh towels, a comfortable bed, reliable AC, and—most importantly—hot water in the shower (which isn’t always guaranteed in every place here!).
Kemal was incredibly accommodating, responsive, and helpful when we needed to extend our stay. We had a wonderful experience and would 100% recommend this place!

Kaldığımız odanın iç temizliği, çarşaf ve havluların ve hatta banyonun temizliği gerçekten güzeldi. Özellikle banyo içindeki fiskiyelerin sorunsuz ve tazzikli akması, sıcak soğuk ayarının kolay olması benim taktığım şeylerden biridir. Bu konuda da harikaydı.
Odanın içi geniş ve ferahtı. Fotoğraflardaki gibi. Rahat hareket edebilmek, eşyalarla yayılmak güzeldi.
Kemal bey ile iletişimimiz de güzeldi. Bir şeye ihtiyacımız olduğunda aradık ve yardımcı oldu.
Onun dışında dairenin konumu da gerçekten çok iyiydi. İstiklal ve Karaköy’e yürüme mesafesi, Galata kulesinin bir sokak arkasında.
Muhtemelen tekrar tekrar gidip kalırım.

Apartment in good location, with elevator which is a big plus. Mostly clean, few loose parts in bathroom and toilet.
Check in and out was simple.
The main thing that bothered us was loud noise from other apartments and smoking in public lobbies. Seems like each apartment to itself, without building's "house rules" and that affects everyone.
But pluses are bigger, and the location is a winner.

description: My petit house is located in the bosphorous and very close to downtown. it takes five minutes to get to the seaside. it overlooks the Bebek bay which makes the petit house special. it has a big terrace and a big (website hidden) is fully furbished house.

reviews.text: Stayed at Ercan’s place for around a month. It’s located on the top of a hill in arnavutkoy, one of Istanbul’s most prestigious areas so you know the views are gonna be amazing. The house is nicely decorated and has all the amenities you need for a comfortable long stay. The bed was super comfortable, water pressure was great, and the wifi connection was good for work. The house is easily accessible to the rest of the city as you can take a ferry nearby and head almost anywhere. The climb up is a bit tiring but you have to make a compromise for the view. I met Ercan once at check in and he was quick to respond to all my messages. Would recommend this place esp for people who are on their 3rd or 4th visits to istanbul and wanna try something different.

Ercan is wonderful, as his family, and they will very quickly make you feel welcome. The apartment is beautifully designed and has everything you would need for both a short or long term stay. The house requires a climb up a few hill or staircases, but the neighborhood is utterly charming--it feels like a intimate village within Istanbul's grand sweep. It is also located on the Bosphorous with lovely walks and restaurants. I would definitely recommend staying here, but be certain you are comfortable with dogs!

Ercan’s place is fantastic—clean, comfortable, spacious, and stylish—and Ercan and his family are truly wonderful, extraordinarily generous hosts. Arnavutköy is a beautiful neighborhood to which I’ve been coming regularly for many years, and Ercan’s place is the perfect hillside perch from which to enjoy it. The view is delightful, as is the companionship on the terrace from the three super-friendly dogs and cat. I really enjoyed the thirteen nights I spent here. I’ll be back!

I stayed at Ercan’s place for 2 months and wish i could stay longer. The house is extremely peaceful and well-designed. The photos don’t do the house justice, the house is actually much nicer! I won’t stay anywhere else when I visit istanbul, this is my go-to place now. It’s also cheaper than any other place you’ll find in this neighborhood, which is one of the nicest areas in Istanbul.

Ercan’s place is clean and has everything you need to enjoy Istanbul. The terrace has a beautiful view and the company of friendly dogs and cats. Shops and cafes are close although the walk back up to the house requires a climb up a few steep stairs. Public transport is a short walk away. All in all the house provides a much needed respite from the more hectic parts of Istanbul and offers a very scenic and peaceful stay. We’d recommend Ercan’s house to friends visiting Istanbul.

description: Balat is a historic and charming tourist destination located in the city. A bus stop is conveniently situated right in front of the house, and it’s just a 15-minute to reach the heart of the city, including popular areas like Taksim, Eminönü, and Karaköy. The accommodation is small but cozy, making it ideal for 1-2 people for a short stay.

reviews.text:
Melise and her mom were extremely helpful. Melise was out of the country but her mom greeted me when I arrived. Melise was available by video communicating with ease. Mom kindly helped out with the luggage coming in and going out. Every query or question was answered quickly and any need was promptly met.
The place was clean and the kitchen was well stocked. Great shower too. The darker cloth on the window shade helped to block the light so that wasn't an issue for us. We were happy that there was an access to the roof but during our time there, it was rainy and cold. Because we couldn't use the terrace, the room felt a bit small, especially with the luggage, but no complaints. Stairs are steep but we managed fine. It would have been helpful to have a closet to hang some clothes.
We liked the Balat and Fener neighborhood which was steps away from us with good places to eat and walk around.
The Istanbul experience was special, thanks to good hosting by Melise and her kind mom.

I can’t say enough about this place!
I stayed in three different Airbnbs in Istanbul, including one in Beyoglu and one in Sultahnamet, and this was far and away the best. The location is excellent - right near the Main Street in Balat, which is full of cafes, restaurants and shops, and yet it’s still relatively quiet and comfortable. The place itself is incredible - tastefully decorated and inviting with incredible views of the Golden Horn from the room and the private balcony. It is well appointed and well stocked, and they even have filtered hot & cold water for drinking. Melis is warm, helpful, and easy to work with. The price is also incredibly reasonable for what you get - a great value.
I have already recommended this place to friends and will stay there again when I return to Istanbul. Don’t pass this up!

Melis and her mother were extremely kind and helpful; they immediately responded to my questions, and they helped us with flexible check-in and check-out hours.
The place itself was warm, comfortable, and well decorated. It was super clean and equipped with all the necessary needs (even tea and coffee). The shared terrace is a perfect spot that you will never want to leave, especially at night. Balat - the area in which the house is located, is very beautiful and it has many lovely local cafes around.
Overall, it was an amazing experience and I had a fantastic stay. I'll definitely visit the place the next time I come to Turkey.
Fantastic stay: clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive, welcoming, and flexible. Highly recommend! :)

This cozy flat was situated perfectly for exploring Balat (and elsewhere in Istanbul) and fully equipped with everything we needed! Melis was so helpful with our checkin time and was quick to respond.
This third story flat had a great private roof, comfy bed, lovely natural lighting, and cool house plants. We mostly ate out while we were there but loved having the water filter system, easy Turkish coffee maker, and little fridge.
Balat was such a unique neighborhood to explore. Great little cafes and restaurants, as well as lots of cool local artisan shops and antique stores. The bus stop was a 3 minute walk and took us closer to Sultanahmet or over across the Golden Horn.

description: Cozy 2-bedroom Galata apartment with a living room, dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen. Features natural gas heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort. Styled in a local Galata home design, it offers charm and convenience. Located on the second floor (entrance floor counted as 0), perfect for those seeking a central yet quiet retreat. Enjoy prompt assistance with our Superhost service. Ideal for a memorable stay in the heart of Istanbul

reviews.text:
Eyp was a great host, friendly, helpful and attentive.
The apartment is located on a dead end road so there is no traffic noise.
Access is simple up one flight of stairs.
The location is perfect in Beyoglu, 5 minutes walk to Galata Tower, Tophane Metro, restaurants and bars.
The beds were comfortable, clean towels and linen, large bathroom with a good hot shower and the kitchen looked good though I did not use it.
It is as described and was clean with all the amenities you should need.
I used Eyp's airport transfer service and this was very good. I would recommend it.
The transfer area at IST airport is rather chaotic but that is not Eyp's fault.
Eyp allowed me to store cases until ready to leave.
Overall an excellent stay and I would definitely stay here again.
Only thing to note is that the area is built on steep hills but that applies to the whole of Beyoglu and is not a fault of Eyp's.

The apartment is well located, with easy access to restaurants/cafes/pubs, metro station, tram stop, Galata tower, Galata Bridge, Karakoy district and also Istiklal Street.
The interior is clean, spacious and comfortable. The kitchen is nice, and the washing machine helps us a lot.
The host is very helpful, and even provide us with welcome fruit juices and snacks. When we encounter a slight problem, he even responded to our inquiry messages in the evening within minutes. Definitely the best.
Just a slight word of caution, most part of Istanbul requires you to go up slopes and stairs. You may wanna take taxi instead of walking if that’s a challenge for you. The host helped us with our luggage up the stairs (thanks) but we have to manage it down ourselves when we check out. But than again this is common through out most of Istanbul.
All in all, highly recommended for anyone coming over to Istanbul and looking for a place to stay for a few days in Beyoglu.

Me and my parents had a great stay there! Location:
Location is great in a heart of historic area, close to anything you need, lots of restaurants around for any budget, nice traditional and artisan bakeries. A great spot for vegetarians and vegans - so many options around.
Apartment:
Very cosy apartment, feels like home. In an old beautiful building. Renovated and redesigned by your host and he definitely added a nice atmosphere to it. It’s a rare case when Airbnb actually is cuter in real life than it looks on photos.
It has a good size kitchen, had everything for us to make quick breakfast, which was very convenient.
The view from the balcony is great too!
Sauna also was a nice plus for us on a cold winter day.
Host: Eyp was very kind to help us with everything, organize transfer and help us get a taxi, he was very quick to reply whenever we had questions. Thanks lots!
The security guy Hasan is a great person, speaks Russian. He was very helpful and gave us a lot of shopping and travel tips. My parents who speak only russian for sure appreciated a friendly person to chat with.
For minuses, nothing really. The only thing I noticed was that one of the bedrooms was colder than others, so on the nights when it was 0 degrees it was a bit cold. If you plan a winter trip maybe just ask for a second blanket. But it hardly ever gets to 0 here so won’t be relevant for most travelers.
Overall: great value and service for the price.

We stayed here for 1 week while in town from America for a wedding. We simply wanted a nice place to sleep at a reasonable price that would allow us to spend most of our time touring the city. The location was off the beaten path, but still walking distance to key sites (Galata Tower, Istiklal Avenue, many small shops and cafes) and public transportation. Eyp met us for check-in and check out and helped with our luggage. He was flexible with check-in and check-out times. The apartment was clean and everything was functional. Eyp was very responsive with all communication. He proactively reached out to see if he could help make our stay more enjoyable and he was able to help with airport transportation, which we found very valuable. We had one small problem with hot water, but he responded as soon as we contacted him and had the problem resolved immediately.

The apartments were really very nice. All photos correspond to the reality. And Eyup is a wonderful host. In case of ANY problems he helped us to resolve them and answered almost immediately.
Location is also nice (like 10-12 min to Karakoy tram station and the same time to Sishane metro station).
All historical places are located very close.
The apartments are clean, beds in the rooms are very comfortable (what else is necessary after the whole day walking?! 😊😊).
And we also liked that despite the apartments are located in the center, the street is very quite.
So, apartments are highly recommended to everyone, who wanna have a good time in this wonderful city 😊

description:
This is a magical building. This is how I feel when I enter this building. When you open the door and get inside you are in a different world. The building is very unique, dates back to 1880's.
It will surprise you. There are two set of steps that leads to units on two sides of the building.
It is just a few steps to Galata Tower, amazing location.

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay at the apartment in Istanbul.The place was as described—comfortable, with clean sheets and towels, and appointed with the essential amenities we needed for our visit. The location was perfect, being close to historical sites, restaurants, shops, and public transportation. The apartment is situated in an old building, it is well-furnished, with comfortable beds and fast Wi-Fi. I especially appreciated Mine's promptness in providing any missing essentials quickly. She was incredibly hospitable and responsive, always quick to answer any questions and ensuring we had a pleasant stay.
If I had to mention some areas for improvement, they would be the street noise, and the creaking doors. However, these issues did not significantly detract from the overall experience. I recommend this place to young and fit individuals without children, as the stairs might be challenging for some. Thank you Mine!

We enjoyed our stay here it was very close to Galata Tower and the pier. You can easily take transport to various parts of Istanbul as well. Home was clean and as shown in the photographs.
Couple of things to keep in mind:
1. this home is in an older building with no elevator and is on the 3rd floor. So a bit hard to navigate with luggage but doable.
2. The surrounding area is very hilly so you will be walking up and down hill a lot.
3. From the main bedroom you can hear seagulls so may want to keep some ear plugs if that would bother you.
Overall, it was great value and we would come again.

Fazilet was a super communicative host! Her place is a 3 bedroom flat located in the heart of Galata, which is like the Times Square in some ways of Istanbul. The location is ideal for being able to get to the top tourist sites within a max 30 min walk or 15-20 min tram ride. The flat itself is as described and comfortable for 6 people. One of the bedrooms is stunning and bright while the other two are small and dark. Not the biggest deal but I do think more than 6 people is too tight. There is a washer (and drying rack) as well as dishwasher and the kitchen is equipped with the basics, though I wouldnt really plan to do much beyond reheating food and having leftovers. Overall, a cool spot with hip decor located two flights up!

The apartment is in the heart of Beyoğlu, a five minute walk to Galata Tower. The flat is inside an older building that has been restored with the most unique characteristics: the lobby, ceiling in the apartment, original wood floors, high ceilings. The water pressure for showers is perfect, and a family of four will not run out of hot water (I'm anal about this)! We really enjoyed having our morning Turkish coffee on the balcony while watching the ships pass by on the Bosphorus.
The host is very friendly & responsive to any questions we had, thank you for not ghosting us after check-in (it happens all the time).
The bonus to this flat is the rooftop deck with panoramic views of Galata Tower and the Bosphorus. It was STUNNING! We even witnessed a professional photo while there. Very cool!! We will be back, thank you!!

We contacted the host last minute upon arrival and we got the response in the matter of minutes, so that we could get organized and move in quickly. Everything was so smooth, we were awaited and showed around. We were very happy with the place, it was even better then on the photos.
The location is great, just bellow the Galata tower. We are a family of 5, "teen-ager kids" didn't mind moving up and down the street :)
The flat is clean and comfortable, the "Turkish balcony" has a great view, we really liked it.
The only downside that has been mentioned in the comments, is that it can be noisy during the night due to the night life of the neighborhood and the birds, but we would choose it again even with this downside.
We hope to visit Istanbul again, one the main positive impressions we have is due to this great experience! Thanks Mine :)

description: Stay in the heart of Sultanahmet and explore Istanbul’s Historic Peninsula with ease. Ivy Suites offers a comfortable 45 m² apartment for up to 4 guests. Hagia Sophia is 2–3 minutes away, Basilica Cistern 2 minutes, Blue Mosque 2–3 minutes, Topkapi Palace 5 minutes and the Grand Bazaar 5–7 minutes on foot. The tram station is just 1 minute away, with many restaurants and cafés nearby.

reviews.text:
We had an AWESOME 2 week stay at Erdal's place! You absolutely cannot beat the location! You are literally across the street from the Blue Mosque and right in the heart of Istanbul.
Erdal graciously arranged for a taxi to and from the airport (definitely worth the $40) for us. His sister met us at the curb where the taxi dropped us off and took us up to the apartment (2nd floor). The apartment was cleaned at least every other day including dishes being washed which we were not expecting. :-) The apartment had all of the basics and best of all, it had strong and reliable internet.
There are plenty of restaurants (and restaurant "hawkers") along the road who will welcome you in for a bite to eat. The place is hidden off of a side street above some restaurants, a bar and a hooka lounge. There is some outside noise, music and smells until about 2:00 am most days. However, after the first few nights we got used to it and we felt that the tradeoff for location was worth it.

This is my honest review for anyone wanting to know about Erdal's apartment.
The host was really friendly.
Erdal's sister greeted us at the door. she was really really helpful and friendly.
On two consecutive morning there were no water in the apartment at all for extended hrs but that was due to local plumbing work and effected local area.
also due to latenight shisha place outside on groundfloor the smoke and smells gets into the bedroom if you open the window.
Apart from that the place is fantastic for its location. it is opposite the hygia sofia and suleman ahmet mosque just by the entrance on opposite side of the road. there are lots of shops and restaurants literally outside the apartment.
The apartment was always warm, comfortable and clean.
On the last day Erdals even helped us with carrying our large suitcase and arranged taxi service for us to the airport.
Erdal's place is brilliant for its location and comfort.

The apartment is literally a minute walk to the Blue Mosque, Aya Sofia and everything touristy around it. The apartment is spacious, the bed is very comfortable. Amazing price for such a prime location. Erdal and his sister were amazing hosts. They planned our transport to the airport, the PCR tests we needed and even kept our luggages after our checkout so we can continue exploring the city before our flight. I recommend them 10/10. Thank you for your wonderful hospitality

Erdal is very pleasant and attentive host. The apartment is located in walking distance to the best Istanbul attractions. There are a lot of places to eat and shop around. The only inconvenience is the noisy bar just outside. If you get used to go to bed early, you might have a problem. Otherwise is absolutely value for money deal.
Very happy with the location, service and cost. I will gladly book here again. Great water pressure in the shower and plenty of hot water.

description:
The penthouse of Levent Apart offers comfort and convenience. In terms of design, everything is available for the comfort of the guests. There is a kitchenette in the apartment. Plates, glasses, cutlery, etc. are available. There is a Wi-Fi network in the apartment. This way, you can stay connected to the digital world and easily manage your business remotely. Android TV (Netflix, Youtube, etc.).
Levent Apart is located next to plazas and draws attention with its proximity to the metro, buses and shopping centers.

reviews.text:
Great location, comfortable, kind and helpful host.
Location: The loft is located less than 3-5 mins walk from 2 large malls: Kanyon mall and Ozdilekpark. Kanyon is great for its nice restaurants and cafes including a branch of the famous Nusr-et restaurant. Ozdilekpark is a bigger mall with all the shops you would need, lots of international name brands like H&M, Mango, Zara etc, also nice food court, cafes and cinema. There are also supermarkets at both these malls for your groceries. There are also nice local eateries, bakeries and turkish pastry/sweet shops around which you can try.
Accomodation: Clean, comfortable and cosy loft with all amenities you would need. The wifi is high speed and television has Netflix and Amazon video for days/nights in.
Host: Serkan was a great host, very responsive, gracious and helpful. Ask him for any help you need.

Both Serkan and his brother were very helpful, easy to communicate with, always checking if I needed anything, if anything was needed, they provided it right away. Very hospitable people and proactive. The location was safe, close to the metro, buses station, plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, 2-3 shopping malls, many markets, 24/7 liquor/snack store, tourist attractions spots, and lastly clinics and hospital in walking distance. Place is as described and like photos, very clean and cleaning is done twice a week. I initially booked it for 3 nights but stayed a month. They are 24/7 at the front desk and if not, can communicate through Airbnb easily. Highly recommended it!

Wonderful little cozy hotel apartment attic. Respectful hosts who also work at front desk when you enter. Everything was super clean and the area was quiet. 10 minute walk to shopping malls. Bottles of cold water in the fridge. Overall it was a great place to stay and I especially recommend to those who emphasize cleanliness.
the home looks like photos. location is great. very clean and comfortable apartment 🩵
Everything was great, the place looks exactly as it its and it’s clean and warm. The location is quite convenient with many shops around. Mr. Hakan was very helpful!

description:
Sultanahmet area
Grand Bazaar - 7 minutes walking distance
Sultanahmet Mosque - 11 minutes walking distance
Sultanahmet Square - 11 minutes walking distance
Ground cistern - 12 minutes walking distance
Hagia Sophia - 13 minutes walking distance
Egypt Bazaar - 17 minutes walking distance
Topkapı Palace - 19 minutes walking distance
Çemberlitaş Historical Bath-8 minutes walking distance

reviews.text:
Spontaneously booked the room 1 hour before arriving(1 guest) - asked for ironing board and other things to be ready for me and had great and quick response, everything was prepared. There is 24/7 reception ready to help with anything.
It was extremely clean (bathroom, bedsheets, towels etc.) and modern interior.
Location is great - it’s just off the main tram road (15 min from Aya Sofya)- it’s at the bottom of a cobblestone hill but no issues getting to it.

I read previous reviews talking about water pressure and other concerns but I faced none of that - shower had good pressure, everything was spotless and the host was great - he even organised a cheap taxi for me to the airport (cheaper than other Taxi services).
Very welcoming, unbeatable quality for its price - I 100% recommend and will be coming back again, God willing.

I have a lot to say. It is really recommended to stay here. It located at very walkable distance to main attractions of Istanbul ( Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia Mosque, Sultanahmet Plaza). It is also near to Tram Station ( 5 min walk distance). Thumbs up👍 for the staffs, they are really helpful about local Attractions, recommended Restaurants etc. Room is also super clean, which is same in pictures described. I am very satisfied and surely stay here again.

We had a fantastic stay at this lovely hotel just ten minutes walk away from the grand bazaar and the blue mosque. There were lots of restaurants seconds away too. You can buy fresh bread, cheeses, olives and even boiled eggs across the small road in a little traditional shop with a pleasant owner, so breakfast is easy. Everything about here was great. Room and bathroom were spacious and spotlessly clean (house keeping is doing an excellent job). You could have your room cleaned whenever you needed. Towels replaced everyday. Shower was hot and powerful. Reception area (and rooms) beautifully decorated and receptionist Faisal and owner Ahmed, both helpful, friendly polite guys and very informative. This hotel is fabulous in every way - we 100% recommend and will definitely return.

The hotel was clean, quiet and comfortable. The staff were friendly and very helpful with everything I needed, from directions, recommendations, and chats about everything else!
The location was central and convenient with some great restaurants and cafes just a few minutes away.
The local area was quiet and the people were all helpful and friendly. I felt very safe walking around day and night.

Worth it for the small price! Hot water, great bed, clean! Just a little bit noisy in the nighttime (heat system or the water tubes or your neighbours) Don’t recommend if you’re a light sleeper. Overall had a great stay! Thanks!

description:
Hello :) I have 2 bedrooms in my house. One room only for you, my dear guests. I have 2 beautiful cats at home. Don't worry, they're both docile and very friendly. There are many cafes and restaurants near my house. It is in a very central but very quiet location. All rooms are bright. My house is always clean. My house is 8-10 minutes walking distance from all means of transportation.
Note: Please send a message before booking. See you later :)

reviews.text:
Zeynep place is extremely comfy, super clean, nice smell and a very comfortable bed.
Zeynep was a very awesome and kind host, she even cooked and offer me to eat with.
The apartment is a very active safe neighborhood 4 minutes from the Kadıköy ferry terminal.
You can find all kinds of shop's near you walking maximum 5 to 6 minutes from the apartment.
And if there anything you don't know where to find, no problems ask Zeynep and she will draw you a sketch.
I highly recommend Zeynep place.

It’s a good place. Location is great in the center of Kadikoy area. Really clean and good room for staying. Host is very friendly and hospitality person. Thank you for everything. If you are looking for a place cheap and clean this is option for you.

First of all Zeynep is very good person, hospitable, kind! She has 2 very cute cats.
Apartment is in amazing location! Clean, cozy, comfortable! Has all things which needed.
Big thank you to Zeynep!)
evin konumu çok iyi, temiz ve yeterli büyüklükte bir oda.Zeynep anlayışlı, cana yakın ve misafirperver biri.Gönül rahatlığı ile kalabilirsiniz

I really appreciated the warm atmosphere and comfort Zeynep has created in her home - a lot of it related to her genuine personality :)
The neighborhood generally felt vibrant and safe during all hours of the day.
The two cats are a nice social couple to lift your mood.

description:
Hello 😊 Please note the following information to ensure a smooth stay:
1️⃣ Please specify the correct number of guests at the time of booking. No additional guests are allowed after confirmation. There is paid indoor parking for the car
2️⃣ Before check-in, all guests are required to share images showing their Turkish ID number or passport details for registration purposes.
3️⃣ Since the roof is the natural habitat of seagulls, you may hear seagulls from time to time. ☺️

reviews.text:
Kanepenin örtüsüz ve lekeli olması tedirgin edici idi. Tek kullanımlık terlik yoktu ama plastik terlik sunmuştu. Yıkanmıştı sanırım ama ben gene de bi daha yıkama ihtiyacı duydum. Ev genel olarak temizdi. En üst kat olduğu için boğazı yatak odasından görebilirsiniz. Kanepeye yakın priz konulması (3'lü çekilebilir) konfor koşullarını arttıracaktır.
Genel olarak memnun kaldık, fiyat biraz eklerle yüksek geldi lakin canımı sıkan "çöpleri çıkarken atın" talimatı idi. Genel olarak çöpleri çöp kutusuna atıp bulaşıkları lavaboya bıraktım. Bavullar ile birliybi de çöpleri 2 kat merdiven 3 kat asansör ile indiremezdim. Kaldı ki alınan bi temizlik ücreti var.
Şifreli giriş sistemi olduğu için ev sahibi ile hiç yüzyüze karşılaşmadım. Anahtarı duvardan alıp masaya bıraktım en son...

The location and communication was perfect. The place is nice and clean and has everything you need. It's cheap so don't expect a 5 star bathroom but it's all functional and clean. The view of the Marmara sea from the bedroom (on the top floor) was exceptional and a very welcome surprise.

One of the most unique place you can stay with 180-degree sea view right from your bedroom. And if you get bored of it you can marvel at some great, 6-storey tall murals. The apartment is clean, newly furnished and offers very fast and reliable wifi. All of this for a very reasonable price and with a superhelpful host. Highly recommended.

It was a nice studio apartment/1+1 with a few quirks. The nice things are that you have an amazing view of the sea and you have easy access to the center of Kadikoy. However, there is a frosted window in the bathroom -- this goes out into the hallway/stairs where one will enter the apartment. While this was not a deal breaker for me, it may be something that one would want to consider. There was some minor cleanliness issues as well. However, I felt that it was an excellent value for the price and it worked very well for my purposes (a very brief weekend trip). If you need to be in the middle of Kadikoy for an affordable price and have a comfortable place to sleep, then it is a good place.

I had a great stay, helpful host and enjoyed the area. The apartment was as seen in photos, comfortable and relaxing. WiFi was a bit spotty on my phone but fine in computer for a zoom. Would definitely stay again, thank you!

description:
Great location in the heart of Istanbul.
If you love art, books and especially photography, this is the perfect place to stay for you.

In addition to having a beautiful coffee shop/bookshop right under your flat, the coolest coffee shops, restaurants, bars, art galleries, design shops are all within walking distance for you to experience Istanbul right at its heart.

Enjoy our colorful book shelves, shared work space and shared terrace on the rooftop of the building with sea view.

reviews.text:
The listing and description are very accurate. Cemre, and her mother Semsa, are great communicators.
The apt is clean, bright and airy; bed is comfortable, the pillows are of different thickness: touch of genius! It's very well located close to major tourist spots and a short walk away from waterfront and Galata bridge. Also, being myself a photographer and book lover I was excited of being two floors up the Fils Bookstore.
Btw, steps are steep, and no elevator, consider it if you carry heavy luggage.
On the other hand: it's in the hearth of Karaköy movida, which means cool bars and restaurants next door but also loud music till late at night. Bring your best earplugs!

The location is great, very central and lots of cafes & restaurants walking distance.
Host is very friendly and responsive.
Room is as described and shown in photos.
They have very cozy cafe on the ground floor.
The only not the best for my situation, that I had a big bag and the stairs weren't wide enough to handle the bags easily, but it wasn't an issue for me (I just trying to help future travellers)

Room was just as described - bright and cosy. Just lovely. Hosts were very polite, welcoming and helpful. The area is buzzing, with lots of cafes, bars, restaurants and shops and is walking distance to the touristy part of town. Great position! The coffee shop downstairs has a good selection of food and cakes and makes a very good coffee, too.
The only two drawbacks are the noise level at night (which comes with being in such a vibrant part of town) and the steep staircase. If you can sleep through loud music and don't mind stairs, then I would highly recommend staying here.

A great property with fantastic hosts and a charming and very cool location. The stairs to our room on the third floor were a bit narrow and tight, especially with luggage. Also, it’s a bit of an uphill walk to Istiklal. However the room was very comfortable and we very much enjoyed our stay.

FilBooks was such a cute place to stay in during our trip to Istanbul. The cafe downstairs was lovely, and the room upstairs was perfect for us. It is in a great neighborhood with lots of amazing food, bars and cafes around. Cemre and her boyfriend as well as all the other cafe staff were incredibly helpful, helping us with our bags and calling taxis and with directions etc. It did get a little bit noisy at night with music coming from the bar next door, but we slept through it -- a small price to pay for the great neighborhood. Thanks for the great experience!!

description: Completely renovated 70m2 apt. 3rd floor w. elevator & sea-view. Few steps from elevator to aprt. door. Balcony with Bosphorus view. 2 bedrooms (queen bed+queen bed) + sofa, full kitchen, bathroom, linen, towels, toiletries and all amenities listed are available. 100 Mbps limitless WiFi, Netflix, SmartTV. 500m (8 min. walk) from Taksim Square and metro (M2 line). 650m (9 min. walk) from Kabataş ferrys, 350m to tram (T1 line). AC's IN LIVING ROOM & MAIN BEDROOM, THE SECOND BEDROOM HAS A FAN.

reviews.text:
My family had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this place. My mother was very happy and comfortable throughout her stay in the place.
The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and fully functional. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything she needed, and even small details like having different types of coffee available made the stay more enjoyable. The host also kindly helped set up the TV exactly how my family preferred, which we really appreciated.
There have been a beautiful sea view in balcony.The beds were very comfortable—my mother has knee and body pain, but she felt great and slept very well, which says a lot.
The location is excellent—very convenient and accessible from all sides. It’s super close to Taksim, the seaside, and everything you might need, making it ideal for both relaxation and getting around easily.
A special thanks to the host for being responsive very fast and flexible for all my cahangs and requeats. In general, my family felt like home here.

This was by far one of the greatest Airbnb listings I've ever stayed at. The apartment was exactly as described. Even full of usually overlooked details like enough towels, toilet paper and kitchen and cleaning supplies. But also other small details like extremely clear instructions in english on how to use the appliances which made our stay go smoothly. The view is antonoshing especially at night, there are plenty of cafés, restaurants, grocery stores and bars in a walkable distance if you don't mind climbing a few stairs. Public transporation is at 6-10 mins walk down the hill and will take you to most of the nicest places in Istanbul. I would give this place and host 10 stars if it were possible. Absolutely recommended and will definitely stay here again next time.

We enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is located in a great area, close to everything and with easy access to public transport, with lots of cafes and eateries around. The apartment is of a good size with two bedrooms large enough and huge living /dining/kitchen area. The view from the balcony is spectacular! We were in April so we appreciated central heating, however be aware that the air conditioning is only in the living room which might potentially be an issue if coming in the peak of the summer. Place was well equipped, water pressure was great and there was hot water 24/7. It was very clean and felt homey. Perhaps the only minor downsides were wardrobes (you cannot move hangers from one to the other in case someone has more clothes and hangers were quite high for smaller person to reach). Be mindful that the lift stops between floors so you have to use stairs a bit. We would gladly stay here again!

Found everything pleasant and as described. Yıldıray was a very responsive and helpful host. The place was clean and neat. The only downside is the neighborhood — very steep roads and lots of stairs, which can be challenging, especially if you’re carrying suitcases. You’ll need to manage the luggage yourself both on the streets and within the building.

I recently stayed at this apartment and had a great experience. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything was well organized, and the location was convenient, near taksim square, just 5 min walking, amazing seaview. I really appreciated the host’s responsiveness and hospitality. I would definitely recommend this apartment and would love to stay here again in the future.

description:
Spacious and cosy 3-bedroom flat in Oldtown Sultanahmet Suites. It features:

• a private balcony
• a compact kitchen
• a modern bathroom
• a calm atmosphere, ideal for families or small groups

Enjoy peaceful mornings or evening tea on the balcony surrounded by greenery, while staying just a short walk from Istanbul’s most iconic landmarks.

• Little Hagia Sophia – 3 min
• Blue Mosque – 10 min
• Hagia Sophia – 15 min
• Grand Bazaar – 15 min

See my profile for other flats.

reviews.text:
Engin was a great host! He provided some excellent recommendations for places to eat as well as pointing us toward some great neighborhood markets.
The flat is in a quiet neighborhood, yet it is still close to all of the sights that most tourists have on their bucket list.
The kitchen is well equipped if you prefer to prepare meals there instead of eating out.

Host was super friendly and responsive, providing local recommendations and suggestions. The flat is smaller than what I expected, but it is in a great location with lots to do. Overall would recommend staying here.
Good location, responsive host and looks like the pictures - would recommend

fantastic stay at Engin's apartment. truly welcoming hosts and also very responsive. a total lifesaver for us as we had a sick child and engin helped us take him to the Dr on a public holiday. the apartment is in a great location for a family - two nice parks in walking distance, and well as little eateries, mini markets and 2 supermarkets so has a residential feel. you can walk up the hill to the tram line/ to blue mosque/ hagia Sophia/ cistern museum etc etc. it was the perfect place to stay with three kids. thank you very much :)

We had a wonderful stay in Istanbul which was made all the more enjoyable thanks to Engin; who was extremely helpful, communicated very well and was very welcoming. We felt very much at home - the flat was lovely, safe and private and in a superb location. The private balcony as well as the shared rooftop terrace offered great views! Engin helped welcome us upon arrival and helpfully gave us advice on local restaurants and local sites. I would recommend this flat to anyone visiting Istanbul and wish to thank Engin again for helping to make our trip to Istanbul so enjoyable.

description:
--Renovated on May of 2023--

This Studio Apartment is specially designed for the guests.
The Apartment is located in the Best Location of Istanbul; Taksim.You will be only 200 meters away from the Taksim Square(Center of Istanbul).Only two minutes away to Istiklal Street which is the heart of the nightlife of Istanbul;There are many shops,restaurants and bars furthermore many of them are open for 24 hours

It is on third floor(three stairs)
The apartment is only 2 minutes away to Metro Station

reviews.text:
The apartment was small, clean, cozy and equipped with excellent and modern interior design.
Everything was fine and all the negative comments I read were corrected.
The bed was super soft and the integrated bathroom and toilet were functional and hassle free.
On the one hand, the interior of the apartment can be seen from the outside and we had to create privacy by using curtains, but on the other hand, it was very bright with natural light.
The apartment was modern and new. It was clean.
The host and co-host were super responsive, available and responded to everything in less than a second even at odd hours. Especially the co-host helped us with luggage and using the washing machine.
The apartment was on the 3rd floor with no elevator which was mentioned and what was not mentioned was that the alley was very steep and I think it would be difficult for the elderly to access it but we didn't have a problem with that. The neighborhood and location was good in every way.

Hello!
I want to leave some impression of this reservation…It was a good choice for this location, I am satisfied with this apartment, it’s clean, structured, comfortable, it is situated in the center and it is convenient to visit many places nearby. I liked it, it’s worth choosing this apartment. Burhan is very kind and responsive, for which I am very thankful!

The Airbnb was in a very good location, it was just next to Taksim Square and meant that we were able to go to all local destinations quickly. The Airbnb a self was very clean and the staff were extremely friendly. The room is self is cosy clean and had everything you could need. The shower was amazing it almost felt like hydrotherapy. Ismail and his co-host answered everything that we asked very promptly and also invited us to shisha and which unfortunately we could not attend due to a busy schedule. However, they were very welcoming and very friendly. I found that whenever I sent the message they replied within a couple of minutes, which is extremely handy, I will definitely book this again and stay here if I came to Istanbul again. I would note that this Airbnb is on a side street which is also an incline and also the location has stairs so will not be appropriate for anyone who has poor mobility, otherwise it was a very good stay.

Definitely one of my favorite Airbnb stays! Very cozy, 2 mins or less walk from Taksim Square, groceries, the metro, Istiklal St and so many bars and restaurants.
The bathroom can get wet, but dries up fairly quickly and there's a curtain and seal on the bathroom door to ensure no water gets out into the room.
All basic amenities available with hot water.
Ismail and Burhan were both very responsive and helpful to any questions I had.
Would surely consider coming back here for another stay!

The location is good near maydine Taksim. love the fact that it was near Mosque. The place is smaller than what I expected in the pictures. There is no wardrobe to put your clothes (only next the bed where you can hang your jacket only for 2 person). unfortunately the place smell due to humidity (problem in building). the place is great for a short trip (4 days max). Overall it's good place minus the few hiccups.

description:
The best location in the city !
It's very bright apartment on the top floor of a historical/Greek building in Taksim/Beyoglu
You'll have a breathtaking view of gorgeous Hagia Sophia/BlueMosque/Topkapı Palace/Golden Horn&MarmaraSea & Princess Islands from your place
Taksim is the most central part of Istanbul, my apartment is 5mins by walk from Taksim Square
Istiklal Street, where you can find hundreds of pubs, restaurants, bars, clubs and all kind colorful shops are 1min away

reviews.text: I’m in love in this cozy nice flat with amazing view! Ugur was so helpful and kind! big big thanks for great host! The flat has everything you need: full equipped kitchen even drinking water! everything in the shower (shampoo, gel - everting you need!), 2 blankets, heater. Local recommendations, beautiful photographs album and more. The flat better than on the pics I think. And the view is incredible! I was in many rooftop restaurants here in Istanbul but from the Ugur’s flat the best view for sure! So you can just seat home and enjoy even if it’s rain or you too lazy to go outside .) It’s 5th floor without elevator but it was not big problem for me: I just made one stop on my way to get one’s breath .) The location is perfect: it’s best district of Istanbul - Cihangir- but the street is quite and windows on the other street but because flat high you don’t here noice. And Cihangir and Pera famous with the very beautiful old buildings, also palazzo’s. And restaurants and cafe 👌🏼

Best location, Ugur was very helpful and I was able to contact him very easily. The apartment had exactly what I needed and what it was described. There is no elevator so take that into account if you have heavy luggage , other than that I loved it, best price best location best host ! Great view and neighborhood. Thanks Uğur!!!

Had a great stay at Uğurs place, would highly recommend! Communication was amazing, very prompt in sending check in instructions which were very clear. Also sent a lot of local recommendations and was super helpful organising left luggage, a wonderful host. Place was easy to find and only a 10-15min walk from where the airport bus ends at Taksim square. Just beware the 5 flights of stairs - they are not for the faint hearted. I was pretty spent with a large backpack, other hard luggage would be a bit difficult with the spiral type stairs. But the climb is definitely worth it for the amazing views!! Kitchen is also well equipped for light cooking. Good location for restaurants, hammam and getting to public transport. Would stay here again

So this is the place for you if you're not looking for a 4 or 5 star hotel and want the gritty authenticity of the old city near Taksim Square. This is a rustic apartment in the heart of the action. Place was tidy and bed etc very clean! One word of caution - this is on the 5th floor and there is no elevator/lift. The best thing about this unit is the host - Ugur is friendly and helpful and will make you feel at home in Istanbul...he's just great! I was here for two weeks and would recommend this place.

I really enjoyed my month-long stay at Ugur's place and highly recommend this bright & cozy, artsy loft! It had spectacular views of the Marmara Sea, Golden Horn and Hagia Sophia off in the distance. Apart from the view, some of the things that stood out in the apartment for me was how comfortable the bed was and the amazing water pressure/temperature control with the shower system in the bathroom.
Ugur was a great host & we had great communication throughout my stay. He was very friendly as he was constantly checking in on me and always wanted to let him know if there was anything else he could do to make my stay more enjoyable. He provided a nice list of recommendations of things to see while I was in Istanbul, as well as the Turkish dishes (and the restaurants where to have them) I needed to eat! Overall simply an amazing apartment, that was so centrally located with a caring & supportive host - it's obvious to me why Ugur is a super host & this Airbnb is so highly rated :)

description: We look forward to hosting our valued guests in our newly opened hotel in Taksim Square, the pearl of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Good hotel for the price.
Pros:
1) minutes away from Taksim. 10-15 min walk to main restaurants and main area of Taksim
2) modern design
3) friendly staff
4) superb view from the balcony
5) grocery store nearby
Cons
1) small rooms, but that’s normal for hotels at Taksim
2) noticed showers in IST has a half door which leads to the floor being wet. However, the bathroom is super tiny, so one day the room got soaked. The staff cleaned it immediately
3) Wi-Fi is a little slow
Overall, I would recommend this hotel/Airbnb

A nice, neat and clean hotel. The staff very helpful and very friendly. Not far to taksim 5 minutes walk away with nice and cozy restaurants. We will definitely visit this hotel again when we are in Istanbul. We were received very nicely, a top receptionist is very personable sahra.

I never leave negative reviews but this time I had no choice, I dont want someone else to even have the slight chance of the experience we had at this place.
Firstly, we didn’t have hot water for both nights of our stay. We called the lobby & they said it would be fixed within the hour. But when I showered later that night, the water running was still freezing cold. Secondly, the hotel room wasn’t equipped with toilet roll. Lastly, things kept falling apart in the room. The toilet flusher was not functional so we had to pull the plug manually. Despite, the room was clean & had a beautiful view. I would not come back again.

Our stay at ROE SUITES was good and value for money. The location is convenient, although not the cutest neighborhood of Istanbul, as it is very busy. The stuff was very friendly and helped us with everything we needed. They even helped us with transportation to the airport (they called a trustworthy taxi-driver). The room was nice and clean. It was a bit small but it was ok for 2 people. However, the bath towels were old and worn. Overall a good stay, that could be even better with small changes.

The location and price of this were hard to beat- absolutely ideal location for exploring the European side of Istanbul. Small things we noticed- there was only one roll of toilet paper and we had to ask for more instead of automatically being checked/ refilled, also there was not great lighting for makeup (I literally used a compact of my own and stood on balcony because it was impossible to do it in the lighting at either mirror. Also, there are no wine glasses so we were drinking our wine out of water glasses - not a huge deal but something to note! The balcony was absolutely stunning and made for an amazing place to watch sunset. Overall great stay with little things that could be done to improve!

description:
This is a truly unique apartment. It has many grand features from the 19th century, well-balanced with contemporary style and an astonishing original gilded ceiling. If you'll enjoy being in the midst of vibrant night-life yet close to daytime cultural highlights it's a great choice. Shared roof terrace access.

TimeOut Istanbul says "If you have just one night to spend in Istanbul, spend it on Nevizade Sokak". You can spend as many as you like: you'll be just 50m from Nevizade Sokak.

reviews.text:
Let me make sure I explain everything as clear as possible. I will address issues that other guest had that We over looked. First of all let me make sure I say that me and my wife are very adaptable with any situation so i consider ourselves to be very easy to please.
Noise: big problem!!! Music does Not stop until 4-5 am!!! I was able to sleep with earplugs perfectly, but I say is a big problem because the host does not try to fix the problem, the air conditioner ( if you are going in summer like we did) is a portable air conditioner ( not a split unit or a window unit ) portable means that you need to open your window and install a tube for the hot air to come out, this tube does not make the window air tight so a lot of noise will come in. If you are a light sleeper please choose another property you will not be able to sleep at all.
The surroundings: well during the day is a perfectly safe place to be, but at night is another completely different thing, from drug addicts to drunks, to kids selling anything!!! ( THIS IS NOT THE HOST FAULT, IS JUST THE AREA) But if you are going to sleep like we did around 10 you won’t find any problems at night. Later than that anything can happen :). There is a lot of night life, when I say a lot I mean a lot!!!! We did enjoy the night life but never stayed too late out.
The place: ok... the host did an amazing job with the pictures. I’m not saying is not what the pictures show, I’m saying that this is a very old and outdated place, needs a bit of work. Wall painting are faded, crown moldings need retouching, wooden floor needs retouching. I get that they want to make it feel like old ( I guess) but it still needs some fixing. Room door was broken, we ended up using a kitchen cloth to be able to keep the door closed( it had no lock to keep it closed ) ( to be fair with the host I didn’t mentioned anything to them)
Appliances : they have about anything you need, don’t think you are going to be cooking a full Turkish dinner , but the kitchen was acceptable, and clean( no microwave) fridge small about the same size you get in a hotel.
Location: is in a good location close to almost everything but we used Uber-taxi( make sure you use Uber taxi, the taxi drivers are thieves )all the time taxis are cheap !!

Superb! We were delighted with our stay at Pera!Place and would definitely choose to return here when we come back to Istanbul. With a last minute booking at a busy time of year Julia helped us make arrangements for our stay so everything went smoothly. The transfer service from the airport and the very helpful Monika welcomed us into the appartment. The team were always super friendly and on hand to help with any questions and reply to email / phone rapidly.
This is truly a culture rich stylish appartment that put us straight into the Ottoman mind set and felt cozy and yet quite palatial with the high ceilings and beautiful renovated features. The photos dont do it justice. Everything needed for a comfortable stay is provided and made it a home from home while here.
The location is perfect. You are in the very centre of the hip and fun part of Beyoglu. Within a 30m radius there are numerous clubs, bars and restaurants. Most bars have live music and the constant flow of people and mix of sounds make this a very visceral experience. Needless to say it is a noisy part of town and full of life at all hours, which we loved. Directly opposite the front door you have a classic turkish buffet / takeaway with very cheap 24/7 fresh hot food that is tasty and gave us a staple diet when eating in (it's constantly full of locals and number 1 in beyoglu on trip advisor!) next door is a lovely bakery, so have delicious smell of bread in the morning. Several shops for all essentials within a few feet. Can't emphasise enough how welcome a variety of places to go there are within a few minutes walk.
Transport links close by so can get to old city etc very easily, or walking there is only 30mins.
This was our first time in Istanbul and our first stay with airbnb and Julia and Tarkan. We can't wait to repeat the experience and highly recommend it.

The location was fantastic!
Even though it is tempting to lock yourself inside this palace, turn the heating on, drink wine and watch the street, I urge you to wonder around!!
The apartment itself was incredible, a clean and absolutely stunning apartment with plenty of space. I understand the complaint of noise however all is forgiven in the morning, when the apartment fills with the smell of bread from the bakery downstairs!

Taskin is an amazing host and Julia and Tarkan were very prompt and helpful in correspondence. I would certainly stay here again !
If you're looking for somewhere to relax, to wind down after busy days in a busy city, a place where you can lie in and not feel guilty, this is the place for you !!

We stayed for a week during the end of ramadan including the celebration.
The apartment is perfect for you if you want: beautiful historic details, a cozy bed, flawless bed lines and towels, good heating, great water pressure and the smell of freshly baked bread from the bakery close by.
You might want to look for another option for your stay if you mind: (very!) loud noises during the night (clubs, big trucks, taxis honking), a (very) light smoke smell in the whole apartment, or a newly renovated shower.
We liked the kindness and help from the hosts; they were great and thought about a lot how to make the apartment a great deal. The price is more than fair!

Julia, Tarkan and Taskin were very friendly and helpful. Super quick to reply to emails.
The apartment was full of character and well set up, clean and comfortable.
The roof terrace could be fantastic but is not really set up to spend any time on
My main concern was that the apartment is noisy - partying till 4am then the garbage trucks. They provide ear plugs and you can close the doors so that sleeping is ok but if you are spending any other time in during the evenings it is very loud, particularly if there is a football game. I guess this is a tradeoff for location as it is very close Istiklal st, but the issue is that there are a lot of nightclubs and pubs nearby. If you are in Istanbul to party then its great - I was there for a conference and I could walk to the congress centre which was nice. Overall good value but be prepared for the noise.

description:
Welcome to our accommodation in Istanbul, in the historic district of Fatih.

Located on the 5th floor, close to historic sites such as the Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar and Hagia Sophia.

Enjoy free tea and coffee in your room.

Small sea view.

Just 400 meters from our accommodation, you will find a T1 tram stop, providing convenient access to the city's main sights and attractions.

reviews.text: The apartment was cozy and clean, the sea view from the balcony was fantastic, and the location was absolutely perfect for exploring the area. Mustafa was very helpful and even offered us transportation to and from the airport, which made our trip easier. However, small disadvantage might be the fact, that’s on the 5th floor with no elevator, and the bed wasn’t the most comfortable, but the apartment was equipped with everything we needed for our stay. Overall, the price-to-value ratio is reasonable for what you get.

Konaklamam genel olarak oldukça iyiydi. Ev rahat, temiz ve konforluydu. Balkon/teras alanı vardı ve manzarası da güzeldi. Oda içerisinde çay, kahve ve su gibi ikramlar düşünülmüştü. Banyo, çarşaflar ve havlular oldukça temizdi.
Konum olarak da çevresi rahattı ve turistik yerlere yakın olması avantaj sağladı. Fiyat-performans açısından da gayet uygundu. Mustafa Bey çok ilgiliydi; iletişimi hiç kesmedi ve her zaman hızlı şekilde geri dönüş yaptı.
Tek dezavantaj olarak dairenin 5. katta olması ve asansör bulunmaması söylenebilir. Ayrıca merdivenler oldukça dardı, bu nedenle bavul taşımak biraz zor oldu.
Konaklama deneyimim çok güzel geçti, İstanbul'a geldiğimde tekrar tercih ederim.

Great host! Very friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout the stay. The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well located. Everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out.
He also offered a great and very comfortable taxi service from and to the airport, which made everything stress-free. Throughout our stay, he was always checking if we needed anything, and whenever we did, he was quick to provide exactly what we needed. Even when we ordered deliveries, he informed us as soon as they arrived—at any time of day, even very late.
Highly recommended, and we would definitely stay again

This place was amazing.
The view from the balcony was breathtaking.
It was the perfect way to start the day sipping coffee and watching the sunrise and then enjoying the magnificent night views right before bed.
This lovely place is full of Istanbul charm and modern comforts. I loved everything about it.
The neighborhood was full of friendly and helpful people. My son enjoyed playing street soccer with the kids.
The host is very helpful, responsive, and generous, in providing many extra amenities: instant coffee, great quality bedding, umbrellas, and trying to help whenever he can.
This has been one of the best Airbnbs I stayed in when it comes to location and quality in the Fatih area.
I plan to stay here again when I come to the area.
Please note the spiral staircase is cute and fun but might pose an accessibility challenge for some. I felt the view was worth the climb every single time.

Very nice and cozy apartment. It is not large, there is space for a bed and a table with a freedge under it, but the bed is very comfortable. It also has a balcony with an amazing view.
Very clean, the owner left me instructions on how to enter it. The location is excellent, you can walk to the main attractions in Istanbul (which I did) or you can easily go to the tram station to go wherever you want. The blanket is very warm, which whas important because it was very cold in Istanbul when I was there.
The shower is amazing, it is really good!
The only negative aspect I can think of is that you have to climb some stairs in the building to reach the apartment. If you have a heavy bag, that may be a problem. But, if you, like me, travel with a backpack only, it is not a problem at all.
I definitively recommend the place.

description:
ENG

Large, and peaceful House located in one of the most pleasant also center neighborhoods in Buyukada

reviews.text: Mustafa is a nice host and the residence is comfortable and sweet. it's very easy to locate, didn't require any climbing to get there. the apartment in the second floor. the location is really good, close to the main streets but not to close so it is quite. its easy to take a walk from there to any parts of the island. we'll definitely recommend it.

Contacting Mustafa was easy and he was friendly and helpful. The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed. It was well positioned within a 10 minute walk of the ferry port, shops and restaurants. It was homely and comfortable and was perfect for our family visit. We had a great time.

Mustafas place was amazing. A block away from all the restaurants with a peaceful front yard. The islands themselves were absolutely stunning. Mustafa was very helpful and gave lots of local recommendations. The place was clean, nice and peaceful for an amazing price. I can’t say enough good things about this place and would love to visit again!

Konaklamamız cok güzeldi Mustafa bey cok nazik ve ihtiyaclarimiz konusunda cok hassastı. Evin icerisi antika ve otantik eşyalarla kaplı buna ragmen rahat ve kullanışlı modern mobilyalar da mevcut. Estetik zevk gözetilmiş bir tasarım kesinlikle. Evin içinde aklımıza gelen gelmeyen her türlü şey mevcuttu. Evin konumu(adanın merkezine 2 dk vapur iskelesine 4 dk uzaklik yuruyusle) ve güneş alıyor olması ferah olmasıysa ayrica bizi cezbetti. Kesinlikle tekrar gelmeyi düşünecegim bir adres; hem rahat hem keyifli bi ev deneyimi için herkese öneririm.

Awesome place and a wonderful owner ready to help with any questions. Great location literally a couple of minutes from the center and a 24/7 store. There were no problems with the internet the speed is around 25-30, which is quite enough for work and rest. The apartment has everything you need to relax, a great balcony with seating and a beautiful view of the garden.
I highly recommend staying here!

description:
Hideaway in the heart of City 🌾

Step into a world where creativity meets comfort at my Boho-inspired home. Nestled in the heart of Bagdat Street, walking distance to Marmaray, Sea Side. Step outside to our sun-drenched patio, where bohemian living extends into the great outdoors with all green private garden. Also well-equipped kitchen invites you to channel your inner foodie.

Willing to host you soon!

reviews.text:
Location is great, close the train station and to bagdad street. Clean house and cute garden. I had asked Sercan if he had a private parking lot before renting the apartment and he said yes, when I arrived and asked again he said that it wasn't available because he had parked his own car. One of the reason why I rented the place was the private parking lot..(which I didn't get obviously) I had to search for a parking lot for a rental car EVERY night.( I had to reckon with scratches) When I arrived and unlocked the apartment door the alarm went off and it was insanely LOUD. when I called sercan he said that he forgot to turn the alarm off. couldn't watch cable tv, couldn't watch netflix because the internet was SLOW. there's no dryer! Before leaving the apartment I checked the checkout time and it said 12pm. at 11pm a lady stood in the garden and said that she was here for cleaning. we were shook. I would have been very pleased if sercan could have called or texted me a day before leaving to inform me about everything but he didn't bother.
Evin konumu güzel, marmaraya yakın bağdat caddesine yakın. her şey ayağınızın altında. Ev tertemizdi, bahçesi güzel. Sercan bey'e otopark var mı diye sormuştum evet demişti sonra eve vardığımda otoparkı sorunca müsait olmadığını bana veremeyeceğini söyledi. evi kiralamamın sebeplerinden biri oydu ve maalesef olmadı. her gece kiralık arabaya park aramak zorunda kaldım. eve girer girmez alarm çaldı ve aradığımda kapatmayı unuttuğunu söyledi, bütün apartman ayağa kalktı. televizyon çalışmadı netflixe girip film izleyemedik, internet çok yavaş olduğundan bir türlü açılmadı. evde kurutma makinesi yok. airbnb'den evden çıkmadan check out saatine baktım ve 12 yazıyordu saat 11:15te temizlik için biri geldi ve şaşırdık. sercan bey önceden iletişime geçseydi benimle çok daha iyi olurdu hepimiz için.

The apartement is even lovelier than in the pictures. It is an oasis in the middle of Istanbul. We loved the brekfast in the lovely, quiet garden. Its clean, and completely free of smell from sigaretts and huminity.
The apartement is located in the best area in the Asian side of Istanbul. It offers an authentic Turkish stay. Closed to grocerys stores, good restaurants, and a lot of shopping opportunities. Near the biggest shopping mall in Istanbul. Good transportation possibilities to other parts of Istanbul. We recomend it highly. The host was very helpful during our stay.

Except for the snafu finding the key to get into the apartment (the cleaner had moved things around) our stay at Sercan's apartment was above expectations. It was a quiet, private neighbourhood. The apartment was new and uncluttered but not without artistic touches. The sofas and beds were comfortable. There are inside and outside blinds to keep out light for sleeping and the area is very quiet. The locks and security on the doors were topnotch. The metro station was only 4 blocks away and was about 6 stops to where all the tourist action is in Istanbul. There were great restaurants and bakeries and corner stores. Do not miss having a Turkish breakfast at Ethem Efendi Kahvalti, 2 blocks from the apartment. We also ate twice at Mis Uludag Doner Lahmacun ve Pide about a 10 minute walk away. After travelling for 2 weeks we really appreciated having a place where the 3 of us could spread out and do laundry. We Highly Recommend!

My family fell in love with this place.
This is a perfect flat where we were in absolute safe and comfort.
Big, modern and bright flat with garden in center of Istanbul.
Atmosphere inside and outside is amazing. Calm and friendly neighbours.
All technic, kitchen devices and furniture are new.
Two entrances to the terrace.
Terrace with cozy chairs was our favourite coffee area on mornings and red wine on evenings.
Stable fast Wi-Fi (more than 120 mbps).
Heating system for cold days.
Perfect LG Smart TV with deep bass sound bar for music lovers and Netflix funs.
Working place with extra 32” monitor.
Sir Sercan (host) was online for us almost 24/7. Honest, kind, helpful and gentle person.
Absolute relaxation.
We will definitely come here again!

Sercan's apartment was excellent. It had all the amenities listed, and they worked well. Check in and check out were super smooth. The location is great. The apartment is close to many things, including a short walk to the nearby Marmaray station. The place is well laid out, giving plenty of space for over a week's stay. The grass and garden were lovely to see out the window. I do note, however, that the seats on the outdoor patio were too dirty--darkened from filth and covered in cat hair to sit on. This, unfortunately, limited our use of the patio.

reviews.text: Konumu güzel,ev sahibi ilgili manzara muhteşem fiyatı biraz abartılı buldum.Yakınlarda otopark mevcut toplu taşımayada çok yakın bir lokasyon.Mutfakta ihtiyaç duyduğumuz bazı ürünler eksikti.Banyolarda duş jeli ve havlular yeterli kalitede bulmadım.Büyük yatak odası konforlu iyi bir uyku deneyimi oldu.Kendi evimizde olan bazı olanakların eksik olmasına rağmen genel olarak memnun kaldım.Banyo ürünleri ve mutfakta eksikler giderilmeli.

We absolutely loved our two-week stay here! ✨ The location is simply unbeatable — right on the water with an incredible, front-row view of the Bosphorus. Waking up to that view every morning was truly something special. 🌊
We lived here for two weeks and the apartment really felt like a home away from home. It’s super cozy, beautifully designed, stylish, and has such a cool atmosphere and character. The combination of the amazing location and the stunning view made our stay in Istanbul unforgettable.
The host was also fantastic — always easy to reach, super friendly, helpful, and available whenever we needed anything. That made the whole experience even more comfortable and stress-free.
We honestly couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Istanbul. We’d absolutely come back and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a beautiful, cozy place with an unbeatable Bosphorus view. 10/10!

The place was safe, comfortable, and well located, with a gorgeous view of the Bosphorus bridge. The house was clean and fully equipped with anything we needed. Communication with the host was great as well, very responsive and was able to answer all of our questions

First, that was my very first booking through Airbnb as usually I prefer hotels. But as this time was quite different, and I needed kitchen and cosy space for some time, this flat made it perfectly suited for me and my mum. I was in recovery after serious surgery and I was so happy with my choice , and honestly just that apartment made me feel relaxed in that noisy and busy city:) Nearly 20 days I almost didn’t leave the apartment and I was quite happy to stay in. Could just spend hours looking out the incredible views. Everything what you need is there. The style of it so interesting and you can see how creatively and with pleasure it was done. The hosts are the cutest souls and will definitely come back to them :)

This apartment was absolutely perfect—very cozy yet modern, with the most breathtaking view of the Bosforus! After a long day exploring, watching the Bosphorus at night, from the coziness of this place, was truly a next-level experience.
The space was incredibly comfortable and felt just like home, not like a typical Airbnb—it had everything we needed and more.
The host was wonderful and always available, even late at night, which made us feel very well taken care of. The location couldn’t be better, with both the tram and ferry stations just a 5-minute walk away. We genuinely loved our stay and would come back in a heartbeat.
Highly recommend!

description:
Enjoy easy access to popular stores and restaurants from this charming accommodation. Our new houses, which are 75 meters from the American hospital and within walking distance of Maçka Park and the congress center, are modern and designed with all your needs in mind.
In Nişantaşı, the heart of Istanbul, it is our greatest happiness to give you the comfort and confidence of your home

reviews.text:
