What can I say? Location is everything and this place couldn't be any better.
With amazing bakeries, restaurants, and shops immediately surrounding the building, it's impossible to resist the delicious Turkish cuisine.
We've stayed at unit #3, which is a 1 bedroom and is exactly as in the pictures, adequate and basic, but comfortable... the kitchen could've been better equipped for those who'd like to cook and eat in... It faces the back courtyard, which makes the unit quite away from the bustling street below.
The staff is friendly and helpful, and they're available 24/7 via the phone.

I had a wonderful experience staying at this lovely apartment in Nişantaşı! The location is unbeatable, nestled in one of Istanbul’s most vibrant and chic neighborhoods, with trendy cafés, boutiques, and restaurants just steps away. The apartment itself is beautifully decorated, clean, and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the overall ambiance made me feel right at home.
Communication with the host was seamless—they were responsive, helpful, and made sure I had everything I required throughout my stay. The check-in process was smooth, and the attention to detail in the apartment was evident from the moment I walked in.
If you’re looking for a stylish, comfortable place to stay in Istanbul with easy access to all the best spots, I highly recommend this apartment. I can’t wait to come back and stay here again!

The apartment is located in a lovely area in Istanbul , nice restaurants and cafés and pharmacies just few meters walking distance.
Nisantasi mall and nice vibes around.
The staff were always there to help and assist us kindly .
A nice detail was finding a 1lt bottle of water on our first day.
Comfortable bed and lovely lighting.
Nice shower and the kitchen has what is necessary to enjoy an indoor breakfast or even a quick lunch.
Air conditioning and lift are great facilities.
Loved the sofa and the privacy of the flat.
Highly recommended! :)

Murat place is just as it looks in the pictures: tidy, small, and clean. It's definitely bigger than a hotel room which is a plus. We spent there only 1 night and everything was okay apart from a very uncomfortable bed (both I and my husband couldn't sleep at all) and the very loud noise of some construction or street work outside.

description:
Our house is a 3-minute walk from Istiklal Avenue and Şişhane Metro Station...
You'll be right in the middle of the city with easy access to shopping, good food and easy transportation.
This is a 2-bedroom house with all the necessary equipment you need to feel comfortable...
High-speed WI-FI: large air conditioner, TV, dishwasher in the living room, washing machine in the bathroom, etc. all items are available...
In short, you just need to bring your personal belongings...

reviews.text: We stayed at Devrim’s apartment for 7 days. There were 5 of us, and the apartment was very comfortable and clean. It had everything we needed. We especially liked the location — it’s just a 6–7 minute walk to Taksim Street, which was very convenient. There are also plenty of grocery stores nearby. Devrim was very helpful and allowed us to check in early and check out late, which we really appreciated. We’re very grateful and would definitely recommend this place to everyone!

Devrim is real superhost with nice, clean apartment in the heart of Istanbul, it’s just 5 minutes walk to famous Istiklal street and 8 minutes to Sisane Metro station. Literally downstairs you can find small shop with fresh fruits and veggies, drinks and all you need. We really enjoyed our stay in this beautiful place.

Devrim place Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. A good bed and nice bathroom,
at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awesome bars and restaurants. His place is great, very clean and has everything you need. Devrim was also very helpful since the beginning, available at all times whenever I had any questions. Totally recommend it.
Everything was as described in his listing. Very responsive and easy to find. Clean house and easy access to wherever you need to go.

Host is super responsive and attentive at all times prior and during stay dates.
The place is beautiful and is exactly how discribed.
Definitely would recommend the place for everyone who wants to stay in Beyoglu/Istanbul for a great value.
Fantastic stay for 2 weeks!

description:
The flat is located in the Haseki Sultan area of the Old City. The area is surrounded by many historical landmarks. Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar are just some of them. Tram, metro and bus stops are just a 5-minute walk away. In addition, you can easily travel the whole Old City area with the tram line.

There are many restaurants and cafes near the flat. Historia Mall is also very close.

We are waiting for you to have a nice and comfortable stay.

reviews.text: While host is kind, place is not great. We had to change mattress as I started having red bite marks and itchiness (but host replaced the mattress and sheets from next door apartment). Toilet needs maintenance, stains at the shower area. Also had sewage smell. We dread returning home everyday as it was serious uphill climb, around 10mins walk from tram. Living room couch needs replacement too. Photos were taken by professionals with good lighting as the real place don’t look this cosy. Dining chairs are seriously uncomfortable too. And bed creaks badly everytime one of us turns during the night.

Buğra’s place was very cozy and comfortable, especially for families. The apartment has both a sofa and a bed, making it convenient for a small group like ours. We stayed there for 4 nights and really enjoyed it. The location is excellent -very close to Haseki tram station, which makes it easy to reach all the main attractions quickly. We also appreciated the thoughtful touches: Buğra and his attendant provided us with water, coffee, tea, salt, and pepper. These small details are very helpful, as they save you time upon arrival and make it easy to prepare something simple before doing a larger grocery shop.

This was my second time staying at Buğra’s. I had a very comfortable stay and found the flat exactly as described. The apartment was clean, quiet, and well organised, which made settling in easy. Communication with the Buğra was smooth throughout the trip, and check-in was simple thanks to the kind flat attendant Abdullah. The location is convenient for getting around and is very peaceful. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches and how well everything was maintained.

Host was very responsive and helpful, he let us check in early, when ever we need something he send his employee on time. Location is very good just 5 to 10 minute walk to Tram station ( Yusuf Pasa) grocery store is only 2 min walk, we loved enjoying there, only sofa bed is not comfortable i think need to change very soon, apartment have full kitchen including fridge and freezer, gas stove, and necessary utensils were there, this is our life time stay over in future. Apartment have iron with iron stand, and queen size bed in bedroom.

The apartment is in a quiet residential street in Fatih, just a 5 minute walk to the T1 tram which takes you into the heart of the Old City inside 10 minutes. The apartment is very clean, warm and comfortable. We spent 6 nights there, having been travelling for 17 days beforehand, and really appreciated the well equipped kitchen with large fridge, washing machine and good shower room. Istanbul is a wonderful city to visit, we went to the Cagaloglu Hamman to relax, Blue Mosque (free of charge with very welcoming staff), Hagia Sofia, Topikapi Palace (with a guide for the first hour, so much to see there), Pierre Loti hill and cable car (fabulous views) and Galata tower (1.5 hour queue, so we had a beer on terrace of adjacent hotel instead). We also took a cruise on the Bosphorus, landing on the Asian side and visiting the New Mosque where the call to prayer song was absolutely beautiful.

description:
Authentic Ottoman-style 2BR Apartment in Historical Istanbul.
Located on the main street of Kumkapı, Fatih — close to Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, and the Grand Bazaar.
Our 55m² cozy and stylish home features 2 bedrooms, a full kitchen, and a bathroom.
Perfect for families, couples, and travelers. We’re a family-run business with 30+ years of hospitality, offering warm, 24/7 support and a shared terrace with sea views.
Please note: the building does not have an elevator.

reviews.text: The home was simply unsuitable for a guest stay. We arrived to dirty smelly bedding, with large crusty stains on the bedspread, bugs in the sheets, stale cigarette smell, dirty bathroom, old food stains in kitchen, a broken air conditioner, no lighting in bathroom and overall dirty. Small bedroom window opens to a wall. Larger bedroom window opens to loud busy street. Located in the poor ghetto. In exploring the city, there are so many sweet neighborhoods with clean modern apartments for the same price being asked here. We did not stay and found so many better options for lodging that were clean and ready for new guest arrival, that we did not find here. Although we waited 5 hours for Barbaros to never arrive or respond, when he did he was gracious in addressing our concerns and allowing us a full refund.

My family and I had a wonderful two-night stay at Barbaros’s apartment in Fatih, Istanbul. The apartment had great wifi, air conditioning and a washing machine. There was a full kitchen and a large fridge but we didn’t use it. The place was clean and comfortable. The location was a busy section with great, unpretentious dining and shopping. It’s walking distance from the Grand Bazaar and the tram, which can take you to Sultanahmet, where the Hagia Sofia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and the basilica cistern are located. Most of all, Barbaros was a wonderful host who kept in touch and let us store our luggage for a day while we went sightseeing and then arranged for a large taxi to take us to the airport. He also has flexible cancellation and there were no issues when I had to change my reservation twice due to a change in plans. A great stay! Thank you!

It was our first Airbnb experience. Mr. Barbaros’s «NiceFamily Apartment Pashas Suite 2» was great! Rooms (one living room with bed, one bedroom, bathroom and kitchen) are same like the photos. Here is everything you need – electric kettle, washing machine, electric cooker, hairdryer etc. Apartment was comfortable and clean, service was unobtrusive and good too. «Pashas Suite» must be recommended for all couples and families, who seek quiet, independent vacation in a good area of the city Istanbul (tram station «Beyazit» is near, maybe 10 minutes unhurried pace). All the must-see places of historical Istanbul (Hagia Sophia, Cemberlitas, Blue Mosque, Suleymaniye Mosque etc.) are very close to the apartment. The neighborhood preserves the atmosphere of old traditional Turkey with kind and friendly people, lovely corners of old city and lots of authentic restaurants and cafes. My husband and I are very thankful to Mr. Barbaros and wish him good luck and many nice guests of course ;)
Это был наш первый опыт использования Airbnb. Квартира «NiceFamily Apartment Pashas Suite 2» господина Барбароса замечательна! Комнаты (одна гостиная с кроватью, одна спальня, ванная комната и кухня) такие же, как на фотографиях. Здесь есть все необходимое – электрический чайник, стиральная машина, электрическая плита, фен и т.д. Квартира была комфортной и чистой, сервис был ненавязчивым и хорошим. Мы рекомендуем «NiceFamily Apartment Pashas Suite 2» для всех пар и семей, которые ищут спокойный, независимый отдых в хорошем районе города Стамбул (станция трамвая «Беязыт» находится рядом, может быть 10 минут неспешным шагом). Все места исторического Стамбула, которые необходимо обязательно посмотреть (Айя-София, Чемберлиташ, Мечеть Султанахмет, Мечеть Сулеймание и т.д.), находятся очень близко к квартире. Окрестности сохраняют атмосферу старой традиционной Турции с добрыми и приветливыми людьми, прекрасными уголками старого города и большим количеством аутентичных ресторанов и кафе. Я и мой муж очень благодарны г-ну Барбаросу и желаем ему удачи и много хороших гостей, конечно ;)
П.С. для гостей из России: отопление в квартире весьма скромное, не как в российских квартирах, зимой можно замерзнуть, так что берите с собой теплые пижамы :) также у вас могут возникнуть проблемы с сотовой связью (у меня МТС напрочь отказался работать), так что предусмотрите это. Ну и, конечно, держите номер телефона Барбароса всегда под рукой.

Place is very clean and tidy. Everything as in the photos. All the historical sites are walking distance. Restaurants and supermarkets are at your doorstep. Barbaros is super host who met us on arrival and gave great tips. A lady comes everyday for cleaning. If anyone planning to stay in Sultanahmet highly recommend this place.

Best host ever!!! Honestly we only have great things to say about our stay.
The place was beautiful, clean, comfortable and really close by walking to all the most important places to visit in Instambul.
Plus they have a great restaurant downstairs (I recommend the eggplant with yougurt garlic and tomatoe, one of the best flavors I’ve ever tasted).
And the attention was amazing, they explained everything, borrowed us a subway card, arranged the transport from the airport, and gave us all the information and tips we needed.
Plus to that I wanted to bring that eggplant plate to Spain cuz I loved it so much, the gave me a topper with a lot of it and wouldn’t charge me for it.
So if you’re thinking on going to Estambul, stay here.

description: Our cool and comfortable one bedroom apartment has been delicately designed and decorated for you to feel home comfort accommodation in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Huseyin and the whole Kaya family have been so gracious, kind, available and more than helpful to us for absolutely anything and everything we needed. They have gone above and beyond any standard requirement to make us feel welcome and comfortable, even helping us to figure out certain administrative issues and finding us a Municipal Map to help us pin-point our location in the city! They have made sure that everything in the apartment is working well and that it is well stocked with linens. The apartment is clean, airy and light, and in a nice neighborhood close to shopping, cafes and restaurants. There is a metro station and a large mall with everything in it from stores to groceries to a cinema, about 20 minutes away on foot. The metro makes getting around the city very easy. It is a wonderful place to stay - highly recommended!!!

one of the cleanest houses i have ever lived in. with a spacious living room, also a fully equipped kitchen. about 20 minutes walk, to the nearest metro and a big mall. Huseyn & His nephew, Said so kind.
Five of five star~ ✨

I actually rented another place but was assigned a different apartment in the same building - just one floor up. Fortunately, the layout was almost identical, which I appreciated since I had specifically chosen the original unit for its furniture style. The hair dryer was broken (everything else was perfectly fine), though I didnt need to use it. Still, it would have been good if they had checked it in advance. The apartment was clean, though not spotless. We had everything we needed for our two week stay. The location suited my needs well.
Communication was excellent. I could easily reach out for any requests, and they were very kind in allowing me to check out an hour later.
Overall, I’d recommend it.

The apartment is nice and I enjoyed my stay
The host is great
The apartment is 15 minutes walk from the Metro

Great place for a longer stay. We've spend 2 weeks there and didn't miss anything. Anything we needed, the host supported with immediately. Great ratio quality/price.
Highly recommended!

description:
3 Bedroom
We work as a family for people's satisfaction.Since we are close to you, you will feel us by your side whenever you need it.
This place between Taksim Square end Bosphorus.
You can walk Taksim Square in 5 minutes by walk , and you can see Bosphorus in 3 minutes by walk distance.
You can go Blue Mosque , Sultanahmet and all historical place in 10 minutes by tramway.
You can go Anatolia by ship in 10 minutes.
It will take you 10 minutes to go to the entertainment centers in the evening.

reviews.text: Tolga was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable, but personally, I think one bathroom (combining a toilet and shower) isn't sufficient for eight people. The location was perfect for exploring the city, but it's important to note that the access route from Taksim Square to the accommodation has a steep incline, which might pose challenges for older or less physically fit individuals. I would highly recommend this Airbnb to young people seeking a cozy and convenient place to stay.

Tolga was very responsive and helpful. Great host and place! Great location. The rooms were clean and beds were comfortable.
The area where it is located is bustling and had too many things to do and see🤩

Tolga's apartment has great facilities. At first glance, the winding apartment looks smaller than it is. But every room has enough space and a nice interior. You feel very comfortable and just the many beds make it possible that really a maximum of eight people can find a place to sleep. The location is also perfect. Within ten minutes you can get to the streetcar or the ferry port. Shopping facilities are also within easy reach. Tolga is a great and accommodating host who will point you to events within the city or organize a cab to the airport if you ask him. I can recommend anyone to be his guest.

The place was as shown in the pictures.. we were 7 adults with 2 babies and there was plenty of room for all of us. We'd asked for an extra floor mattress and a crib and both were kindly provided. The place had the all amenities listed..
Tolga was there at check-in, helped us in and gave us a tour of the place. He was super friendly and made us feel welcome. He was also quickly to respond whenever he was needed to reach him.
The location was perfect: mostly quiet street, very close to Taksim sq. and ALL transportation. The only downside was that we needed to climb a steep hill to reach Taksim sq and MOST public transportation. This was only inconvenient since we had babies and 2 60+ members.. Otherwise it wouldn't have been a problem.
Overall, we're all very satisfied with our stay!

First time i book an Airbnb, the place looks exactly like in the pictures, the apartment is very spacious, calm neighborhood, accessible to many areas and public transport.
Hamdi was a very friendly host very down to earth, you feel like you know him from before, always responsive and ready to help and guide you throughout your stay.
Thank you Hamdi for this lovely stay and hopefully will book with you in future when come back to Istanbul.

description: Totally new renovated in the heart of old-town Istanbul!

reviews.text:
Batuhan was kind, responsive, and attentive when we needed help. The woman who cleaned the space was a sweetheart!
Location:
Great for exploring Sultanahmet, close to Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and the water for peaceful morning walks. The tram is just minutes away and public transit was so easy and cheap.
Note: close proximity to any mosque means the call to prayer will ring LOUD, which is culturally unique throughout the day but earplugs needed throughout the night.
The Space:
Bright with beautiful windows, a comfy bed, and strong AC. It’s very small and ideal for just one person. For two people, I’d only recommend one night. There’s space for coffee, tea, or wine, but no kitchen or meal needs beyond that.
We’d recommend it for a short stay. Thanks again, Batuhan!

Wow!!!! Thank you! The place is truly amazing!!!! Very nice and clean, Spacious, and located in one of the best touristic area within Istanbul. it is within walking distance to the Metro station which would be able to take you everywhere. I have visited Turkey many time, I have stayed in all different places, this place is the best by far from anywhere else. Everything one or two station away!!! no need for taxis to move around when you are staying here!
First, the photo are accurate, not a stretcached view where it does not reflect the actual size of the place, the place is big, your room in a floor by itself, so no worries about other being in the same floor with you.
the place is fully renovated, the bathroom is stunning beautiful and the place is super super clean.
the Host is very friendly, kind and very helpful, give you your personal space, does not force his present. Very aware and give excellent suggestions. When i come back to Turkey, I know where i am going to stay!

I had an amazing stay at Batuhan's place in Sultanahmet, Istanbul. The location was perfect—peaceful yet surrounded by beautiful mosques, restaurants, and close to the metro. The apartment was clean, with a super comfortable bed and pillows, hot shower, and Netflix for a relaxing night in, + water and tea upon arrival. Batuhan was a great host, very responsive and friendly. I truly enjoyed my vacation and would highly recommend this spot!

Ok so let me break this down into parts!
First I’ll start with the room itself! It’s exactly like the pictures. Beautiful and spacious and EXTREMELY clean! The bathroom is gorgeous and large and it made me feel like I had my own personal spa!! The room has a tv with WiFi and Netflix and it came with water and coffee ! Absolutely perfect! Simply perfect!
Next I’ll talk about the location. The room is in the heart of the old city! So you can literally walk to the blue mosque and Hagia Sophia and all those attractions in under 10 minutes! It’s incredible! Also there’s a plethora of restaurants and bars near the room.
Now I’ll talk about Batuhan! Batuhan was an amazing host! He organized a shuttle to AND from the airport for me. He also provided me with water. He even showed me around a bit when I first got there. He also took me to the ferry one day! He was always extremely responsive and always ready and willing to help! He’s the shining example of what a host should be!

Rundown versus the photos. Ants in the bathroom were gross. The bathroom is not nice like the photos showed — cracked sink, bad lighting, poor shower water, etc. The bed was comfortable & great location. They did not clean the room daily & did not leave enough shampoo or toilet paper.

description: Experience the city center from this peaceful, elegant, fully renovated historical flat. Step into a chic oasis of comfort, and relax with a cup of coffee after a day of exploring the cultural center of İstanbul. Walking distance to the Taksim Sq (400 meters), İstiklal St (350 mt) and at the center of the transportation hub; this bright, spacious 3 br 2 bath, high ceiling apartment is designed and equipped to address all possible needs with its rich amenities list and welcome basket.

reviews.text:
Yalin apartment was indeed one of the more beautiful airbnb’ i have stayed in. We were a group of 5 people and it was a pretty n spacious space for us. The apartment was on 3rd floor but the walk up was not very hectic as staircase was spacious and it had was a steep climb as we had to move our luggage also so dint feel the pressure and yalin helped us with our bags also.
He was a great and very helpful host to start with. Gave us a detailed list of things and places to go and check in was very smooth. Even helped us booking our taxi for airport at reasonable prices.
The place is at a great location a min walk to istiklal but yet in quiet locality. A perfect location. Restaurants, cafe, shopping, daily needs shop was all at walkable distance. The house is as described in the pictures, very neat, newly renovated, with french windows and aesthetically done. Would certainly live here again and recommend this place.

Please Just book Yalin’s place without hesitation.
The home is super clean and it gave us a feel of a hotel in a home. The beds, pillows, blankets were comfortable and toilets were clean and neat. Kitchen was well equipped and living room was so cosy to unwind after a long day.
The location was very convenient with loads of cosy restaurants and cafes. Supermarket just downstairs. 2 mins walk to the popular Istiklal Street which was such a lovely experience to be at. Communication with Yalin pre arriving till we left was on top form. I would definitely recommend everyone to stay here and if we visit Istanbul we will definitely stay here again!
Thank you Yalin!

Yalin definitely was a great host. He would go above and beyond to help you get settled. We had strange check-in and out times and he was pretty flexible and worked with us. As far as the apartment is concerned, it was definitely what was described. The apartment was pretty clean, and equipped with what you need to make it home. The location is also spectacular with only 5 minutes to walking distance to Metro and other local bars/restaurants. The only thing I would add is that there are some stairs to get into the place, which is typical of buildings in the Taksim neighborhood. But I think that it should be mentioned, especially if you plan to stay with your senior family there, like we did. But other than that, everything was great, and Yalin helped us every step of the way. Definitely would recommend staying here.

We stayed at Yalin’s place with my husband and 2.5 year old son and my senior parents. The apartment was very spacious to accommodate all of us, and we enjoyed some family meals at the big dining table and family time in the comfortable living room.
The space is just as described and what I expected from the photos. The kitchen had all the cooking utensils for preparing meals (my son has numerous food allergies, so we have to cook a lot when traveling). Some coffee pods and tea were greatly appreciated for that first morning in a new place.
Communication with Yalin was always great—he is always responsive and was very proactive about providing detailed check in instructions and suggestions on local points of interest.
Location is also great—close to Taksim square for metro connections or funicular down to T1 tram line to get over to Sultanahmet. And, of course, istiklal street is just around the corner.
Would not hesitate to stay at Yalin’s place in the future.

My friends and I had a great stay at Yalın's flat! Yalın was a thoughtful, responsive, and accommodating host. We ran into a water issue one night (a city issue, out of his control) and he was incredibly responsive, giving us instructions to see how we could fix the issue on our own and even offering to send his plumber-- the issue was very quickly resolved! The apartment itself was spacious, bright, and comfortable. The AC worked perfectly and it was a cool oasis for us after a long day. We also loved the neighborhood-- a cute and hip location that's easily accessible to more touristy locations. Overall we had a great time and would love to visit again. Thanks so much, Yalın!!

description:
Has Elevator , 1st floor at Taksim
We work as a family for people's satisfaction.Since we are close to you, you will feel us by your side whenever you need it.
This place between Taksim Square end Bosphorus.
Walk to Taksim Square in 5 minutes by walk , and you can see Bosphorus in 3 minutes walk distance.
You can go Blue Mosque , Sultanahmet and all historical place in 10 minutes by tramway.
You can go Anatolia by ship in 10 minutes.
10 minutes to go to the entertainment centers in the evening.

reviews.text: This apartment is very nice and clean. The location is very close to Taksim and Cihangir, easy walk to both, so is ideal for Istanbul. The living room has a good couch and table that you can work at. The bathroom and kitchen are clean and in good order. The air conditioning works well, as does the wifi. The bedroom is in the back so it stays quiet. Tolga is a very helpful host. I recommend this place!

The flat is very clean and nice, it has fast WiFi, lots of light, a good kitchen and bathroom. All amenities in the apartment are in working condition.
There is quiet outside despite the flat being located in the city center. The location is great!
The host is very attentive and responsive. Hamdi is a great host!

This was a beautiful apartment in great surroundings. Tram and bus stop in a few minutes, 7 minutes to Galataport shopping centre and Bosporus embankment. 10 minutes to Taxim and Istiklal street, but you need to go uphill. You can find tasty breakfast and coffee in the cafe in the same building. The apartment is very clean, it has all the necessary furniture and looks exactly like on the photo. Hamdi Tolga is a great host, he gave us local recommendations and helped with the transfer to the airport.

Hamdi is a very nice, kind and reliable host. Excellent location, close to Taksim and Galata Tower, within walking distance. Metro station is just 3 mins walk away.
Groceries are available nearby, Domino's is next door and is open until late at night. The stairs can be challenging though but take it as a workout after the good food you will enjoy on the streets :)

Tolga is the great host. We arrived earlier and he met us and let us check in earlier. Very friendfull :)
The apt also nice - clean and cozy. It placed in the center of the city, near the Taksim square with a lot of shops, transport spots etc. 10/10

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place.

*A luxurious and comfortable apartment
*For families.
*A place with a terrace and city view awaits you.

50 meters from Trump Shopping Center and Metro.

reviews.text: Clean and nice apartment, has all the kitchen equipment, towels and new bed sheets and very helpful and friendly staff also located in a very good area surrounded by shopping mall, supermarket and salon directly under the building

الشقة بدون أصنصير والدرج صعب الصور لا تظهر الحقيقة فالشقة صغيرة جداً واللحف غير جيدة وغير نظيفة المؤجر غير متعاون فيما يخص الحقائب عند المغادرة الشقة لا تستحق السعر المدفوع المؤجر يظهر عدم تعاونه خاصة بعد الوصول. لن أكرر التجربة.
على الرغم من تنظيفنا للشقة قبل المغادرة وهناك رسائل بيني وبين المالك تثبت ذلك
The apartment has no elevator and the stairs are difficult. The pictures do not show the truth. The apartment is very small and the blankets are not good and not clean. The owner is not cooperative regarding the bags upon departure. The apartment is not worth the price paid. The owner shows his lack of cooperation, especially after arrival. I will not repeat the experience.
Even though we cleaned the apartment before leaving and there are messages between me and the owner which approve that.

I want to start with how kind, responsive and respectful person Roni was as the person I’m communicating with is far more important than where I stay, it’s so far the best costumer service I’ve had. The place was exactly how it was described and the staff were amazing. A quit place to get well rested before an exam (my wife had a medical exam to take for residency). We were able to checkout even later than we were supposed to and if I was staying for longer in Istanbul I would’ve definitely stayed at this place. Very convenient and close to everything you need, restaurants, transportation…etc it’s for sure a five star place and I highly recommend it

Highly recommended.The aprtment is wonderful.exactly as it is in the photos.the location is good. We are satisfied and would stay there again. Ahmet was always responsive and made sure everything is okay until the end.

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev temiz, düzenli ve anlatıldığı gibiydi. Ev sahibi bizi çok sıcak ve samimi karşıladı, iletişimi de oldukça iyiydi. Konum ve genel olanaklar açısından da beklentilerimizi karşıladı. Güzel bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text:
Good and bad elements.
Good:
- Large unit with a kitchen, balcony
- Very comfortable beds
- Fast internet - 50 mbps
- Very responsive host (we need a clothes drying rack and a wine bottle opener and they were dispatched within a few minutes
Bad
- AC wasn't working properly, 18 or 25 C would have the same air temperature output
- Black mold on multiple silicone joints (shower, sinks)
