Overall an acceptable lodging, but a bit expensive given the negatives.

Ev ilanda gösterildiği gibiydi ve girişi çok kolaydı. Evin içerisi temiz, düzenli ve güvenliydi. Kendimi rahat hissettiğimi söyleyebilirim. Ev sahibi ise çok kibar biriydi ve sorduğum her soruda çok hızlı geri dönüş sağladı. Güzel bir deneyimdi benim için. Gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilirsiniz.
Ev fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi ve tertemizdi. Çok memnun kaldık. Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi.
The place is clean, very safe, I enjoyed my whole stay in Turkey, but the place is far from the tourist areas, you will need a car.
Her şey gayet yeterli tek sıkıntı ulaşım ve konumu

description:
Enjoy a luxurious stay in the heart of Istanbul then this is your place!
A cozy and luxurious apartment, naturally lighted, with an amazing view from the bedroom.
The apartment is a perfect place for couples or a small family of 3 and it's exactly walking distance from 212 outlet mall !

reviews.text: My mother and I had an awful experience at this Airbnb. The entire house was disgustingly dirty—the worst we have ever stayed in. The carpet, which appeared white in the photos, was actually grey with disgusting stains. The sofa bed was also stained, and the whole place looked like it hadn't been cleaned in ages. The flush didn't work, and there was a pervasive smoke smell. The house was filthy and dusty from the moment we arrived. Additionally, the host tricked us by saying the AC worked when it didn't. Thankfully, we received a full refund from Airbnb. Please DO NOT stay here!

A lovely stay – the flat was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. The host was kind and attentive, and the location was ideal. I would gladly return and highly recommend this place to others. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Our stay at Wassam’s place was pleasant, we did not complain about anything related to the apartment, they were so helpful and cooperative every time we have contacted them, they were answering right away, the apartment was super clean , the sleeping areas were really comfortable, very safe and quiet neighborhood and very close to a big supermarket and a good mall, we absolutely recommend everyone to book with Wassam. Thank you for your great hospitality. Iyi günler

I stayed in this apartment for two months and highly recommend it! The place is comfortable, well-equipped, and exactly as described.
The hosts were lovely — always available and attentive, which really made the stay enjoyable. Thank you again for your kindness!

The suite was comfortable with a nice balcony for relaxing. It was well-located, with easy access to public transport. I also want to thank the host Wassim for his clear instructions and friendliness. He was always quick to respond to any questions. Overall, it was a great stay, and I highly recommend it. Next time I visit Istanbul, I will definitely stay here again! :)

description: Have a location intertwined with the city center in my new generation, comfortable home. Easily access all public transportation networks. You're in the right place for the comfortable minimalist stay you've planned! Specially designed architectural structures and lighting will make you feel beautiful. Enjoy a luxury vacation in a home all to yourself.

reviews.text:
Burada harika bir konaklama geçirdim. Daire geniş, temiz ve ihtiyacım olan her şeyle donatılmıştı. Konum, metro istasyonuna yakın ve şehir merkezine ulaşımı kolaydı.
Halil süper bir ev sahibiydi, çok duyarlı ve yardımseverdi. Konforlu ve keyifli bir konaklama geçirmemi sağladı. İstanbul'da lüks ve rahat bir ev arayan herkese bu yeri şiddetle tavsiye ederim. Teşekkürler, Halil!

The apartment was absolutely amazing - very cozy, clean and with anything that is needed for comfortable living! The neighborhood is very nice and calm with several convenience stores close to the apartment. Overall that was a great experience and we definitely would stay there again once back to Istanbul :)
Ev sahibi Halil bey ilgiliydi.Ev fotoğraflarlarda göründüğü gibi kullanışlı ve temizdi.

Great apartment, it’s got everything one could need for a long-term stay. Washer, dryer, dishwasher, etc. No major problems with the unit.
The location was perfect for my needs, as I was staying here while my apartment in Maltepe was undergoing renovations. It’s located on a quiet residential street - I am a light sleeper and had no issues here.
Halil was a great host, very welcoming and responsive. Overall, I recommend this unit to anyone looking to stay in Maltepe.

Ailem ile konakladım. 2 yaşında kızım olduğu için temizlik konusunda ekstra bir hassasiyet duyuyor insan. Halil sağ olsun bu konuda çok özenmiş her şeyi temiz olmasına rağmen kızım için 2 kere yıkamış temizlemiş. İstanbul'da kendi evimde sıradan bir hafta sonu geçirir gibi geçirdim. Ev çok temiz, çok zevkli döşenmiş ve tasarlanmış. Mutfakta aradığınız her şey mevcut. ütüden çamaşır kurutma makinesine kadar koymuş Halil. Eğer bu yorumu okuyorsanız bence kesinlikle başka bir yere gitmenize gerek yok. Halil ile iletişime geçin gerisini o halleder. :)

description: in the center of Beyoğlu, with a magnificent view of Goldenhorn Marmara sea (Haliç). Panoramic sea view from a bedroom and living room. 15 minutes to Taksim, 3 minutes walking distance to the sea coast - restaurants and coffees - public transport, 8 minutes walking distance to the Miniatürk open air museum, 6 minutes walking distance to the Metrobus. Newly furnished and decorated 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, kitchen and bathroom. Fast WiFi

reviews.text: The apartment looks nice. The host communication is good. The sea view is amazing. However the area is in a local place on the hill so it is not very accessible and not easy to get a taxi unless you walk up the hill or down the hill. Everything looks good overall.

Mehmet is a great host and welcomed. Hospitality was great. Furniture was clean but the foor and the bathroom wasn't. Also there was a room which has a horrible smell and wasn't mentioned in the listing. Which made us to leave the place and cancel our order.
Mehmet is a very friendly host - always responsive and willing to help. His apartment has everything you need, is very clean and the view from the living room is spectacular.

Mehmet bey çok kibar ve anlayışlı birisiydi, geç kalmamıza rağmen bizi bekledi kendisine çok teşekkür ederiz. Evin manzarası çok güzel, ve ev kullanışlı temizdi.Mehmet beye Çok teşekkür ederiz , çok iyi bir ev sahibi

I would like to thank Mehmet for a wonderful apartment! Me and my friends loved it.
Opens a very beautiful view from the living room to the Golden Horn. Especially beautiful in the evening-night!
Quiet place with good cafes on the waterfront.
Mehmet is a very nice owner. You can ask him any questions and he will be happy to answer.
Very convenient accommodation!
Highly recommend!

description:
My apartment is located in the most central part of Istanbul, 5 minutes from Esteghlal Street and 10 minutes from Taksim Square.
Access to public transportation is very convenient.
Bus 1 minute / Tasim metro 10 minutes / Shishane metro 15 minutes / Dolmush 5 minutes
I will guide you to visit all the touristic and attractive areas of Istanbul.
If you are planning a family trip, I look forward to hosting you.

reviews.text: Tala oldukça nazik ve cana yakın ilgili birisiydi . Oldukça güzel bir yerdi , temiz bakımlı , muhit olarak Taksimin hemen dibi Tarlabaşı .

I had a flight to istanbul that got cancelled and I asked the host if he could
Cancel the reservation because we could only arrive 2 days later. He told us that it’s ok we didn’t need to cancel that we could arrive 2 days later but stay 2 days extra. Then missing 2 days for our booking to finish he message me saying. “You guys are checking out today right” pretending we never talked before. And asking us to check the booking on Airbnb. Such a scammer. Simply because he forgot to close the dates because of our deal. Then we needed to leave anyway the next day (1 day before what we supposed to do) as he had other people coming and we needed to find a place last minute. We are so disappointed that just decided to leave. Then we asked him to refund the money of the last day and that he could discount from the clothes he washed for. He charged 500tl when normally is 80tl saying that was too many clothes. I don’t like to give bad reviews. But this situation deserved it.
Thank you for the hospitality. The host was excellent and very nice

L'hôte est accueillant et disponible. L'intérieur du logement est propre malgré l'exiguité. L'environnement peu agréable et accidenté.
Je recommande à l'hôte de réunir les conditions pour faciliter l'accès à son site.
Note positive : On est à 3 minutes à pieds des meilleurs endroits d'Istanbul en termes de détente et d'achats des objets de souvenirs.
fue agradable mi estadía muy cerca de Taksim

description: You will be staying in the most active and lively environment by staying in this one-of-a-kind place.

reviews.text: Accomodation at Erkan's place was a great choice. For me as a solo traveller was really important to stay central for all my exploring activities and also to feel safe. As I work in tourism I know that many times pictures doesn't correspond to reality what awaits you but this time it was a very nice surprise for me and room did looks like on the pictures. It became my home :) for a week. You have plenty of restaurants close by, few minutes of walk to Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet, Topkapi or Gulhane park. Few minutes walk other direction and you can have lovely early morning walk on shores of Bosphorus. Just perfect. Erkan was also very helpful, especially on day of my departure when he managed very last minute car for me to take me to airport as one what I ordered didn't arrived. It literally saved me. Thank you very much for experience
This apartment was nice. The showerhead did not work properly and I let the host know and he immediately replaced it with a new shower head the same day! Host is very responsive and prompt.
Nice place
Posto semplice senza pretese ma perfetto per le mie esigenze. Personale super disponibile e cordiale, il must di questo posto!

Solo he estado 1 día, la habitación está bastante bien, pero no me gustó encontrarme un bicho en el baño.
Erkan contesta rápido y es flexible.
El alojamiento es fácil de encontrar y está bien ubicado para visitar mezquita de Santa Sofía por ejemplo.
:)

description: Our facility, which is a 4-minute walk from Galata Tower, has a small kitchen in every room and a terrace where you can spend your free time with your guests and a reception that always serves even in the curfew. We have a transfer service (VIP car to/from the Airport to the Facility. Breakfast is available and is only 5 euros. A small kitchen, minibar and seating or work area, each room has a TV, air conditioning. Turkish Bath and Parking area.

reviews.text:
If you look for a place to stay for a couple of days, cheap and central, this is your best option. If you look for a place to have some self made breakfast, stay more than 4 days, and have more space? I would not do it again. It was indeed a live-saver (we had to book last minute), but the description of the room was not accurate. I would recommend the hotel that if they offer a place to cook, they equip it with the basics (we didn’t have the basic). And to check on the pipes and repair them so the next guest won’t have the water problem we had.
Still, the person at the front desk was really helpful and ready to fix or clean anything.

The room is in a hostel, listed as self check in but it’s not and information were not sent ahead. I was all day with no access to my phone nor Internet and this made my check in complicated. I was instructed to walk t a certain addressed, and referee to a hotel. The hotel had no idea of the bnb, but the door of the assumed bnb was locked and without internet I could not communicate with the host.
The room was dirty, especially my bed sheets (as if bird or small pet had entered it) the toilet (mold walls) and the kitchen (small pieces of ceiling falling) . When I asked to change the bed sheets they said “later” (I checked in at 19:00 and wanted my privacy so latee when? Also I asked who would have come in to change as I was leaving in valuables. They first said no worries then “ok no actually better if you stay cause we don’t know”. Finally they came in to drop off the bed sheets so I could change them myself… (I asked them to, and kindly did it).
I do NOT recommend
Great location, close to the busier tourist streets but still peaceful. Clean and comfortable. Easy to check in and out, friendly and helpful host, would definitely stay again :)

we really enjoyed staying the night. the location was perfect and there were no problems at the check-in. sadly the warm water didn't work after the first two guests used the shower and there was a used panty liner in the bedside table.

It was good overall and there was a smell in the bathroom continues and host spread it, shower was leaking but host got is new hose pipe to fix it.
They were responsive

description:
We are located in the center of Şişli. There are many cafes, restaurants and shops in this area. Cevahir Mall and metro station are a 5-minute walk away. It is also close to well-known areas such as Taksim square, İstiklal street and Nişantaşı.

We are waiting for you in Şişli for a pleasant and comfortable stay.

reviews.text:
One star is for a beautiful interior, second one - for Rasim and his service and third one - for a lot of shops nearby.
Cons.
Walls are thin so get ready to stay together with people upstairs.
No view. It's not that not nice view. I am ok with courtyard though. It is not necessary to be a Bosphorus. But it's NO view. Windows covered so you will not be able to see anything. I would like to attach pictures but it is not allowed in the review. Actually it's my second time in Istanbul that I get nothing through windows. It's very sad that Turkiye finds tourists a little better than a trash.
No hot water at our first night. The time we spent together with two strangers trying to fix boiler.
Power outage has happened twice in 9 days. Knives are poorly sharpened.
Not crucial but nice to have scissors.

Good ; Location is good, most venues like mall, metro, groceries, restaurants are within walking distance. Very responsive host and very helpful staff at the reception.
Not so pleasant ; The sound proofing of the building is bad. You can hear very clearly when your upstairs' neighbour was walking or doing house chores.

Our stay in Bugra's place was more than satisfactory !!! It was magnificent! ! We spent 10 days and felt directly like home! The place is sparkling clean and very pleasantly decorated. So relaxing atmosphere! We had everything we needed for our stay as the place is very well equiped.
Located in the center of the Sisli area, from where one can get to all the touristic attractions by mini bus or metro and yet so quiet and peaceful. Great place to discover the city!
Special thanks to our hosts for being so easy to communicate with, so flexible and accommodating!! Highly recommended!

Positives:
- Very helpful and kind staff. Provided many amenities.
- Fixed all issues that arised swiftly.
- Grocery stores close by.
- Not too far from busses and metro.
Some things to note:
- Can be a bit loud upstairs since you can hear footsteps.
- The stove is on the weaker side which will lengthen cooking time. It is not too bad.

This my second being hosted by Bugra! And it’s always amazing to be here.
Very peaceful and clean and the assistance been always there for me which I appreciate it a lot!
I definitely recommend Bugra’s location great business man
Thank you for having me

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Friendly host with a nicely decorated home. Very clean, tidy and light space in a calm neighbourhood and walkable to the city center, metro station and train access. Nursema is very friendly though knowing turkish is a plus in order to communicate with her. Overall, great experience, definetly recommend.
Nursema home was super super clean and exactly like the pictures . plus the house is close to train metro and bus stations .

I stayed in Nursema’s space for a month and loved it. The room has a lot of privacy and is super clean. You get an enclosed balcony with a table and chair for work. Also, the WiFi was amazing, considering I’m a digital nomad. Nursema’s apartment was very nice and she was such a great host. I would stay again.

kaldığım en iyi airbnb konaklamamdı, evin temizliği , mobilyaların kalitesi , evin genel kalitesi çok iyiydi , merkezi konumda olmasına rağmen , evin bu kadar kaliteli olmasına rağmen fiyatı çok iyiydi , çok teşekkür ederim
Kadıköy'e ve YHT istasyonuna yakın bir yer, ev temiz, Nursema hanım ilgili bir host teşekkür ederim.

description:
Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby.

You’ll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text: We had a good stay at the apartment. The place was clean, modern, and comfortable, and the host was responsive and helpful during our stay. The location was convenient . Overall, a good experience and good value for the price.

Wow, what a unique Airbnb experience! The apartment was super comfortable and clean, and it had brand-new furniture that made it feel extra cozy. The location was perfect with so many great places to eat nearby, and the public transport made it easy to explore the city.
The playground for the kids was an added bonus and our host was so helpful throughout our stay. Checking in was a breeze, which made our trip stress-free. We highly recommend this place for families looking for a home away from home.

Our stay was absolutely perfect. The apartment was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described. The Esenyurt area is convenient and safe, with shops and transport nearby. The hosts were exceptionally professional, polite, and attentive — always quick to respond and eager to help. They even allowed us to check out at a time that suited us best. Highly recommended, and we would gladly stay here again.

Bu Airbnb'de kalırken harika bir deneyim yaşadık! Daire tertemizdi ve rahat ve keyifli bir konaklama için ihtiyacımız olan her şeye sahipti. Yakınlarda çok sayıda harika restoran ve toplu taşımaya kolay erişim ile konumu da harikaydı. Ev sahibimiz ayrıca inanılmaz derecede yardımsever ve duyarlı, bu da konaklamamızı daha da iyi kılıyor. Bölgeyi ziyaret eden herkese kesinlikle tavsiye ederim!

We had a wonderful stay here! The place was very clean and looked exactly like the pictures, even more beautiful in person. It was peaceful and felt very relaxing. The host was also extremely responsive and helpful whenever we needed anything. We would definitely stay here again!

description:
historical more than 170 years old wooden building with an unique style located in the forrest, with a beautiful natural surrounding, a garden with barbecue facilities, top of the hill far away from noise and stress but still close enough for all the interesting trips, consists of four floors, every floor with separate entrance, Apart 3, located on the 3nd floor.
The electric bus (Ist.card 150TL)drives right past our door, Taxis are also available (Ist.card 350-380TL). On foot 15-20min., uphill

reviews.text:
A wonderful stay, fully enjoyed with managed expectations;)
Apartment: visually exactly as described. Feels a bit smaller in person but perfect for 2. Wonderful natural light pours in, no AC or fan needed- the breeze was amazing. Charming location in nature.
Location: definitely up a hill, busses run frequently. 20 min gentle pace to walk into town.
Hosts: the best we could ask for! Ayten was extremely proactive and responsive, providing local recommendations, tips to get around and advice for any question. Ercan kindly checked us in past midnight and even helped us do our laundry. We were given a late check out too. Couldn’t have had better hosts
Value for money: a little on the costlier side but if you factor in the peace of the island, it can be worth it.
If you are sensitive to noise or animals, do note that we had a seagull family that cried all night and morning. We are animal lovers and found them cute (sometimes. Sometimes we wondered if seagulls were edible (jk)

What a beautiful place to have a peaceful rest & retreat from the world! It’s a cosy and comfortable home, beautiful views, very clean, with everything you need. Great for 1-2 people. Ayten & Ercan are perfect hosts, immediately responsive to questions, providing helpful tips for the island - and making great breakfast conversation :) Definitely worth paying extra for the delicious homemade breakfast, it’s a great value! The small electric bus into “town” is very convenient & stops right at the house so you don’t have to climb a steep hill, just make sure you load up your Istanbulkart to use it. It’s also a good location for hiking and sightseeing on the far side of the island - everything is walkable.

A basic, authentic Airbnb. We stayed in apartment 3, it was immaculately clean and had everything you needed for a short stay.
The highlight was the small balcony, that saw the afternoon sun.
A couple of things to consider if you're thinking of booking (and both are out of the control of the hosts).
The location - we knew it was away from the town and we were happy to walk. However it is a very steep 15 minute uphill climb. Yes there is public transport, but in peak times, you can we waiting a long time for a bus. The buggies charge about £6 for a 1km trip, expensive if you want to head into town morning and evening.
The noise - we expected it to be peaceful, and chose the location for a rest after 4 nights in Istanbul. Unfortunately, the area has many dogs (guard dogs I think) they are left outside, and they bark constantly through the night. Making a nights sleep challenging.
The location is a great base for walks though. ideal for view points, the Orphanage and church.

This July we had an amaizing time at this place.
It's a historical house but it's been handled with care and attention. Cozy and always clean. You might see some traces of wear on the house itslef, but it's just how it goes with the houses on the island. Climate is not very gentle with the old-old wood.
It was our 4th time on the islands, but this one was one of the best locations. Far from the noise and crowds of passing tourists. Bus line is right next to you so you don't have to worry about climbing the hills.
Our room was perfect. Nice view and great bedroom with a small balcony. Kitchen is small but gets the work done, if you're into small portion cooking.
Ayten & Ercan are wonderful hosts. As well as their cats! We had some really great (and long) conversations and amazing home dinners. (Not with the cats, obviosly. They were mostly chilling nearby).
We wish them the best, appreciate the hospistality and hopefully going to visit them again next year.

İstanbul’dan kaçıp bir günlüğüne kafa dinlemek için seçtik burayı, çok doğru seçmişiz. Konumu çok güzel gerçekten doğanın içindeki o huzuru hissettiriyor, evin dokusu, dizaynı çokk güzel. Fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibi. Ayten hanım çok sıcak ve çok samimi bir ev sahibiydi her konuda yardımcı oldu. Temizlik gayet güzeldi. Balkonda kahve içmek o kadar keyifliydi ki, dinlenmek kafa dinlemek için kaçacak bir yerimiz oldu. Çok teşekkür ederiz. Ayrıca çarşıya yürümek de keyifli uzak değil, evin önünden sürekli minibüsler de geçiyor ulaşımı kolay. Gönül rahatlığıyla gidebilirsiniz.

description:
This place is located in the center of Kadikoy. Walking distance to everything. Every other major tourist destination outside of the Kadikoy is reachable via major public transportation including subways and Moda T3 Tram.

Guest access
* WI-FI is provided.
* Kitchenware, dining ware, and utensils are provided.
* Towels are provided.
* The mounted air conditioning is available.

reviews.text: It's a very lovely place. super clean and many useful stuff. The apartment even smells great. It has good design that makes it peaceful. The apartment and the furnitures looked new and very clean. the location is great and the hosts were super helpful and kind and responsible. They were even flexible with our check in and check out. In fact They helped us as much as possible. My wife and I highly recommend it to those who mind about clean bed, bathroom, etc.

Great location to enjoy your stay in Istanbul. Apartment is right in the center of kadikoy. 10-15 walk to ferry port. Lots of grocery and restaurants around there. Host is very responsive. Have all needed instructions beforehand. Apartment is clean, well decorated, and has everything you could ever need. More than worth it's price
Nice location - very walkable around Kadikoy. Great instructions from the host, easy check in and check out. Comfy bed, quite bedroom. Squeaky clean.

Me and my friend stayed in Burak's apartment for 5 nights.
Once we entered, we felt how spacious and comfy his apartment is. The kitchen has all the amenities you need from seasonings to a pealing knife. The toilet has all of the essentials including women hygiene products (much appreciated!).
The apartment is located in calm area but lots of cafés, shops and restaurants are on 3-5 min walk. The Metro and Ferry are reachable by Tram but we wanted to walk since the neighbourhood is really enjoyable (15-20 min walk). Same for the Train (Marmaray).
Our host, Burak, is incredibly welcoming, responsive, and accommodating throughout our stay. He also shared ideas on places for eat, grab a drink.. he even has a foldable chairs so you can enjoy on the Moda Pier Park!
Overall, I recommend this apartment highly! Whether you're in town for business or pleasure, this is the perfect place to call home during your stay. Thank you for providing such a wonderful Airbnb experience!

One of the best qualities of this place is it's location in the very center of Kadıköy. The place itself is as shown in the pictures. The host has very detailed descriptions for almost everything. He was very helpful regarding an early check-in and late check-out.
Tekrar her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz, Burak bey!

description:
Armoni Residence is located in the center of Istanbul and designed to bring together the comfort of your home with the Residence concept where you are offered luxurious service.

You can notice the combination of cleanliness and comfort with a sparkling clean living room, a fully equipped American kitchen, a bedroom with a carefully washed and ironed linen set, a luxurious bathroom with all your special needs and equipment in your apartment.

reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at Armoni’s residence. The location is great, quiet and peaceful, close to the metro and bus stops. The apartment itself was as described in the listing, with a responsive host. There’s also a great selection of restaurants and other service operations just near by.

Tek kelime ile muhteşem. Odalar geniş ve ferah mutfak eşyalar gayet kullanışlı ve yeterli. Ev sahibimiz Gökhan bey herşey ile ilgili ve anında problem çözen bir insandı. Bebekle konakladığımız bu yerde temizlikle alakalı aklınızda en ufak birşey kalmayacak bir ev.
Muhit olarak etrafı lüks ve lezzetli restoranlar hep yürüme mesafesinde. Şehire bir adım kadar yakın ancak şehrin gürültüsünden bir o kadar uzaktık.
Kapalı otoparkının ekstra ücretli olması dışında hiç bir konuda şaşırtmadı bizi :) Herşeyden çok memnun kaldık. Çok teşekkürler.

The flat hosted by Gökhan met our needs during our stay in Gayrettepe. It was conveniently located and spacious (large living room, dining room, large bathroom, full kitchen, lots of closet space). The check-in process was seamless and the reception staff were extremely helpful.

Önemli bir sağlık problemi nedeniyle İstanbul'a gelmemiz gerektiğinde gerek trafik ve ulaşım gerek kalacağımız yerin hijyeni ve araç park olanakları bizim için çok önemliydi. Bununla beraber konaklayacağımız yere geldiğimizde hem ana ulaşım yollarına yakınlığı, hem kapalı otoparkının oluşu hem de aldığımız hizmet ve olanaklar bizi inanılmaz rahat ettirdi.
Her sorumuzu verilen samimi cevaplar ve problemlerimizle ilgili çözüm odaklı yaklaşım zaten taşıdığımız stresin üzerinde stres eklemeyi bırakın resmen yükümüzü aldı.
Çok Teşekkürler
Gokhan is a great host, I enjoyed staying here. The apartment is clean and modern. The apartment is in a quiet area.

description:
Our place is located in Mecidiyeköy.
A central point, quiet and on a street away from the city's crowds.

*2 min to Trump Towers Shopping Mall
*An apartment with renovated interior and surroundings.
*Separate air conditioning in the bedroom and living room.
*Kitchen (Dishwasher, Washing Machine with Dryer, Stove, etc.) will meet your basic needs.
*Our apartment is on the first floor from the entrance (there are only 7-8 steps), there is no elevator.

Note: The accommodation is a licensed apart hotel.

reviews.text: Her şey fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibi verdiğiniz parayı sonuna kadar hakeden bir ev. Kendi evinizde gibi hissedebilirsiniz. Konum olarak çok merkezi bir yerde Trump Tower’ın hemen 2 arka sokağındasınız. Metroya yakın bir konumda. Ev sahibi Ahmet Bey son derece ilgili ve titiz birisi. Her türlü sorunuzu cevaplıyor ve ilgileniyor. Evdeki eşyalar tertemiz her türlü ihtiyaç düşünülmüş tabak tencere her türlü bardak ve mutfak malzemesi var. Televizyonu yatak odası koltukları son derece harikaydı. Ev merkezi bir konumda olduğu için bazen araç sesleri duyabilirsiniz. Binanın dış görünüşüne aldanmayın dairenin içerisi son derece temiz ve düzenli. Hiç tereddüt etmeden konaklama yapabilirsiniz. Ahmet Bey’e çok teşekkürler. Bir dahaki İstanbul seyahatimizde yolumuz düşerse önceliklermizden birisi olacak kesinlikle.

Really enjoyed our stay at Ahmed's Airbnb. He was very very responsive and friendly. Airbnb was as clean and beautiful as it showed in photos. We found everything we need inside. Best part is it close to Mecidiyeköy Metro. There's also metro bus you will. Overall it was perfect.

We liked Ahmed's hosting and his apartment so much that we booked it for another week. Airbnb was clean and comfortable with easier access to public transport. The unit looks as it is in the pictures. Lastly, check in & check out were also smooth & hassle free.

Ahmet bey ilgili iyi bir insan sorunlarimiza cozum olmaya calisti fakat evde klozette bi sorun vardi gerek ses bakimindan gerekse kullanis bakimindan problem yasadik giderilmeye calisildi fakat bizim orada oldugumuz surece giderilemedi. Fiyat Performans olarak beklentimi karsilamadi, evin disi dis kapilari merdivenleri olsun eskiydi ve bu fotograflarda belirtilmedi daha sonradan wp uzerinden kiralamayi yaptiktan sonra atildi bize fotograflar Ev temizligi acisindan problem yok sadece biraz eski banyoda isitma yoktu soguktu cok cok iyi bir deneyim olmasada gene de idare ederdi fakat bu fiyata daha iyi yerler bulunabilir
Ahmed is very helpful and kind. The apartment is beautiful and clean, and the location is excellent

description: Hello! We look forward to welcoming you to our luxury apartments in the heart of Istanbul. With its new and earthquake-resistant building, "Insense Apartments" offers safe and comfortable accommodation. It is decorated with modern and stylish items, prioritizing the comfort of the guests. With its central location, you can easily reach the most attractive points of Istanbul. Our apartments, which combine comfort and luxury with their unique architecture, await you for an unforgettable accommodation experience!

reviews.text:
We had a lovely 4 night stay here.
Easily the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in.
It felt so luxurious.
The apartment is even more spacious and beautiful than in the photos.
The balcony was so lovely to sit and enjoy at various point during the day.
It was very quiet despite the central location. We slept very well indeed.
It was very, very clean and had so many useful amenities!
We felt so comfortable and at home here.
And it was so lovely to be able to arrive back here after a long day of walking in the heat to relax in the super comfortable bed with excellent air conditioning.
Maria was VERY responsive to any questions or issues we had.
Thank you for an amazing stay, it really enhanced our trip to Istanbul.
We wish Maria had an Airbnb in every city we visited!

Beautiful apartment, very clear directions, fun area. Super quiet at night even in the chaos of Istanbul on New Year’s Eve. Modern amenities, comfortable and stylish and spotlessly clean. Lift was excellent. Maria was super responsive and even brought a bottle of wine and some treats for the new year! It’s easy to walk around trendy parts of Istanbul from here but also easy to get across to the Asian side or to tourist sites across the water!

Maria’s place was awesome and exactly as it was described. Apartment was very well designed, clean and had top notch appliances. Needless to say that location was the best! Surrounded by all the good cafes, restaurants and couple mins walking distance to both ferry and tramline. Check-in, check-out process very easy and appreciated that they let us get to apartment very earlier than it should be. Definitely recommend that place and Maria as a host! Will stay there again in the future for sure!

First of all, I would simply say I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Istanbul.
Apartment:
- The apartment itself was finished to such a high standard. You can tell instantly that they have taken time and care to think about all the details. It felt very cosy yet spacious too.
- The apartment had all the amenities for our stay including a large comfortable bed, washer & dryer, iron, great shower and so on. We didn't feel it was lacking in any sense at all.
Location:
- This was the perfect location for our visit to Istanbul and if returning, I would stay in the same place. The apartment is within 2 minutes walk to the tram, ferry and the lovely waterfront for amazing views of the Istanbul skyline.
- Located near so many restaurants but still in a private street which was quiet and peaceful at night too and felt very safe.
Maria was a great host, proactive in all her communications and texted mid-stay to check if we needed anything.
We would definitely stay again!

Maria’s place is in the perfect location for walking everywhere in Istanbul- all major attractions in walking distance so no need for public transport .
The apartment is spotless and very well appointed . Great shower, bed and pillows very comfortable, and welcome lemon infused water, nuts and fruit a lovey surprise on arrival .
Maria also gave great restaurant recommendations some just on the doorstep, and a coffee cafe just below was great as well .
Maria is a very responsive host and always answered queries promptly.
Would highly recommend if you are coming to Istanbul.

description: Stay in the heart of Beşiktaş, just a 5-minute walk from vibrant Nişantaşı. This chic 1-bedroom apartment combines modern comfort with elegant design—ideal for solo travelers or couples seeking a central and stylish base in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We stayed here for just under three weeks and ended up extending our stay midway through because it truly felt like home. Any minor issue that came up was addressed quickly and efficiently, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
The apartment itself is comfortable, well equipped, and has everything you need for a longer stay. What we appreciated most, though, was the location. It’s only a few steps from the heart of Beşiktaş, giving you easy access to countless restaurants, cafés, shops, and ferries, yet it’s tucked away just enough that you can enjoy peace and quiet away from the crowds.
It’s also within walking distance of Nişantaşı, or just a short taxi ride away, which typically costs around 200 TL and takes only a few minutes.
Above all, the hosts were fantastic. They made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we arrived and were always responsive, helpful, and accommodating throughout our stay. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and would happily recommend it to any

Stayed there for 8 nights. The place was clean, cozy & homey. We love exploring the neighborhood, it has everything you could ask for within walking distance. Doruk and team were very communicative and helpful. would definitely love to comeback on the next visit to Istanbul.

I wasn’t able to complete my stay in Beşiktaş but Anastasia, Ugur, and the host team went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of. Truly, this was the top 1% of customer service I have ever experienced. If you have any issues, reach out to them and politely explain and they will do everything in their power to assist you. I would stay at one of their properties again in a heartbeat.
One word of caution: the neighborhood for this apartment is VERY hilly. You should be of reasonable fitness to climb stairs in order to enjoy your stay. Don’t try to save money via public transit when you first arrive — take a taxi here with your luggage. Thank me later!

Eşimle birlikte 3 ay konakladığımız bu evden çok memnun ayrıldık. Ev tam olarak fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi, temiz ve düzenliydi.
Beşiktaş vapur iskelesine ve otobüs duraklarına 10 dakika, çarşıya ise sadece 5 dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde olması hayatımızı çok kolaylaştırdı. Nişantaşı ve Teşvikiye gibi bölgelere de yürüyerek ulaşabiliyorsunuz (yokuş sevenler için harika bir rota!).
Uzaktan çalışan biri olarak internet bağlantısının kalitesinden çok memnun kaldım; hem toplantılar hem de Netflix/YouTube için gayet yeterliydi.
Apartman genel olarak sessiz, çevresi ise oldukça güvenli. Mutfak gereçleri nispeten az olsa da temizlik malzemesi gibi detaylar fazlasıyla düşünülmüştü. Ev sahiplerinin her türlü küçük sorunda hızlıca çözüm üretmesi ve ilgili olmaları bizi çok güvende hissettirdi.
Her şey için teşekkürler!

We stayed at this apartment which was the perfect location for us. The apartment was clean and had all the things we needed to make it a nice a stay. The team are very helpful and reply within a couple of minutes. highly recommended.

description:
It is in the most pleasant and easily accessible place of Nişantaşı. It is also easy to reach Beşiktaş by walking or stairs. Our apartment is surrounded by the best venues for shopping, dining, night and day entertainment.
Our flat is large and spacious with 3 bedrooms, a bathroom and a kitchen.
You will be able to find cooking supplies in the kitchen.
There is a high speed internet.
The living room has a corner seat, TV, xiaomi mi, work desk, large dining table for six and bookshelf.

reviews.text:
It was my first time getting Airbnb in Istanbul after three cancellations. Finally, I ended up with Mr Hakan's accommodation,
We had a very grateful and comfortable time with my family in this accommodation, you have access to so many places near the house, a lovely neighbourhood
very clean house
Also will get gifts from me Hakan and clean sheets. Clean towels, an air conditioner, food, kitchen air conditioner, food, kitchen for cooking, clean bathroom. Also, the apartment got a lift as well, which is very important it in. I don’t want quality cheese with Sasha as funny as the basement, but you don’t feel the basement at all.
Thanks, Airbnb for recommending this nice accommodation and
Thanks, Mr Hakan for being a very good house and lovely representative of your country. I highly recommend it to friends and family.

It was a great experience staying here, so grateful to meet such a wonderful and friendly host, the place is in an amazing location of Nisantasi/Besiktas clean easy to communicate I highly recommend this place and host to everyone.

I really want to appreciate of the host (Mrs Ensie)she is so kind and respectful.she responded to every single messages i sent her about our requests (if we needed something she provided it quickly),she answered and guided kindly to all questions we asked about area,shops,transport....
She was waiting for us When we reached the location,after showing the flat and explaining everything ,she helped to find nearest currency Ex change and took me there because she noticed i was worried about the turkish currency and need to go shopping ,she stayed for hours and left us when made sure all is good,i know,it's a duty of a host to be at location and pass the key to guest but staying and spending more time is not their duty.I really appreciate her,thank you Ensie.
We had a great stay for 9 days at the apartment. We have 3 young children and the apartment was well equipped and very clean. Great location too!

hôte très réactif et accueillant
nous avons passé un super séjour en famille

description: Welcome to our cozy İstanbul apartment located between Cihangir and Galataport. Stunning view of the Bosphorus, Maidens Tower and ferries awaits you in living room and balcony. The location is quite unique as the house is within walking distance of the Galataport, Cihangir neighborhood, seaside, public transportation, bars and restaurants. Our Check in time is from 14:00 til 17:00.

reviews.text:
My parents and I had a wonderful stay here and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. The location is fantastic, within walking distance of Taksim Square, with beautiful views and everything you need nearby, including grocery stores.
The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our stay. What really stood out, though, was the host. She was incredibly accessible and responsive, every time we messaged her, she got back to us within minutes and was always helpful.
She also went above and beyond when we were checking out. We had a lot of luggage and had to leave early in the morning, and she arranged for a bellboy to come and help us with all of our bags and she even helped us herself to get our luggages downstairs. She made sure everything went smoothly and that we had a great experience right until the very end.
Overall, a fantastic experience from start to finish. I would definitely stay here again!

Here’s a revised version of the review:
“The location of this flat was ideal, with great proximity to various areas and a lovely view from the living room. However, there are some important details that were not reflected in the listing photos. The building exterior has some visible wear, and there is no lift available, so guests need to be prepared to carry luggage up a significant number of uneven stairs, which may be challenging with larger or multiple suitcases.
Inside, the amenities were a bit lacking. The kitchen and other essentials could use some updates, and the cleaning standards left room for improvement. Basic necessities like shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were not provided, which was inconvenient.
The living room was nicely designed and comfortable, but the bedrooms and kitchen appliances (aside from the fridge and cooker) are in need of a refresh. The bathroom, in particular, requires attention. While there’s an attempt at a shower upgrade, there is visible mold

We stayed in this apartment for 4 days. Everything went great. We easily got to the apratment. Denise's sister was super welcome and answered on messages and calls immediately. We had 3 keys to the apartment. The apartment was super warm in movember. We even switched off some of the batterys. There were no problems with hot water in the bathroom. All 3 bedrooms had enough pillows and blankets. So everything was comfortable. The view is amazing. You will see the sunrise at the Bosphorus from the dining room. The location is great. You can easily get to all main tourist attractions by tha tram #1 (the nearest tram stop is 5 minutes from the apartment). You will need to climb the stairs to reach the apartment. We did not have luggage so it was not a problem. It is not easy to walk in Istanbul, you will always need to go up and down various hills. But it definitely worth it.

I had an awesome time in Istanbul. The apartment was super clean and tidy.
The view was amazing.
There was air-conditioning in two bedrooms.
In the apartment, we had all what we needed. so we didn't need to bring anything with us. (Kitchenware, towels, shampoo, toilet paper rolls, TV with PS4, ... etc)
The only downside was the stairs. The apartment is on the second floor, and there are extra 40-50 steps to the mainstreet. Therefore, it is not recommended for elders.
For small groups or big families, the apartment is ideal.
Compared to the location and equipment, the price was cheap

Our stay in Denis's apartment was a dream vacation: The place has absolutely epic views of the Bosphorus (you can catch the sunrise over the water directly from the living room!) which is gorgeous day and night. The place is conveniently located near the Galata port, many super nice local cafes and restaurants, and is only a short walk away from supermarkets, ferries, and the Taksim square.
The place was well-equipped with everything we needed (lots of clean towels and linens, all sorts of kitchenware, washing machine and dishwasher, etc.), a really nice collection of books on the shelf, a play station, and the place is so gorgeously designed that it feels like home.
Denis and her sister were super friendly, hospitable, kind, and flexible with us, for which I'm really grateful. It really made us feel like we're staying with family. They were very easily accessible, responsive, and helpful.
I would highly recommend Denis's place, I guarantee the experience would be one of a kind.

description: Our hotel room is located in Arnavutkoy. We have comfortable rooms just 15 minutes to Airport

reviews.text: This is a well-located and well-maintained hotel where we stayed for one night before flying out of Istanbul. It was perfect for us with its 24 hour restaurant and convenient location near the airport. The person at the reception was helpful and pleasant. We would stay here again if we needed a place near Istanbul airport.

I had a fantastic experience staying at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The property was immaculately clean and well-maintained, providing a very comfortable and relaxing environment. What truly stood out, however, was the incredibly friendly and helpful staff. They went above and beyond to ensure my stay was perfect, offering great local tips and assisting with any requests. I highly recommend this place!
The room was clean, the hotel was near the Istanbul airport and there were many different restaurants around. I’ll recommend this place
Our stay at this place was pleasant overall. The room was clean and tidy, the location was convenient, and the staff was friendly and helpful.
Nice and comfortable place to stay. Very close to the airport, ideally for short city break. Staff are very friendly and responsive.

description: My place is close to: Little Hagia Sophia, close to the Sultanahmet Mosque and Hagia Sophia. You'll love my place because of the people, the outdoors, and the neighborhood. My place is suitable for couples, solo adventurers, families (with kids), and large groups.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay, the apartment was as described. Clean, nice and warm with a good shower. Very close to the Blue mosque and Grand bazzar. We did so much exploring. Thank you Furuk for your great communication and special thanks to the cleaner who would make extra efforts in making the apartment wonderfully clean every other day.

This unit located only a few minutes by walking to Kumkapi metro station and only 3 station away from Sirkeci main station. Kitchen are complete with all that needed. Our unit was on the 2nd floor with a spiral & narrow stairs as its quite challenging to carry our baggage through it. We experienced a low water pressure, challenge with water heater plus a cold room because of the centralised room heater was centralize and cannot be ON. Anyhow, we were treated very well and attentively by Mr Faruk.

Great location! Apartment was nice and clean. The host was very helpful and friendly. Very quick response when you need any help, he can also arrange a pick up from airports.
We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment as it had everything we needed. I would stay again and recommend it to others. So close to all attractions. Thank you and we hope to visit wonderful Istanbul again.

Fatih was very proactive and clear in his communication. He provided recommendations as to where we could eat local dishes. He was always responsive when I asked him any questions. The location was perfect. We could reach the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque just by walking. We could also walk to other restaurants. There is a local supermarket nearby where we could shop for groceries too. Recommended!

Good and quiet area with nice cafes close by and short walking distance for central attractions (uphill if that is relevant for your level of fitness). The host was very helpful and gave a great recommendation for somewhere we would have missed otherwise.

description:
Our modern and stylish penthouse apartment with a large terrace is a 1+1 apartment with an en-suite bathroom. It has a total capacity of 4 people
it is in a very central location 1 minute from the subway.
there are shops such as a grocery store, a butcher.
our apartment is on the third floor and there is no elevator. (we have a few more apartments for large families in the same building)
(we organize extra-day Istanbul tours to our guests at their request)

reviews.text:
The apartment was great and comfortable, we also loved terrace. Our hosts were very helpful and welcoming.
We were very close to metro station Huzur which was very convenient. We also had free parking.
Overall our experience was great 🤍

Özellikle Ataşehir - Bostancı tarafında iş ve gezi seyahatleri için metro ile ulaşımla büyük rahatlık sunan lokasyonda. Yine metro ile Üsküdar'a kolayca varılabilir. Semt her ne kadar dışarıda da olsa İstanbul'u tanımayanlar için gönül rahatlığı ile kalabilecekleri nezih ve güvenli bir mahallede. Evin dizaynı çok kullanışlı ve konfor sunuyor. Özellikle terasın varlığı ile kuzeydeki bir semt olduğu için boğucu yaz aylarında size nefes aldıracak bir tercih olacak.
Ev fotoğraflardaki gibiydi, temiz düzenli mobilyaları yeni ve rahattı. Ev sahipleri çok nazik ve ilgili insanlar her konuda yardımcı oldular.
Clean Appartment with everything necessary. Near to subway station.

Hem konumu bulma açısından hem dairenin düzen ve temizliği hem giriş çıkış konusunda sağladıkları kolaylıklar hem de diğer ihtiyaçlarımızla ilgili yardımları için çok teşekkür ederiz. Dairenin bulunduğu muhit genel olarak sessiz ve huzurlu, geceleri çok iyi şekilde dinlendik. Dairede gerek tabak çatal vb. gerek beyaz eşya, küçük ev eşyası vb. açısından lazım olabilecek her şey mevcut bu bizim için büyük kolaylık oldu. description: Cozy Home in Historic Istanbul

reviews.text:
Appartment
Clean, well equipped kitchen, four bedrooms, two bathrooms. Air conditioning. Home from home. No complaints. Its on the third floor but this was not a problem for us. Sufficient for family of 6 adults. A great base to explore Istanbul from.
Location
It’s in a busy, suburban neighbour. There are family bakers, small grocers and restaurants. The people are friendly and generous natured. There are several medium sized hotels within 50m. Within 100m there are foreign exchange offices. The metro station Yenikapi is less than 10 minutes walking but we found that the tram at Atakoy, (which is also less than 10 minutes walking) was better. You can walk towards Sultanahmet in about 25 minutes or in about 4 or 5 stops get there on the tram which costs £0.50 pence if you use the prepaid card or £0.75 pence if you ‘tap’ your debit card. All the major tourist attractions are on this route.
Host
Huseyin replied to messages very quickly. He was polite, friendly and helpful.

Great place to stay. The neighborhood isn't the best part of Istanbul, but it was convenient to get to many areas by public transportation or walking. The unit was clean and had plenty of space. It was nice that some small items like soap/toothpaste/etc were provided if needed. There was AC in the master bedroom. The other rooms were a bit warm, but not bad. The shower in the master bedroom was a bit finicky and water would run from the shower to the bathroom floor if you weren't careful, so it would be nice to fix that, but otherwise fast internet and no other concerns. Host is very responsive!

Extremely fantastic place. Was lucky enough to meet Husyein in the end. Helped me with bags and was really impressed by his place. Solid secure door on entry, fantastic pre check in communication,and ensured we had everything we could possibly need. I'm shocked with how well equipped his place was. Even had mens razors and grooming kits to towels to dishwasher tablets to washing up liquid and softener. The beds are extremely comfortable and large enough rooms meant as a family of 4 we could easily move around and store and irganise our luggage/clothes. The thing is on entry to the property. There is no lift in the building, but we did not mind walking up the stairs as we only needed to do it twice a day. very clean place and spot on location for travel via bus and metro. in the middle of a busy area yet very quiet during the night but convienet for breakfast and for shopping. I wouldn't bother booking elsewhere. I'm booking this place again without a shadow of doubt. Hussain is superb.

We had a wonderful stay! The house had everything our family of four needed for our 10-day visit. It was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. All the little amenities we needed for our stay were well-thought-out and provided—even things you wouldn’t normally think of, like a weighing scale, travel adapters, vanity kits, irons, coffee, tea, sugar, ice packs and first aid kits. The location was excellent—close to both metro and tram lines, with many shops around the area open until late, which made it very convenient. The area was safe for children, and shop prices were reasonably priced. The host was extremely helpful, resourceful, and very responsive, even arranging airport pickup for us. We will definitely be going back!

I had a fantastic stay! The location was perfect, the apartment was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and well-equipped. What really made the experience outstanding was the amazing communication with the host. They responded incredibly fast, were always helpful, and made everything so smooth and easy. Highly recommend!

description: Located in the very center of Istanbul, the apartment offers a unique accommodation opportunity in the heart of the city with its 75-inch giant TV and open terrace. Cevahir Shopping Mall, Metro, Metrobus are within a 5-7 min walk.
